66412.recognize_zh: 組織中一顆大型顆粒，中心呈淡嗜伊紅、可見細小裂隙與纖維狀結構，邊緣有一圈深紫色放射狀絲狀菌帶，周圍被嗜中性球與出血包圍；這種「硫磺顆粒」（sulfur granule）是放線菌病（Actinomyces）的典型表現。
features: Large, well-demarcated granule (colony) with a pale eosinophilic, finely fibrillary center containing needle-like clefts
Dense basophilic band of radiating filaments at the peripheral edge (upper margin)
Eosinophilic club-like fringe (Splendore-Hoeppli material) at portions of the periphery
Surrounding rim of neutrophils admixed with red cells and golden-brown hemosiderin/fibrin
Loose fibrous stroma in the background
66412.describe_en: H&E-stained section of a peritoneal nodule shows a large, well-circumscribed granule within a neutrophil-rich inflammatory infiltrate with hemorrhage and hemosiderin deposition. The granule has a pale eosinophilic, fibrillary center and a basophilic peripheral band of radiating filaments with an eosinophilic club-like fringe. The surrounding tissue shows loose fibrous stroma. Findings are consistent with a sulfur granule of actinomycosis; Gram and GMS stains highlighting branching gram-positive filaments and culture are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Nocardia rarely forms true granules, and its beaded branching filaments are modified acid-fast positive, whereas Actinomyces is acid-fast negative.
Botryomycotic granules are composed of gram-positive cocci or gram-negative bacilli rather than thin branching filaments.
Fungal grains contain broad septate hyphae (3-5 um) with chlamydospores on GMS/PAS, much thicker than bacterial filaments (<1 um).

ddx.dx: Hyphal fungal ball (e.g., Aspergillus) or calcified debris
ddx.vs: Aspergillus shows acute-angle branching septate hyphae without a Splendore-Hoeppli fringe, and calcific debris lacks filaments on Gram stain.

exam.answer_en: Actinomycosis — sulfur granule with radiating basophilic filaments and eosinophilic club-like fringe (Splendore-Hoeppli) in suppurative inflammation
pearls_zh: 考法：指著膿瘍中央的圓形顆粒問名稱與病原；答 sulfur granule，Actinomyces（多為 A. israelii）。
周邊嗜酸性棒狀邊緣為 Splendore-Hoeppli phenomenon（抗原抗體複合物沉積），並非 Actinomyces 專屬，也見於寄生蟲與其他真菌。
特殊染色：Gram 陽性分枝細絲、GMS 陽性；modified acid-fast 陰性，此點用來與 Nocardia（弱抗酸陽性）區分。
Actinomyces 為厭氧菌，培養需告知實驗室；腹腔/骨盆放線菌病與 IUD 相關，常形成腫塊而被誤當惡性腫瘤；治療以長療程 penicillin 為主。
exam.pitfall_zh: 顆粒易被誤認為 botryomycosis（葡萄球菌等形成的顆粒，Gram 染色為球菌）或鈣化/異物；需做 Gram 找分枝細絲，並以 modified AFB 排除 Nocardia。

quiz.q: 圖中顆粒要與 Nocardia 區分，應加做哪一種染色？預期結果為何？
quiz.a: Modified acid-fast（Fite）；Actinomyces 陰性，Nocardia 陽性。

66348.recognize_zh: 骨小樑之間有一顆巨大的多核巨細胞（multinucleated giant cell），細胞質豐富嗜伊紅，數十個核聚集於中央並部分沿周邊排列，細胞質內含一個圓形顆粒狀包涵體，外圍有小淋巴球與組織球環繞，背景為含嗜伊紅性球的反應性造血骨髓。
features: Very large multinucleated giant cell with abundant homogeneous eosinophilic cytoplasm lying between two bony trabeculae
Numerous oval vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli, clustered centrally and partly arranged at the periphery
Rounded granular/stellate intracytoplasmic inclusion within the giant cell
Surrounding cuff of small lymphocytes and epithelioid histiocytes
Background hypercellular marrow with numerous eosinophils, plasma cells and scattered megakaryocytes
66348.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a large multinucleated giant cell with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, numerous centrally clustered and peripherally arranged nuclei, and a rounded granular intracytoplasmic inclusion. The giant cell is surrounded by epithelioid histiocytes and a cuff of small mature lymphocytes. The adjacent marrow is cellular with a reactive background rich in eosinophils and plasma cells, and megakaryocytes are present. No necrosis or atypical large cells are identified. Findings are consistent with a giant cell-containing granulomatous reaction in the marrow; infectious causes should be excluded with special stains.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single lobulated hyperchromatic nucleus and granular cytoplasm, not multiple separate vesicular nuclei in a histiocytic cytoplasm with a lymphocytic cuff.
Osteoclasts sit in Howship lacunae directly on the bone surface with uniformly distributed nuclei and no surrounding granulomatous cuff.
RS cells have two or a few nuclei with large inclusion-like eosinophilic nucleoli and are CD30/CD15 positive, unlike the many small-nucleolated nuclei of a histiocytic giant cell.
Infectious granulomas may look identical and require AFB and GMS stains, culture or PCR for exclusion.

66092.recognize_zh: A 圖冠狀 CT 見巨大前縱膈腔腫塊合併肋膜及心包膜積液；B 圖母細胞核質比高、染色質細緻、有明顯核仁，細胞質淡藍無顆粒並拉出手鏡狀（hand-mirror）突起；C 圖流式中紅色母細胞 cyCD3 強陽、表面 CD3 弱、CD7 強陽、CD45 弱，年輕男性加上縱膈腫塊，符合 T 淋巴母細胞白血病／淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A (coronal CT): bulky anterior mediastinal mass with bilateral pleural effusions and pericardial effusion
Panel B (smear): large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin and prominent nucleoli
Blast cytoplasm scant to moderate, mildly basophilic and agranular, drawn into elongated hand-mirror (uropod) projections
Panel C (flow): blast population (red) CD45 dim with low side scatter and partial CD34 expression
Blasts show bright cytoplasmic CD3 with dim/partial surface CD3 and bright CD7, supporting T-lineage
66092.describe_en: Coronal chest CT demonstrates a bulky anterior mediastinal mass with bilateral pleural and pericardial effusions. The smear shows large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and mildly basophilic agranular cytoplasm forming hand-mirror projections, without Auer rods or vacuoles. Flow cytometry reveals a dominant CD45-dim, low side-scatter blast population with partial CD34, bright cytoplasmic CD3, dim surface CD3 and bright CD7 expression. The combination of mediastinal mass, lymphoblastic morphology and T-lineage precursor phenotype is consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may show granules or Auer rods and express MPO, CD13/CD33/CD117, whereas these blasts are MPO-negative and cytoplasmic CD3 bright.
B-ALL blasts look identical but express CD19, CD79a and PAX5 and lack cytoplasmic CD3, and rarely present with a bulky mediastinal mass.

Thymic T cells are TdT+/CD1a+ but show a normal maturational continuum (CD4/CD8 double-positive to single-positive) with cytokeratin-positive epithelium, unlike this monomorphic CD4−/CD8− blast population in marrow and blood.
ETP-ALL lacks CD1a and CD8, has weak CD5 and expresses stem/myeloid markers (CD117, CD13, CD33, HLA-DR), whereas these blasts are CD5+, CD1a+ and myeloid-negative.

exam.answer_en: T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma — bulky anterior mediastinal mass, agranular hand-mirror lymphoblasts, cytoplasmic CD3+/CD7+ blasts on flow
pearls_zh: 考法：CT + 抹片 + flow 三合一；關鍵是 cytoplasmic CD3 陽性，WHO 定義 T 系列（lineage-assigning marker）。
T-ALL/LBL 常見表型：TdT+、CD1a±、CD2、CD5、CD7、cyCD3+，CD4/CD8 可雙陽或雙陰；MPO 陰性。
ETP-ALL：CD1a−、CD8−、CD5 弱（<75% 陽性），並表現 CD117/CD34/HLA-DR/CD13/CD33 等至少一項。
急症：前縱膈腫塊可致 superior vena cava syndrome 與氣道壓迫，麻醉鎮靜風險高；高腫瘤負荷注意 tumor lysis syndrome。
T-ALL 與 T-LBL 的慣例區分：骨髓 lymphoblast ≥25% 稱 leukemia，否則以 lymphoma 為主。
exam.pitfall_zh: 手鏡狀突起不代表特定系列，易被誤判為 AML；決定系列靠 flow：cyCD3+、MPO−、無 CD13/CD33/CD117 支持 T-ALL。

quiz.q: 流式圖中哪個標記確立芽細胞為 T 系列？此病人最需預防的縱膈相關急症為何？
quiz.a: Cytoplasmic CD3；superior vena cava syndrome／氣道壓迫（加上 tumor lysis）。

66284.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆比周圍紅血球大約兩倍的細胞，細胞核圓形、偏心且未分葉，染色質中度凝集；細胞質豐富，佈滿粗大顆粒，以粉橘紅色為主並夾雜少量偏紫色的未成熟顆粒；圓核加上嗜酸性顆粒，符合嗜酸性骨髓球（eosinophilic myelocyte）。
features: Large cell (about 2 red cell diameters) with abundant cytoplasm and moderate N:C ratio
Round, eccentric, non-indented and non-segmented nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin; no distinct nucleolus
Cytoplasm filled with coarse granules, predominantly pink-orange with admixed purplish (immature, basophilic-staining) eosinophil granules
Granules partly overlap the nucleus; no Auer rods
Surrounding red cells normocytic and normochromic
66284.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large granulocytic precursor with a round, eccentric, non-segmented nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin without an evident nucleolus, and abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse pink-orange eosinophilic granules admixed with some darker purplish immature granules. Background red cells are normocytic and normochromic. The morphology is consistent with an eosinophilic myelocyte; its presence in blood suggests a left-shifted or myeloproliferative process and warrants correlation with the eosinophil count and CBC.

ddx.vs: Mature eosinophils have a bilobed nucleus with condensed chromatin and uniformly orange refractile granules, whereas this cell has a round non-segmented nucleus.
Basophilic granules are dark purple-black, water-soluble and obscure the nucleus, rather than predominantly pink-orange.

ddx.dx: Abnormal eosinophil precursors of AML with inv(16)/t(16;16)
ddx.vs: inv(16) eosinophils contain large, dark purple-violet abnormal granules predominating in early precursors within a blast-rich marrow, unlike this well-granulated myelocyte.
Neutrophilic myelocytes have fine lilac specific granules with a perinuclear Golgi zone rather than coarse orange eosinophilic granules.

65900.recognize_zh: 中央一個大型圓形透明空泡（脂肪空泡或抹片氣泡）佔去大半畫面，周圍擠滿核偏位、細胞質灰藍的漿細胞樣細胞；影像失焦，標題所說的雙核漿細胞在這張圖中難以明確辨認。
features: Large central round clear space (fat vacuole or bubble) with pink fibrin strands occupying much of the field
Surrounding crowded plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm
Coarse chromatin with occasional perinuclear clearing
Possible binucleate cells at the periphery, but not convincingly resolved
Marked blur and color cast limit assessment of nuclear detail
65900.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large central clear space, likely a fat vacuole or bubble with fibrin strands, surrounded by crowded plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm. The image is substantially out of focus, so binucleate plasma cells cited in the title cannot be confidently identified, and nucleoli cannot be assessed. The density of plasma cells in the surrounding cellular areas supports a plasma cell proliferation, but quantification on a well-spread area and clonality studies are required before a diagnosis of plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are typically fewer, mature and polytypic without sheets or multinucleation.
LPL contains a mixture of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes rather than a near-pure plasma cell population.
Normoblasts have central round nuclei with deep blue cytoplasm and no perinuclear hof, whereas plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with a hof.

65708.recognize_zh: 骨小樑寬厚且形狀不規則、彼此相連，骨髓腔被纖維化、水腫樣的疏鬆基質取代，內有擴張血竇及零星深染的巨核細胞，正常造血幾乎消失；符合原發性骨髓纖維化合併骨硬化。
features: Broad, irregularly shaped lamellar bone trabeculae with scattered osteocytes occupying much of the field
Narrowed intertrabecular spaces replaced by loose fibrotic stroma with a pale, edematous appearance
Scattered dilated sinusoids within the fibrotic marrow
Occasional small clusters of dark hyperchromatic megakaryocytes
Marked depletion of normal hematopoietic elements
65708.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy at low power shows thickened, irregular and interconnected bony trabeculae with a corresponding reduction of the marrow space. The intertrabecular areas are replaced by loose fibrous stroma with dilated sinusoids, scattered hyperchromatic megakaryocytes, and markedly diminished hematopoiesis. Reticulin and trichrome staining are needed to grade fibrosis. In the clinical setting of pancytopenia and massive splenomegaly, findings are consistent with fibrotic-stage primary myelofibrosis with osteosclerosis.

ddx.dx: Post-polycythemia vera or post-essential thrombocythemia myelofibrosis
ddx.vs: Histology is indistinguishable from fibrotic PMF and separation depends on documented prior PV or ET.
MDS with fibrosis shows dysplastic small hypolobated megakaryocytes and multilineage dysplasia, usually without marked osteosclerosis or massive splenomegaly.
Osteoblastic metastases contain cohesive epithelial cell nests highlighted by keratin immunostaining.
Renal osteodystrophy shows paratrabecular fibrosis with prominent osteoclastic resorption and lacks clustered atypical megakaryocytes.

exam.answer_en: Primary myelofibrosis, fibrotic stage with osteosclerosis — thickened interconnected trabeculae, fibrotic marrow with dilated sinusoids and atypical megakaryocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍切片考官會指骨小樑問「為什麼這麼粗」（osteosclerosis），再指竇內或成簇深染巨核細胞；下一步要做 reticulin/trichrome 評 MF grade。
分子：JAK2 V617F 約半數以上，CALR 約 25–30%，MPL 少數；三者皆陰性（triple-negative）預後較差，ASXL1 等高風險突變亦影響預後。
周邊血典型為 leukoerythroblastic picture（有核紅血球、早期顆粒球）加 teardrop cells（dacrocytes），臨床多伴巨脾與髓外造血；骨髓抽吸常 dry tap。
overt PMF 主要診斷條件包含：巨核細胞增生與異型並伴 reticulin/collagen fibrosis grade ≥2、驅動突變或其他克隆標記、並排除其他髓系腫瘤；唯一可能治癒為 allo-HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 post-PV/post-ET myelofibrosis 或 MDS with fibrosis 混淆：前者組織學相同需靠病史；MDS with fibrosis 為小型低分葉發育不良巨核細胞，較少明顯骨硬化與巨脾。

quiz.q: 這張骨髓切片骨小樑增厚、骨髓腔纖維化，確認纖維化程度下一步要做什麼特殊染色？
quiz.a: Reticulin（銀染）與 trichrome（collagen）染色，評 MF grade

65836.recognize_zh: 中央一顆大型巨噬細胞，細胞質泡沫狀且帶紫紅色顆粒，內含一顆被透明空泡包圍的小淋巴球/有核細胞、一顆較大的有核細胞以及核碎片，即吞噬血球現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant foamy, finely vacuolated pale cytoplasm containing scattered pink-red granules
Engulfed small round dark nucleated cell (lymphocyte or erythroblast) surrounded by a clear phagocytic halo
Additional ingested larger nucleated cell and nuclear debris within the cytoplasm
Histiocyte nucleus not clearly identified separately from the ingested cells in this plane
Background of red cells, a myelocyte-like granulocyte and small lymphocytes; smear is thick with some drying artifact
65836.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant foamy vacuolated cytoplasm that contains an engulfed small nucleated cell surrounded by a clear halo, a second larger ingested nucleated cell and fragments of nuclear debris. The surrounding marrow shows red cells, granulocytic precursors and scattered small lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis. Hemophagocytosis alone is not diagnostic of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis and must be interpreted with clinical and laboratory criteria; in this patient it occurs in the setting of Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Tingible body macrophage with apoptotic debris
ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear fragments rather than intact whole hematopoietic cells in phagocytic vacuoles.
Emperipolesis shows intact cells moving within the cytoplasm without phagocytic vacuoles, typically in Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes or megakaryocytes.
Megakaryocytes have a large multilobated nucleus and granular cytoplasm, with passenger cells not enclosed in digestive vacuoles.
Storage histiocytes have cytoplasm filled with lipid or ceroid material without ingested nucleated cells.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis in bone marrow — macrophage containing engulfed intact nucleated cells within phagocytic vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：指這顆巨噬細胞問「裡面吃了什麼、代表什麼」：看到被完整吞入、周圍有空泡暈的有核細胞或紅血球才算 hemophagocytosis。
HLH-2004 需 8 項中 ≥5 項：發燒、脾腫大、≥2 系血球低下、高三酸甘油酯和/或低纖維蛋白原、組織吞噬血球、NK 活性低或缺、ferritin ≥500 ng/mL、sCD25 升高。
Hemophagocytosis 既非必要也不充分：可見於輸血後、感染、敗血症；診斷 HLH 靠整體條件，成人可用 HScore 評估。
成人 HLH 要找誘因：淋巴瘤（含 Hodgkin、T/NK 淋巴瘤）、EBV 感染、自體免疫（MAS）；家族性 HLH 與 PRF1、UNC13D、STX11 等基因相關，治療以 etoposide/dexamethasone 並處理誘因。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 tingible body macrophage 或 emperipolesis：前者吞的是凋亡核碎片而非完整細胞；emperipolesis 是完整活細胞在細胞質內穿行、無吞噬空泡，常見於巨核細胞或 Rosai-Dorfman。

quiz.q: 中央這顆細胞內含被空泡包圍的完整有核細胞，此現象叫什麼？它是否足以單獨診斷 HLH？
quiz.a: Hemophagocytosis；不足以單獨診斷，需符合 HLH-2004 等綜合條件

65772.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液抹片中出現大量大型異常細胞，細胞質佈滿粉紫色顆粒，多數核呈雙葉、腎形或折疊狀（butterfly/bilobed nuclei），這是異常前骨髓細胞（abnormal promyelocyte）的典型外觀，提示 APL 中樞神經復發。
features: Numerous large atypical cells, 2-3 times the size of red cells, in a cytocentrifuge CSF preparation
Moderate N:C ratio with folded, reniform, or bilobed (butterfly-shaped) nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this magnification
Abundant cytoplasm packed with fine to coarse purple-pink azurophilic granules, some granules overlying the nucleus
Occasional cells with cytoplasmic vacuoles; a single small mature lymphocyte for size comparison
Background of scattered red cells without significant inflammatory cells
65772.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows a markedly cellular specimen composed predominantly of large atypical myeloid cells. The cells have folded, reniform to bilobed (butterfly-shaped) nuclei with fine chromatin and abundant cytoplasm filled with prominent azurophilic granules. Rare small lymphocytes and red cells are present in the background; Auer rod bundles are not clearly identified in this field. Findings are consistent with CNS (extramedullary) involvement by acute promyelocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: The variant shows bilobed nuclei but sparse or invisible granules, whereas these cells are overtly hypergranular.
Monoblasts and promonocytes have folded nuclei but grey-blue cytoplasm with fine sparse granules and are strongly NSE positive rather than packed with coarse azurophilic granules.
Blood contamination brings mature segmented neutrophils in proportion to red cells, not a monotonous population of large granular immature cells.

ddx.dx: Leukemic meningitis from AML with maturation
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have round nuclei, visible nucleoli and fewer granules; PML::RARA testing or PML nuclear body immunofluorescence confirms APL.

65324.recognize_zh: 淋巴結低倍可見被膜明顯纖維化增厚；高倍有大量漿細胞浸潤，並環繞血管形成同心圓狀袖套，血管壁增厚、管腔狹窄（閉塞性動脈炎樣）；梅毒螺旋體免疫染色見大量紅色螺旋狀菌體，符合梅毒性淋巴結炎。
features: Panel A: matted lymph node with thick fibrotic capsule and surrounding dense fibrosis
Panel B: dense plasma cell-rich infiltrate with admixed histiocytes in fibrous stroma
Panel C: small vessel with thickened wall and narrowed lumen surrounded by concentric perivascular plasma cell cuffing
Panel D: Treponema pallidum IHC shows numerous red-staining organisms concentrated in perivascular areas
Panel D inset: organisms have thin spiral (corkscrew) morphology
65324.describe_en: Composite figure. Lymph node biopsy shows matted nodal tissue with marked capsular and pericapsular fibrosis. At higher power there is a dense plasma cell-rich infiltrate with histiocytes, and small vessels show endothelial swelling, mural thickening and concentric perivascular cuffing by plasma cells, in keeping with obliterative vasculitis. Treponema pallidum immunohistochemistry highlights numerous spiral organisms distributed in aggregates and around vessels. Findings are consistent with syphilitic lymphadenitis; serologic confirmation is recommended.

ddx.vs: IgG4-related disease shows plasma cell-rich fibrosis with increased IgG4+ cells and obliterative phlebitis but no treponemes on T. pallidum IHC.
Castleman disease shows interfollicular sheets of plasma cells with regressed follicles and no spirochetes or obliterative arteritis.
These show well-formed granulomas with necrosis and organisms on AFB or GMS stains, which were negative here.
Neoplastic plasma cells show light-chain restriction on kappa/lambda ISH, whereas syphilitic plasma cells are polytypic.

65196.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血組織被大片淡染、細胞質豐富呈灰藍泡沫/顆粒狀的巨噬細胞取代，缺乏典型壞死性肉芽腫；抗酸染色（Ziehl-Neelsen）可見巨噬細胞內塞滿大量紅色、彎曲且較長的桿菌，符合非典型分枝桿菌感染。
features: Bone marrow core with extensive sheet-like infiltrate of large histiocytes replacing hematopoietic tissue, adjacent fat spaces
Histiocytes with abundant pale gray-blue, finely granular/striated cytoplasm and bland oval nuclei; no well-formed epithelioid granulomas, caseation or giant cells
Scattered residual lymphocytes, plasma cells and hematopoietic cells between histiocytes
Ziehl-Neelsen stain: macrophages packed with innumerable magenta acid-fast bacilli, many long and curved, forming dense intracellular bundles
65196.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate of large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm replacing much of the hematopoietic marrow. Well-formed epithelioid granulomas, necrosis and multinucleated giant cells are not identified. Ziehl-Neelsen stain demonstrates macrophages laden with innumerable acid-fast bacilli, many of which are elongated and curved. Findings are consistent with disseminated mycobacterial infection of the marrow, morphologically favoring atypical (nontuberculous) mycobacteria in an immunocompromised host; culture or molecular speciation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Typical TB in immunocompetent hosts forms epithelioid granulomas with caseous necrosis and scant bacilli, whereas here there are sheets of macrophages with enormous bacillary loads; speciation requires culture/PCR.
Gaucher cells show 'crinkled tissue-paper' cytoplasm that is PAS positive but acid-fast negative, whereas these histiocytes are stuffed with acid-fast bacilli.
These show small intracellular yeasts or amastigotes (GMS/Giemsa positive) rather than rod-shaped acid-fast bacilli.
Whipple macrophages contain PAS-positive diastase-resistant material but are not acid-fast, unlike mycobacteria.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated (likely nontuberculous) mycobacterial infection of marrow — sheets of histiocytes without granulomas, packed with ZN-positive bacilli
pearls_zh: 考法：H&E 見大片淡染組織球取代造血組織、無典型肉芽腫，再給 ZN 染色問病原；答 acid-fast bacilli（mycobacteria），多見於免疫低下宿主。
台灣與東南亞：成人 anti-interferon-γ autoantibody 免疫缺陷常以播散性 NTM（如 M. avium complex、M. abscessus）合併骨髓侵犯表現。
送檢：務必保留無菌骨髓抽吸液做 mycobacterial culture 與 PCR 定種；切片以 ZN 或 Fite 抗酸染色補充。
免疫低下者肉芽腫形成差，常只見滿載菌體的組織球，不能因無 caseation 或 giant cell 就排除分枝桿菌感染。
exam.pitfall_zh: 大片紋狀細胞質組織球常被誤認為 Gaucher 或 pseudo-Gaucher cell；務必做 ZN 染色，Gaucher cell 為 PAS 陽性但抗酸陰性。

quiz.q: 此骨髓組織球內的紅色桿菌以何種染色呈現？為何未見典型乾酪性肉芽腫？
quiz.a: Ziehl-Neelsen 抗酸染色；宿主免疫低下無法形成肉芽腫（常為 NTM 播散感染）。

64940.recognize_zh: 低倍觀察抹片尾端，可見多個大小不一、淡藍色、無結構的球狀沉積物（箭頭），部分團塊周邊包裹著白血球與紅血球，背景紅血球稀疏；抹片尾端大量淡藍色球狀物提示冷凝球蛋白血症。
features: Low-power view of the feathered/tail end of a peripheral smear
Multiple round to irregular pale blue homogeneous globular deposits of varying size (arrow)
Some deposits surrounded by a pink rim or containing trapped leukocytes and red cells
Scattered leukocytes and small red cell clumps along the tail; individual cell morphology not assessable at this power
64940.describe_en: Low-power examination of the tail end of the peripheral blood smear shows multiple pale blue, homogeneous, acellular globular deposits of variable size, some with trapped leukocytes and red cells at their periphery. Scattered leukocytes and small red cell aggregates are present, but cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. The accumulation of pale blue globules at the tail of the smear is suggestive of cryoglobulin precipitation; correlation with warm-collected cryoglobulin testing and a smear from a prewarmed sample is recommended.

ddx.vs: Smudge cells show purple nuclear chromatin remnants, whereas cryoglobulin globules are pale blue and structureless.

ddx.dx: Platelet clumps at the feathered edge
ddx.vs: Platelet clumps are purple granular aggregates, not smooth homogeneous pale blue globules.
Monoclonal proteins cause diffuse bluish background with rouleaux rather than discrete precipitated globules.
Artifacts are refractile, irregular or crystalline and vary with smear technique, whereas cryoglobulin deposits disappear in prewarmed samples.

65068.recognize_zh: A、B 兩張臨床照片顯示四肢廣泛的紅色斑丘疹（麻疹樣皮疹），C 張周邊血抹片可見多顆含橘紅色粗顆粒的嗜酸性球（紅箭頭）與細胞質深藍的反應性淋巴球（綠箭頭），組合起來指向藥物反應伴嗜酸性球增多及全身症狀（DRESS）。
features: Panels A-B: confluent erythematous maculopapular (morbilliform) rash over upper and lower limbs
Panel C: multiple mature eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and coarse orange-red granules (red arrows)
Panel C: reactive lymphocytes, larger than small lymphocytes, with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm (green arrows)
Accompanying segmented neutrophil; eosinophils show no dysplastic features
Red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis; platelets present
65068.describe_en: Composite figure: clinical photographs (A, B) show a diffuse erythematous maculopapular eruption involving the arm and leg. The peripheral blood smear (C) shows leukocytosis with increased mature eosinophils bearing bilobed nuclei and coarse eosinophilic granules, together with reactive lymphocytes having abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Eosinophils appear morphologically mature without hypogranularity or blasts in this field. In the context of recent levetiracetam exposure, fever and lymphadenopathy, the findings are consistent with drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS).

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia or chronic eosinophilic leukemia
ddx.vs: Neoplastic eosinophilia may show dysplastic or immature eosinophils, blasts and clonal markers (PDGFRA/B, FGFR1 rearrangement), and does not resolve after drug withdrawal.
Viral infections produce reactive lymphocytes but typically without marked eosinophilia or a temporal link to a new drug.
Parasitic eosinophilia lacks the drug-associated rash and reactive lymphocytosis and is supported by stool/serology testing.
SJS/TEN shows mucosal involvement, blistering and epidermal detachment, and eosinophilia is not a defining feature.

64492.recognize_zh: 電子顯微鏡下血管腔內可見多個邊界銳利、長方形或多角形的電子緻密沉積，內部有規則平行條紋（晶格狀，藍箭頭），代表結晶化的單株免疫球蛋白或冷球蛋白，而非無定形的免疫複合體。
features: Multiple sharply demarcated rectangular to polygonal electron-dense deposits
Internal organized substructure with regular parallel striations (crystalline lattice)
Deposits located within a capillary lumen/cell cytoplasm-like space bounded by a basement membrane-like layer
Adjacent cellular elements with mitochondria and a vacuole at the periphery
Variable size of crystals, from small fragments to large blocks
64492.describe_en: Transmission electron micrograph at high magnification shows several sharply marginated, rectangular to polygonal electron-dense deposits within a capillary lumen (blue arrows). The deposits have an organized internal substructure composed of regular parallel linear striations, indicating crystalline organization rather than amorphous immune complexes. Surrounding cellular elements are compressed at the periphery. In a patient with CLL, findings are consistent with intraluminal crystalline deposits of monoclonal immunoglobulin (e.g., crystalline cryoglobulin or crystalglobulin), supporting a paraprotein-related glomerulopathy; immunofluorescence for light-chain restriction is required.

ddx.vs: Ordinary immune complexes are granular without organized substructure, whereas these deposits show a sharp geometric outline with a periodic lattice.

Cryoglobulin deposits typically form curved microtubules or annular structures 20-35 nm in diameter, so tubular versus crystalline substructure plus serum cryoglobulin testing separates them from crystalglobulin.
These crystals are located inside proximal tubular cells or histiocytes, not within capillary lumina.
Fibrillary GN has randomly arranged 10-30 nm fibrils and immunotactoid has parallel 30-50 nm microtubules in the mesangium and GBM, rather than solid lattice crystals in lumens.

64620.recognize_zh: 大型巨噬細胞的淡藍泡沫狀細胞質中，同時可見被吞噬的紅血球、一個小而深染的核碎片/細胞殘骸以及多顆深色顆粒狀碎屑，是典型的噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale blue, vacuolated cytoplasm and irregular cell border
Single round-to-oval nucleus with fine chromatin, eccentrically placed
Phagocytosed red cells (pale pink round inclusions) within the cytoplasm
Engulfed nucleated cell/nuclear debris (dense purple round body) and scattered dark granular cellular debris
Background of clumped red cells in a marrow aspirate smear
64620.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant, pale, vacuolated cytoplasm and an eccentric oval nucleus with fine chromatin. The cytoplasm contains phagocytosed erythrocytes, a dense purple round body representing an engulfed nucleated cell or nuclear remnant, and multiple small dark fragments of cellular debris. Findings represent hemophagocytosis, which in the appropriate clinical and laboratory setting supports a diagnosis of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Emperipolesis shows intact viable cells within a large multilobated megakaryocyte, not a mononuclear macrophage with degraded red cells and nuclear debris.
Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear fragments without engulfed red cells or platelets.
Storage histiocytes contain blue-green granules or striated/foamy lipid material rather than recognizable engulfed red cells and nucleated cells.
Siderophages contain coarse blue-black hemosiderin granules (Prussian blue positive) rather than intact red cells.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis — marrow macrophage containing engulfed RBCs, a nucleated cell/nuclear remnant and cellular debris, in the setting of HLH
pearls_zh: 考法：指巨噬細胞內的深紫圓形小體問「被吞的是什麼？」——答被吞噬的有核細胞/核殘骸；吞噬有核細胞（淋巴球、中性球）比單純吞紅血球更具 HLH 意義。
HLH 必考實驗室：ferritin 顯著上升、sCD25 上升、低纖維蛋白原與高三酸甘油酯、NK 細胞活性低下；骨髓噬血在早期可能找不到，可重複取樣。
Primary（家族性）HLH 與 perforin 路徑缺陷有關（PRF1、UNC13D、STX11、STXBP2），也見於 Chédiak-Higashi、Griscelli、XLP 等免疫缺陷。
成人 secondary HLH 必須找惡性腫瘤（尤其 T/NK 細胞淋巴瘤）與 EBV 感染；Taiwan 常見 EBV 相關 HLH。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 tingible body macrophage；後者只含凋亡核碎片、沒有被吞的紅血球或血小板，常見於反應性濾泡或高增生淋巴瘤。

quiz.q: 圖中巨噬細胞內同時有紅血球與深紫色核殘骸，這種現象叫什麼？列出兩個 HLH 相關的實驗室指標。
quiz.a: Hemophagocytosis；ferritin 上升、sCD25 上升（亦可答低纖維蛋白原、高三酸甘油酯、NK 活性低）

64428.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高度細胞性、被小淋巴細胞、漿細胞樣淋巴細胞與漿細胞混合浸潤；CD20/PAX5 陽性的 B 細胞與大量 CD138 陽性漿細胞並存，κ 輕鏈原位雜交限制、cyclin D1 陰性，提示淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤而非單純漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with diffuse interstitial replacement (panel A)
Mixed population of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells (panel B)
Aspirate (panel C): small mature lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells with clumped chromatin and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
CD79a diffusely positive; CD20 and PAX5 mark a large B-cell component (panels D-F)
CD138 highlights numerous plasma cells intermingled with B cells (panel G)
Kappa ISH strongly positive with lambda ISH essentially negative; cyclin D1 negative except endothelial cells (panels H-J)
64428.describe_en: The bone marrow core biopsy is markedly hypercellular and diffusely replaced by an interstitial infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells; the aspirate shows corresponding small lymphoid and plasmacytoid cells. Immunostains show a diffuse CD79a-positive infiltrate composed of CD20+/PAX5+ B cells and numerous CD138+ plasma cells, with kappa light chain restriction by in situ hybridization. Cyclin D1 is negative in the infiltrate. With MYD88 L265P and CXCR4 mutations, findings are consistent with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma with extensive plasmacytic differentiation (IgG-kappa type).

ddx.vs: Myeloma plasma cells are usually CD19-/CD45-/CD56+ without an accompanying monotypic CD20+ B-cell component and lack MYD88 L265P.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL can look identical morphologically but lacks MYD88 L265P in most cases and often shows nodular/sinusoidal patterns; separation is often molecular.
MCL shows monotonous small cleaved cells that are CD5+ and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive, whereas cyclin D1 is negative here.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma with plasmacytoid features
ddx.vs: CLL/SLL is CD5+/CD23+ with proliferation centers and lacks a large monotypic plasma cell component.

64428.stain: H&E; Wright-Giemsa; IHC panel; ISH: kappa, lambda

64364.recognize_zh: 整片紅血球大多失去中央淡染區、表面有多個短而不規則的棘狀突起（棘球形紅血球 spheroacanthocyte），夾雜緻密小球形紅血球與較大偏藍的多染性紅血球，符合藥物（alectinib）引起的溶血。
features: Marked red cell poikilocytosis dominated by dense cells with multiple short, irregular surface projections (spheroacanthocytes/echinocytic forms)
Numerous small dense spherocytes lacking central pallor
Larger, slightly bluish polychromatic red cells indicating reticulocytosis
Rare nucleated or inclusion-bearing red cell; neutrophils morphologically unremarkable
Platelets present and not clumped
64364.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked red cell poikilocytosis. A large proportion of red cells are dense and spherocytic with multiple short, irregularly spaced spicules (spheroacanthocytes), admixed with smooth spherocytes and larger polychromatic cells. Schistocytes are not a prominent feature, and leukocytes and platelets show no significant abnormality in this field. Findings are consistent with a spheroacanthocytic hemolytic anemia with reticulocytosis; in the clinical context of alectinib therapy, a drug-induced red cell membrane injury is favored after exclusion of liver disease and storage/drying artifact.

ddx.vs: Artifactual echinocytes have regular, evenly spaced short projections and are confined to thick or slow-drying areas without spherocytes or polychromasia.

ddx.dx: Spur cell anemia of advanced liver disease
ddx.vs: Spur cells of cirrhosis look similar, so the distinction rests on liver function tests and clinical history rather than morphology.
Hereditary spherocytosis shows smooth spherocytes without spiculated forms, with a positive family history and abnormal EMA binding test.
Congenital acanthocytosis has fewer, longer, irregular spicules on non-dense cells with neurologic findings or low lipoproteins, and lacks brisk reticulocytosis.

64236.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下，骨小樑間多個黏聚的腫瘤細胞巢呈強烈棕色細胞質 PSA 陽性，周圍造血細胞與脂肪細胞為陰性，符合轉移性攝護腺癌侵犯骨髓。
features: Multiple cohesive tumor nests of variable size infiltrating intertrabecular marrow spaces
Strong, diffuse cytoplasmic (brown) PSA staining in tumor cells with some gland-like lumens
Background hematopoietic cells and adipocytes negative
Decalcified bone trabeculae with blue counterstain; low-power view
64236.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow trephine biopsy immunostained for prostate-specific antigen shows several cohesive nests of tumor cells within the intertrabecular spaces, some forming small lumen-like spaces. The tumor cells show strong, diffuse cytoplasmic PSA positivity, whereas the residual hematopoietic marrow and fat are negative. Findings are consistent with metastatic prostatic adenocarcinoma involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Urothelial carcinoma is PSA and NKX3.1 negative and positive for GATA3 and p63.
Non-prostatic adenocarcinomas are PSA negative and express site markers such as CDX2/SATB2, TTF-1, or GATA3.

ddx.dx: High-grade or treatment-related prostatic carcinoma with PSA loss
ddx.vs: Poorly differentiated prostatic cancer may show weak or absent PSA, in which case NKX3.1 and PSMA are more sensitive.

64172.recognize_zh: 肋膜液抹片中可見巨大多核細胞與雙核／三核細胞，細胞質深藍嗜鹼性、核仁明顯，並有核偏位的非典型漿細胞，符合多發性骨髓瘤侵犯肋膜的異常巨大漿細胞。
features: Giant multinucleated cell (top) with several nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Multinucleated (trinucleate) atypical plasma cell with round nuclei, fine chromatin, and distinct nucleoli (right)
Plasma cell with eccentric nucleus and deep blue cytoplasm containing a dense round inclusion with a pale halo (bottom)
Small cells with dense nuclei and background pink-purple proteinaceous material at left
Scattered degenerating cells and debris; red cells scant
64172.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of pleural fluid shows markedly atypical plasma cells, including a giant multinucleated form and a trinucleate cell with prominent nucleoli, both with deeply basophilic cytoplasm. An additional plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus contains a dense round cytoplasmic inclusion of uncertain nature, possibly phagocytosed material or an immunoglobulin inclusion. The background contains proteinaceous material, small lymphoid or degenerating cells, and debris. In a patient with multiple myeloma, findings are consistent with myelomatous pleural effusion; flow cytometry with light chain restriction or CD138 immunocytochemistry is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells show central nuclei, dense perinuclear and pale peripheral cytoplasm with surface blebs, and intercellular windows, and are calretinin/WT1 positive and CD138 light-chain negative.
Adenocarcinoma cells form cohesive three-dimensional clusters with vacuolated cytoplasm and are cytokeratin/claudin-4 positive.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic or anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These contain large blastic cells without a known myeloma history; PBL is often EBER positive and ALCL is CD30 positive with hallmark kidney-shaped nuclei.
Macrophages have abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm with bean-shaped nuclei rather than deeply basophilic cytoplasm with eccentric nuclei and hof.

64044.recognize_zh: 六個小圖中的嗜中性球大小正常、胞質粉紅帶細顆粒，但核只有單一圓形/卵圓形或對稱雙葉，染色質明顯粗糙凝集，呈現假性 Pelger-Huët 異常（pseudo-Pelger-Huët anomaly）；配合移植後用藥史指向藥物引起。
features: Normal-sized neutrophils with pink cytoplasm and fine neutrophilic granules
Nuclei non-lobated (round/ovoid, monolobated) or bilobed/dumbbell-shaped rather than 3-5 lobes
Coarsely clumped, mature-appearing nuclear chromatin despite hypolobation
No obvious cytoplasmic hypogranulation or toxic changes in these cells
Background red cells with crenation; figure composite of six high-power fields with embedded legend
64044.describe_en: Composite peripheral blood smear (Wright stain, high power, panels A-F) shows neutrophils of normal size with pink, finely granular cytoplasm but abnormal nuclear segmentation, including monolobated cells with a single round to ovoid nucleus and bilobed dumbbell-shaped forms. Chromatin is coarsely clumped, indicating nuclear maturity despite hypolobation, which distinguishes these cells from myelocytes. Cytoplasmic granulation appears preserved. Findings are consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huët anomaly, which in this post-transplant patient receiving mycophenolate mofetil and ganciclovir is compatible with a drug effect, although myelodysplasia must be excluded clinically.

ddx.vs: The inherited LBR-related form affects nearly all neutrophils with uniform bilobed spectacle-shaped nuclei, normal counts and a family history, whereas acquired forms involve a subset of cells and resolve on drug withdrawal.
MDS often shows pseudo-Pelger cells with cytoplasmic hypogranulation, other dysplastic lineages and cytogenetic abnormalities, requiring marrow examination to separate it from drug effect.
Immature granulocytes have finer, less condensed chromatin and more basophilic cytoplasm with primary granules, unlike the densely clumped chromatin of pseudo-Pelger neutrophils.
Bands have an elongated, curved, sausage-shaped nucleus of uniform width, not a round or symmetric dumbbell nucleus.

exam.answer_en: Drug-induced pseudo-Pelger-Huët anomaly (mycophenolate/ganciclovir) — mono/bilobed neutrophils with coarsely clumped chromatin
pearls_zh: 考法：指著單葉或啞鈴狀雙葉的嗜中性球，問是什麼異常；答 pseudo-Pelger-Huët，並強調染色質粗糙凝集代表成熟細胞，不是 myelocyte 或 band。
後天原因要會列：MDS/AML 等骨髓發育不良、藥物（如 mycophenolate mofetil、ganciclovir 等免疫抑制/抗病毒藥）；藥物性者停藥或換藥後可恢復。
先天 Pelger-Huët anomaly 為 LBR 基因異常、體染色體顯性、良性；幾乎所有嗜中性球均受影響且家族成員有同樣表現，顆粒正常、無血球低下。
移植後病人出現此變化合併血球低下時，需檢視用藥史並追蹤停藥後抹片；若持續或合併其他系發育不良，應做骨髓檢查排除 MDS。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與左移的 myelocyte/metamyelocyte 或 band 混淆；pseudo-Pelger 的核雖少分葉但染色質高度濃縮、胞質成熟粉紅，且 MDS 型常合併去顆粒化。

quiz.q: 這些嗜中性球的異常名稱為何？在此移植後病人最可能的原因是什麼？
quiz.a: Pseudo-Pelger-Huët anomaly；藥物引起（mycophenolate mofetil、ganciclovir）

63916.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片四格免疫染色中，間質性浸潤的腫瘤細胞同時呈 CD56、CD123、CD4 與 TCL1 陽性，而右側一團結節狀淋巴聚集則為 CD123 與 TCL1 陰性；CD4＋CD56＋CD123＋TCL1＋ 的組合是 BPDCN 的典型表現。
features: CD56: membranous staining of an interstitial infiltrate between fat cells
CD123: strong diffuse staining of the same interstitial population; a nodular aggregate (upper right) is negative
CD4: weaker but diffuse staining of the infiltrate
TCL1: strong staining of the infiltrate, sparing the nodular lymphoid-appearing aggregate
Marrow with interstitial and patchy distribution among preserved fat
63916.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stains on the bone marrow core biopsy highlight an interstitial to patchy infiltrate of neoplastic cells between adipocytes. The infiltrate is positive for CD56, CD123 (strong), CD4 (weaker) and TCL1, while a well-circumscribed nodular aggregate is negative for CD123 and TCL1. Co-expression of CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCL1 establishes plasmacytoid dendritic cell differentiation, pending exclusion of myeloid (MPO, lysozyme, CD34) and lymphoid markers. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with CD56 or CD123 expression
ddx.vs: AML typically expresses MPO, lysozyme, CD34 or CD117 and is TCL1-negative, whereas this infiltrate is TCL1-positive with the full CD4/CD56/CD123 profile.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation associated with myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Reactive or MDS/CMML-associated pDC nodules are CD123/TCL1-positive but CD56-negative and small, not a diffuse CD56-positive blastic infiltrate.
NK/T-cell lymphoma is CD56-positive but CD123- and TCL1-negative and EBER-positive.
Monocytic blasts are CD4-positive but usually CD123-dim, TCL1-negative and positive for CD11c, CD163 or lysozyme.

63852.recognize_zh: 這是 HPLC 層析圖：除了 2.43 分鐘的 HbA（Ao 60.6%）外，在 4.03 分鐘的 D-window 出現 30.8% 的變異峰，HbA2 0.7%、HbF 0.8% 不高；單一 D 窗峰約三成加上大量 HbA，符合父親為 HbD（如 HbD-Punjab）帶因者。
features: Cation-exchange HPLC report with peak table and chromatogram (retention time 0-6 min)
Dominant Ao (HbA) peak at 2.43 min, 60.6% of total area
Sharp variant peak at 4.03 min in the D-window, 30.8%
HbA2 0.7% and HbF 0.8%, not elevated
Small P2 (2.6%) and P3 (3.5%) peaks; no peak in the S or A2/E window beyond baseline
63852.describe_en: Cation-exchange HPLC shows a major HbA peak (60.6%) and a single variant peak eluting at 4.03 minutes in the D-window, comprising 30.8% of total hemoglobin. HbF (0.8%) and HbA2 (0.7%) are not increased, and no S-window or A2/E-window variant is present. The pattern of HbA plus roughly one-third D-window variant indicates heterozygous carriage of a D-window hemoglobin variant, most commonly HbD-Punjab (HbD-Los Angeles), which should be confirmed by alkaline/acid electrophoresis or beta-globin sequencing. Findings are consistent with HbD trait in the father of an index case with HbSD disease.

ddx.vs: HbS elutes later in the S-window (about 4.4-4.5 min) and is sickling-test positive, whereas HbD elutes earlier in the D-window and is sickling-negative.
Several variants co-elute in the D-window and migrate with HbS on alkaline electrophoresis, so separation requires acid electrophoresis (where HbD/G run with HbA) and DNA sequencing.
HbE co-elutes in the A2 window at about 3.6 min with a value of roughly 25-30%, not in the D-window at 4.0 min.

63788.recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的髓腔被成片、粉紅色細胞質豐富的類上皮組織球（epithelioid histiocytes）與淋巴球取代，看不到脂肪與正常三系造血，符合骨髓肉芽腫性發炎。
features: Marrow space effaced by a sheet-like, poorly circumscribed aggregate of cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Cells with elongated to oval, pale nuclei consistent with epithelioid histiocytes, admixed with small lymphocytes
Vague nodular (confluent granuloma) architecture in the upper field
Absence of adipocytes and recognizable normal hematopoiesis in this field
No definite caseous necrosis or multinucleated giant cells at this magnification; adjacent bony trabecula
63788.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low-to-medium power shows the intertrabecular space replaced by a confluent, poorly circumscribed infiltrate of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval nuclei, admixed with small lymphocytes. Adipocytes and normal trilineage hematopoiesis are not seen in this field. Definite caseous necrosis and Langhans giant cells are not appreciated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with granulomatous inflammation; special stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi and cultures are recommended.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma with granulomatous reaction
ddx.vs: Contains scattered large CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells within the histiocyte-rich infiltrate.
Spindle-shaped mast cell aggregates can mimic epithelioid histiocytes but are CD117 and tryptase positive with aberrant CD25.
Tumor cells are cohesive with nuclear atypia and keratin positivity, while epithelioid histiocytes are CD68/CD163 positive.
Small, incidental lesions with lipid vacuoles, usually near lymphoid aggregates, rather than a large confluent infiltrate.

63660.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指漿細胞核偏心、染色質呈車輪狀，細胞質中央偏藍、周邊卻染成桃紅至洋紅色的火焰狀邊緣，為火焰細胞（flame cell）；左側另見一塊洋紅色細胞質碎片。
features: Large plasma cell with round, eccentric nucleus and coarse clock-face chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm, basophilic centrally with fuchsia-magenta staining toward frayed margins (flame appearance)
Small perinuclear clear vacuole; a few platelets overlying the cytoplasm
Adjacent detached magenta-staining cytoplasmic fragment
Background red cells; small lymphocyte at upper right
63660.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large plasma cell with an eccentric round nucleus, coarse clock-face chromatin, and abundant cytoplasm that is basophilic centrally with intense fuchsia-magenta staining toward a frayed periphery, imparting a flame appearance; an adjacent magenta cytoplasmic fragment is also present, and a few platelets overlie the cell. Findings are consistent with a flame cell. In the given context of plasma cell myeloma, correlation with plasma cell percentage, clonality, and serum and urine protein studies is required, since flame cells are classically linked to IgA myeloma but are not specific.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells lack the fuchsia peripheral cytoplasm and are polytypic by kappa/lambda studies.
Mott cells have cytoplasm packed with multiple round pale Russell bodies in a grape-like pattern.
Thesaurocytes are large plasma cells with voluminous pale pink cytoplasm rather than a magenta flame-like rim.
Promyelocytes have azurophilic granules, a paranuclear Golgi zone, nucleoli, and are MPO positive, without clock-face chromatin.

exam.answer_en: Flame cell — plasma cell with fuchsia-red frayed cytoplasmic periphery, classically linked to IgA myeloma
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指細胞質周邊呈桃紅火焰狀的漿細胞問名稱與典型關聯；答 flame cell，經典與 IgA 型骨髓瘤相關，但並不特異，反應性漿細胞也可見。
Myeloma 檢查：SPEP、immunofixation、serum free light chain；骨髓漿細胞比例與 CD138 IHC、kappa/lambda 限制性。
WHO/IMWG 診斷：骨髓克隆性漿細胞 ≥10% 或切片證實 plasmacytoma，加上 CRAB 或 SLiM 等 myeloma-defining events。
預後 FISH（CD138 純化）：t(4;14)、t(14;16)、del(17p) 與 1q gain/amplification 為高風險異常。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Mott cell 混淆：Mott cell 細胞質內是多顆淡色圓形 Russell bodies；flame cell 是細胞質周邊呈洋紅色火焰狀染色、沒有球狀包涵體。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指漿細胞的細胞質染色特徵叫什麼？經典上與哪一型免疫球蛋白骨髓瘤相關？
quiz.a: Flame cell（火焰細胞）；IgA myeloma

63596.recognize_zh: 箭頭處的異常前骨髓球胞質中有一束束交錯的粉紫色棒狀 Auer rods（柴束細胞，faggot cell），周圍還有顆粒極多、核呈雙葉或腎形的前骨髓球，是急性前骨髓球白血病（APL）的必考影像。
features: Abnormal promyelocyte with bundles of multiple crisscrossing Auer rods in the cytoplasm (faggot cell)
Folded, reniform to bilobed nucleus with fine chromatin
Neighboring abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules obscuring the nuclear outline
Several cells with bilobed (butterfly-like) or folded nuclei
Background of red cells; no significant maturing granulocytes in this field
63596.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa) shows numerous abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules and folded to bilobed nuclei. One cell contains bundles of multiple Auer rods arranged in a crisscross pattern, characteristic of a faggot cell. Normal granulocytic maturation is not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia (hypergranular type); urgent confirmation of PML::RARA and coagulation work-up for DIC are recommended.

ddx.vs: This AML shows blasts with single slender Auer rods, perinuclear hof and salmon-colored granules with maturation, rather than hypergranular bilobed promyelocytes with bundled Auer rods.
Reactive promyelocytes have round nuclei with Golgi zones, lack Auer rods, and are followed by orderly maturation.
Microgranular APL shows bilobed nuclei with sparse fine granules and rare faggot cells, although it carries the same PML::RARA fusion.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia (hypergranular) — faggot cell with bundles of Auer rods among abnormal promyelocytes
pearls_zh: 考官指含一束束 Auer rods 的細胞問名稱：faggot cell；接著問診斷 APL 與最緊急的處置。
遺傳：t(15;17)(q24.1;q21.2) PML::RARA；變異型如 ZBTB16::RARA 對 ATRA 反應差。可用 FISH、RT-PCR 或 PML 免疫螢光快速確認。
細胞化學 MPO 強陽性；流式常 CD33+、CD13 異質、CD117+、HLA-DR−、CD34− 或弱表現。
急症：DIC 與纖溶亢進造成的出血是早期死因；形態懷疑即應立刻給 ATRA，不必等基因確認，並積極補充血小板與 cryoprecipitate。
非高危險群標準治療為 ATRA 合併 arsenic trioxide；需監測 differentiation syndrome（呼吸窘迫、體重增加、水腫、肺浸潤）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 AML with t(8;21) 的單根細長 Auer rod 或反應性前骨髓球；faggot cell 為多根成束交錯的 Auer rods，APL 細胞核雙葉、HLA-DR 陰性且缺乏正常成熟。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指細胞叫什麼？必須立即確認的融合基因為何？
quiz.a: Faggot cell；PML::RARA [t(15;17)]

63532.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中一大片界線清楚的細胞結節，細胞核卵圓至梭形、細胞質淡而透亮、細胞間有粉紅色纖維化基質，與周圍脂肪髓分隔，符合伴硬化灶的肥大細胞結節（mast cell nodule）。
features: Large compact nodule of monotonous mononuclear cells occupying much of the field amid fat spaces
Round, oval to focally spindled nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale to clear cytoplasm with distinct cell borders in areas (fried-egg-like appearance)
Intervening eosinophilic fibrillary/collagenous stroma consistent with a sclerotic focus
Few admixed normal hematopoietic cells; granules not discernible on H&E
63532.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a large cellular nodule set among adipocytes. The nodule is composed of monotonous mononuclear cells with round to oval and focally spindled nuclei, fine chromatin, and moderate pale to clear cytoplasm, separated by eosinophilic fibrillary to collagenous stroma consistent with sclerosis. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is sparse within the lesion, and cytoplasmic granules cannot be resolved on H&E. Findings are consistent with a neoplastic mast cell nodule with associated sclerosis in systemic mastocytosis; tryptase, CD117, and CD25 immunohistochemistry are needed to confirm the multifocal dense aggregates required for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Hairy cell leukemia also shows fried-egg cells with clear cytoplasm but grows diffusely and expresses CD20, annexin A1, and BRAF V600E rather than tryptase and CD117.
Lymphoid cells have round nuclei with scant cytoplasm and lack the pale spindled cytoplasm and sclerosis, and they stain with CD3 or CD20.
Granulomas consist of epithelioid histiocytes with elongated slipper-shaped nuclei and often giant cells, and are CD68 positive but tryptase negative.
Myelofibrosis shows clusters of atypical megakaryocytes and streaming hematopoiesis in fibrotic stroma rather than a nodule of uniform mast cells.

exam.answer_en: Systemic mastocytosis — compact mast cell nodule with associated sclerosis (fibrotic stroma) in bone marrow biopsy
pearls_zh: 考法：切片見界線清楚、胞質淡透並伴纖維化的結節，問可能診斷與 IHC：tryptase、CD117、CD25。
多灶緻密肥大細胞聚集（每團 ≥15 顆）為 SM 主要標準；需 IHC 證明不是淋巴聚集或肉芽腫。
SM 結節常位於骨小樑旁或血管周圍，伴網狀/膠原纖維化與骨硬化，病灶內常夾雜淋巴球與嗜酸性球。
SM 可合併其他血液腫瘤（SM-AHN），切片需同時評估結節以外骨髓是否有 MDS/MPN 等病變。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為毛狀細胞白血病（fried-egg 外觀）或肉芽腫；HCL 呈瀰漫間質浸潤、CD20+/annexin A1+，SM 為緊密結節伴纖維化，tryptase 與 CD117 陽性。

quiz.q: 要確認此結節由肥大細胞組成，第一線 IHC 為何？
quiz.a: Tryptase 與 CD117（再加 CD25 看異常表現）

63468.recognize_zh: 周邊血片中央有一顆比嗜中性球大很多的細胞，細胞核不規則折疊、染色質較粗，灰藍色細胞質豐富且充滿大小不一的空泡，細胞邊緣呈不規則突起，這樣的形態符合循環中的組織球（histiocyte）。
features: Large cell, roughly two to three times the diameter of adjacent neutrophils
Irregular, folded to reniform eccentric nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with numerous small vacuoles and fine granules
Irregular, frayed cytoplasmic borders
No definite phagocytosed cells or organisms visible
Background with neutrophils, numerous platelets, and unremarkable red cells
63468.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large mononuclear cell with an irregular, folded eccentric nucleus and abundant grey-blue, extensively vacuolated cytoplasm with irregular borders. No ingested red cells, leukocytes, or organisms are identified within this cell. Adjacent neutrophils and platelets appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a circulating histiocyte/macrophage, which can be seen in severe infection, hemophagocytic states, or after intravascular stress, and should prompt review for intracellular organisms or phagocytosed cells.

ddx.vs: Monocytes are smaller with fine lacy chromatin and grey cytoplasm with fewer vacuoles, whereas histiocytes are larger with more abundant cytoplasm and frayed borders; distinction is often imprecise on blood smears.
Blasts have fine open chromatin with nucleoli, and are typically numerous rather than a single isolated mature-appearing cell.

ddx.dx: Endothelial cell or other circulating non-hematopoietic cell
ddx.vs: Endothelial cells are elongated with oval nuclei and scant non-vacuolated cytoplasm and often appear in clusters.

63404.recognize_zh: 肝臟針刺切片的 CD71 免疫染色中，淡色的肝細胞板背景下，散佈許多深棕色陽性的小細胞團，位於肝竇內並呈點狀或串狀分布，代表肝內的紅血球系造血島，符合髓外造血（extramedullary hematopoiesis）。
features: Liver core biopsy with background hepatocyte plates showing only faint staining
Numerous discrete clusters of strongly CD71-positive cells within sinusoids
Positive cells form small round clusters and linear cords along the sinusoidal pattern
Larger confluent positive aggregates toward the lower left of the core
Distribution throughout the lobule without mass-forming lesion
63404.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD71 on a liver core biopsy shows numerous small clusters and cords of strongly positive cells distributed within the sinusoids throughout the parenchyma, while the hepatocytes are essentially negative. The positive cells correspond to erythroid precursor islands. Findings confirm erythroid extramedullary hematopoiesis in the liver, consistent with the clinical setting of post-polycythemic myelofibrosis.

ddx.dx: Hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma or other sinusoidal lymphoma
ddx.vs: Sinusoidal lymphoma cells are CD3 or CD20 positive and CD71 negative, forming a monotonous rather than erythroid-cluster infiltrate.
Leukemic blasts express CD34/CD117 or MPO rather than CD71 in discrete erythroid islands with admixed megakaryocytes.
Kupffer cells are CD68/CD163 positive and scattered singly rather than forming CD71-positive clusters.

63276.recognize_zh: 四格組圖中，骨髓造血組織被梭形纖維化間質取代，其中散在少數大型、核仁明顯的非典型細胞（1a、1b），CD30 染色使這些大細胞呈膜狀及點狀陽性（1c），網狀纖維染色顯示纖維增加（1d）；纖維化背景中的 CD30+ 大型 RS 細胞是典型何杰金淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓的線索。
features: Figure 1a (H&E, low-medium power): marrow space replaced by a cellular fibrotic stroma with spindled cells and scattered larger atypical cells adjacent to a bony trabecula
Figure 1b (H&E, high power): large cells with irregular hyperchromatic to vesicular nuclei in a mixed background; RS cell nucleoli are only partly resolved due to focus
Figure 1c (CD30 IHC): scattered large cells with membranous and paranuclear dot-like CD30 staining; background small cells negative
Figure 1d (reticulin stain): increased network of reticulin fibers with intersections, consistent with increased fibrosis (grade II)
Normal hematopoietic elements are sparse in the fibrotic areas
63276.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows marrow spaces extensively replaced by a fibrotic, spindle-cell-rich stroma containing scattered large atypical mononuclear and occasionally multinucleated cells within a mixed inflammatory background. Immunohistochemistry for CD30 highlights these large cells with membranous and Golgi-type staining, while the background cells are negative. Reticulin stain demonstrates a diffuse increase in reticulin fibers with intersections, consistent with grade II fibrosis. Focus and image resolution limit assessment of nucleolar detail in the H&E panels. Findings are consistent with involvement of the bone marrow by classic Hodgkin lymphoma; CD15, PAX5 (weak) and CD45 staining would further support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: ALCL cells are strongly CD30-positive but form cohesive sheets or sinusoidal clusters of hallmark cells and are T-cell/ALK-positive, lacking PAX5 and CD15.
Shows reticulin fibrosis with clustered bizarre megakaryocytes that are CD61-positive and CD30-negative, rather than CD30+ RS cells.
Large cells are strongly CD20/PAX5-positive and CD30/CD15-negative within a T-cell and histiocyte-rich background.
Tumor cells form cohesive nests that are cytokeratin-positive and CD30-negative (except embryonal carcinoma).

63212.recognize_zh: A、B 圖 H&E 可見成片組織細胞，胞質豐富、嗜伊紅、呈顆粒至纖維狀，間夾小型成熟漿細胞；C 圖 CD68 標出成片組織細胞，D 圖原位雜交顯示組織細胞與漿細胞都是 kappa 陽性、lambda（插圖）陰性，符合結晶貯積組織細胞症。
features: Sheets of large polygonal histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic, granular to fibrillar cytoplasm effacing the core (A, B)
Small bland histiocyte nuclei with interspersed small mature plasma cells with eccentric nuclei (B)
CD68 immunostain strongly highlights histiocytic sheets separated by CD68-negative plasma cells (C)
Kappa ISH positive in plasma cells (arrowhead) and histiocyte cytoplasm (arrow); lambda negative (inset) (D)
Discrete crystals are subtle at this magnification; no sheets of atypical plasma cells evident
63212.describe_en: Core biopsy of a sternal mass shows diffuse sheets of large histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic, granular to fibrillar cytoplasm (A), with small bland nuclei and scattered interspersed small mature plasma cells (B). CD68 highlights the histiocytic sheets, separated by CD68-negative plasma cells (C). Kappa in situ hybridization is positive in both the plasma cells and the cytoplasm of the histiocytes, with lambda negative (D, inset), indicating monotypic kappa immunoglobulin stored within histiocytes. Individual crystals are not well resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with kappa-restricted crystal-storing histiocytosis; evaluation for an underlying plasma cell neoplasm, lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma or monoclonal gammopathy is required.

ddx.vs: Granular cell tumor is S100/SOX10 positive and rhabdomyoma is desmin/myogenin positive, and neither contains CD68-positive histiocytes with light-chain-restricted stored immunoglobulin.
Organism-laden histiocytes are foamy or striated with acid-fast/PAS-positive bacilli and show no monotypic light-chain staining.
These have wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm (PAS positive, glucocerebroside) rather than eosinophilic crystalline kappa-positive material.
Langerhans cells have grooved folded nuclei with admixed eosinophils and express CD1a/langerin/S100, lacking abundant eosinophilic crystalline cytoplasm.

63148.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴組織內大量擴大的濾泡（A，紅圈），高倍濾泡內由中到大型細胞取代正常生發中心結構（B、C）；免疫染色中濾泡內細胞呈強核陽性（E，符合 MUM1/IRF4）且增生指數高（H），FISH 顯示分離訊號（I，紅綠分開），是 IRF4 重排大 B 細胞淋巴瘤早期的濾泡型分布。
features: A: low-power section of lymphoid tissue with numerous closely packed, expanded follicle-like nodules (red circle marks area magnified)
B-C: follicles populated by medium to large cells with vesicular nuclei, lacking polarization and tingible body macrophages, rimmed by small lymphocytes
D: immunostain negative in follicles with positivity in surrounding mantle/interfollicular cells
E: strong diffuse nuclear positivity within follicular cells (pattern consistent with MUM1/IRF4)
F-G: additional unlabeled immunostains, one largely negative and one with cytoplasmic/membranous positivity in follicles; H: high nuclear proliferation index within follicles
I: interphase FISH with separated red and green signals (break-apart) alongside fused yellow signals, indicating a gene rearrangement
63148.describe_en: Composite figure. Low-power H&E (A) shows lymphoid tissue with numerous expanded follicular nodules, and higher power (B-C) shows follicles effaced by medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin, lacking normal germinal center polarity and tingible body macrophages. Immunostains (D-H; antibody labels not shown on the figure) highlight strong nuclear positivity within the follicular population in a pattern consistent with MUM1/IRF4, with a high proliferation index confined to the nodules, while the surrounding compartment is highlighted by a separate marker. Break-apart FISH (I) shows split red and green signals indicating rearrangement. Findings are consistent with an early follicular (intrafollicular) pattern of large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement; exact stain identities require the original legend.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers show polarization, tingible body macrophages and are MUM1 weak/negative in most centroblasts with BCL2-negative germinal centers and no IRF4 rearrangement.
PTFL shows expanded serpiginous follicles of blastoid cells but is MUM1 negative and lacks IRF4 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma grade 3B / FL with BCL2 rearrangement
ddx.vs: Conventional FL is usually BCL2 positive with t(14;18) and centrocytic background, whereas IRF4-rearranged LBCL is strong MUM1 positive and typically lacks BCL2 rearrangement.
DLBCL NOS shows diffuse sheets without the site/age profile and IRF4 break-apart; FISH for IRF4 is the discriminator.

63148.stain: H&E; IHC (unlabeled, incl. MUM1-pattern); FISH: IRF4

63084.recognize_zh: PET（A）見多處淋巴結與結外高攝取病灶；組織（B）為中小型淋巴細胞瀰漫浸潤，其間散在帶大核仁與空暈的大型 HRS 樣細胞（插圖）；大細胞有膜狀免疫染色（C、D）與點狀 ISH 訊號（E），提示為 ATLL 背景中的 HRS 樣細胞，而非典型霍奇金淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A: FDG-PET maximum intensity projection with multiple hypermetabolic nodal and extranodal lesions
Panel B: diffuse infiltrate of small-to-medium atypical lymphoid cells with scattered large cells
Panel B insets: large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-like cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent eosinophilic nucleoli and perinuclear halo
Panels C-D: membranous and cytoplasmic staining of the large cells with an unlabeled IHC marker, background small cells negative
Panel E: punctate dot-like nuclear/cytoplasmic ISH signals in large cells
Panel F: red chromogenic signal highlighting a cluster of cells (marker not labeled in the image)
63084.describe_en: FDG-PET shows widespread hypermetabolic nodal and extranodal disease. The biopsy demonstrates a diffuse infiltrate of small-to-medium atypical lymphoid cells within which scattered large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-like cells with prominent nucleoli are present. The large cells show membranous staining on immunohistochemistry and punctate signals on in situ hybridization, while the background small cells are largely negative for these markers. The markers are not labeled in the figure, limiting precise interpretation; in the context of the title, the findings support HRS-like cells in adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma associated with HTLV-1 infection, a mimic of classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: In cHL the background is reactive, non-clonal T cells, whereas in ATLL the background small-to-medium cells are atypical clonal CD4+CD25+ HTLV-1-positive T cells.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with HRS-like B cells (including AITL)
ddx.vs: These lack HTLV-1 integration and AITL shows TFH markers (PD1, CXCL13) with expanded FDC meshworks.
ALCL consists of sheets of CD30-strong hallmark cells rather than scattered HRS-like cells in a small-cell background.
EBV+ DLBCL shows EBER in many large B cells with a polyclonal T-cell background and no HTLV-1 serology or clonal integration.

62956.recognize_zh: LEF1 染色中強陽性的核只見於散在或小群聚的小型 T 細胞，而背景大片腫瘤細胞核為陰性或僅極弱染色；LEF1 陰性有助於排除同樣 CD5 陽性的慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL/SLL）。
features: Strong nuclear LEF1 staining limited to scattered and small clusters of small lymphocytes (reactive T cells)
Neoplastic intermediate-sized cells negative or only faintly stained
Dense diffuse sheets of round to slightly irregular nuclei
Positive cells arranged in loose streaks, not in a diffuse pattern
62956.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for LEF1 shows strong nuclear staining in scattered and loosely clustered small background lymphocytes, consistent with reactive T cells. The diffuse population of intermediate-sized neoplastic cells is negative to only faintly stained. Lack of LEF1 expression in a CD5-positive B-cell lymphoma argues against CLL/SLL and, together with cyclin D1 positivity, supports mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL neoplastic B cells show diffuse nuclear LEF1 positivity, whereas MCL cells are LEF1-negative apart from background T cells.
Large cells arising from CLL frequently retain LEF1 expression and are cyclin D1-negative.

ddx.dx: Aggressive B-cell lymphoma with aberrant LEF1
ddx.vs: Some DLBCL and Burkitt lymphomas express LEF1 in large or medium cells, but these lack cyclin D1 and CD5 co-expression.

62892.recognize_zh: 血小板凝集儀報表：ristocetin 1.2 mg/mL 凝集最大達 104%，其餘促效劑（ADP、epinephrine、arachidonic acid）幾乎無凝集、collagen 反應明顯低下；只保留 ristocetin 反應的模式代表 GPIIb/IIIa（αIIbβ3）缺陷，即 Glanzmann 血小板無力症。
features: Ristocetin 1.2 mg/mL tracing (channel 1): full aggregation, maximal amplitude 104%, AUC 522
Ristocetin 0.6 mg/mL: no response (1%)
ADP 10%, epinephrine 1%, arachidonic acid 0%: flat tracings with small shape-change spikes only
Collagen: delayed, partial response with maximal amplitude about 30%
62892.describe_en: This figure is a light transmission aggregometry report displaying six agonist tracings and a numeric summary. Only high-dose ristocetin (1.2 mg/mL) induces full platelet agglutination (maximal aggregation 104%), with no response to low-dose ristocetin. Aggregation to ADP (10%), epinephrine (1%), and arachidonic acid (0%) is essentially absent, and collagen elicits a slow, markedly reduced response (about 30%). This isolated preservation of ristocetin-induced agglutination with failure of agonist-induced aggregation is characteristic of an αIIbβ3 (GPIIb/IIIa) defect, and with normal platelet count and VWF studies, findings are consistent with Glanzmann thrombasthenia; flow cytometry for CD41/CD61 can confirm.

ddx.vs: Ristocetin response is absent while other agonists aggregate normally, with macrothrombocytopenia.

ddx.dx: Type 2B or platelet-type von Willebrand disease
ddx.vs: Shows enhanced aggregation at low-dose ristocetin (0.6 mg/mL), which is absent here.

ddx.dx: Acquired anti-αIIbβ3 effect (GPIIb/IIIa inhibitor drugs or autoantibody)
ddx.vs: Produces an identical aggregometry pattern; distinguished by drug history or acquired onset rather than a lifelong bleeding history.

exam.answer_en: Glanzmann thrombasthenia (αIIbβ3 defect) on aggregometry — only high-dose ristocetin agglutinates; ADP, epinephrine, arachidonic acid absent, collagen markedly reduced
pearls_zh: 考法：看報表數值判讀各促效劑反應，指出唯一正常的是 ristocetin，問診斷與確認檢查（flow CD41/CD61）。
低劑量 ristocetin（約 0.5–0.6 mg/mL）用來找過度反應：type 2B VWD 與 platelet-type VWD 會凝集；本例無反應。
Arachidonic acid 單獨缺乏反應提示 aspirin 效應或 COX 缺陷；本例則所有生理性促效劑都缺乏，指向共同最後路徑 αIIbβ3。
LTA 前需排除藥物（aspirin、P2Y12 inhibitor）與血小板數過低的干擾。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 aspirin 效應：aspirin 主要使 arachidonic acid 反應消失，ADP/epinephrine 僅第二波減弱；Glanzmann 則 ADP 等全部缺乏凝集。

quiz.q: 此報表中哪一個促效劑保有正常反應？確認診斷可用哪兩個 flow cytometry 標記？
quiz.a: Ristocetin（1.2 mg/mL）；CD41 與 CD61

62764.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一個中型淋巴球核呈多葉花瓣狀（flower cell，A），流式顯示 CD7 缺失、CD4 陽性的 T 細胞族群（B）；組織切片在心肌、軟組織與淋巴結內可見糞小桿線蟲（Strongyloides）幼蟲（C–E），符合 HTLV-1 相關 ATLL 合併播散性糞小桿線蟲感染。
features: Medium-sized lymphocyte with deeply lobulated, clover-leaf (flower) nucleus, condensed chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm (A)
Flow cytometry: CD3-positive T-cell population with loss of CD7 (arrowhead) and CD4-positive, CD8-negative phenotype (B)
Slender filariform larva lying between cardiac myocytes (C)
Coiled nematode larva within fibrous/soft tissue with mild inflammatory reaction (D)
Lymph node at low power with a larva (arrowhead, inset) in the capsule/sinus region (E)
62764.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an atypical medium-sized lymphocyte with a markedly lobulated, flower-like nucleus and condensed chromatin. Flow cytometry demonstrates a CD3-positive, CD4-positive, CD8-negative T-cell population with loss of CD7. Tissue sections (heart, soft tissue and lymph node) contain slender nematode larvae with minimal surrounding inflammation, morphologically consistent with Strongyloides stercoralis filariform larvae. Findings are consistent with HTLV-1-associated adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma with disseminated strongyloidiasis (hyperinfection); HTLV-1 serology and CD25 expression support the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform, finely grooved nuclei rather than polylobated flower nuclei, and HTLV-1 is negative.
Prolymphocytes have a visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, usually retain strong CD7, and carry TCL1A rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Reactive atypical lymphocytes with lobulated nuclei
ddx.vs: Reactive cells are polyclonal with preserved pan-T-cell antigens (including CD7) and do not show a clonal CD4+/CD25+ HTLV-1-positive population.

ddx.dx: Other tissue nematodes (e.g., hookworm, Trichinella larvae)
ddx.vs: Trichinella encysts within skeletal myocytes and hookworm larvae do not typically disseminate to heart and lymph nodes in the immunosuppressed; Strongyloides hyperinfection is the classic HTLV-1 association.

exam.answer_en: HTLV-1–associated adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma with disseminated Strongyloides — flower cells, CD4+ CD7-lost T cells, tissue larvae
pearls_zh: 考法：A 圖指多葉花瓣狀核問名稱（flower cell），B 圖問表型（CD3+、CD4+、CD8−、CD7 缺失），C–E 問組織中線蟲（Strongyloides stercoralis）。
ATLL 典型表型：CD4+、CD25+（強）、CD7−，常 CCR4+；確診需 HTLV-1 抗體，必要時證明 HTLV-1 前病毒單株性嵌入。
Shimoyama 分型：acute、lymphoma、chronic、smoldering；acute 型常見高血鈣、溶骨病灶與伺機性感染，預後差。
HTLV-1 會促進 Strongyloides hyperinfection；化療或類固醇前應篩檢糞小桿線蟲並以 ivermectin 治療。
Mogamulizumab（anti-CCR4）用於 ATLL，但移植前使用與 GVHD 風險增加相關。
exam.pitfall_zh: Flower cell 易與 Sézary cell 混淆；Sézary 為腦回狀細溝核、HTLV-1 陰性，ATLL 為多葉花瓣核、HTLV-1 陽性並常 CD25 強表現。

quiz.q: A 圖花瓣狀核的細胞稱什麼？此病與哪一種病毒及哪一種寄生蟲重度感染相關？
quiz.a: Flower cell；HTLV-1；Strongyloides stercoralis

62700.recognize_zh: 淋巴球門控（Lymphs gate）的 CD4 對 CD8 散點圖中，綠色標示的族群數量最多且 CD4 陰性、CD8 陰性至弱陽性，與藍色的 CD4+ 及 CD8 強陽性 T 細胞分開，代表擴增的 NK 細胞族群。
features: Dot plot of CD8-ECD (x) versus CD4-APC750 (y) gated on lymphocytes
Dominant green-painted population is CD4-negative and CD8-negative to dim, far outnumbering T cells
Residual blue T cells form discrete CD4+CD8- and CD4-CD8 bright clusters
Magenta events (other lymphocytes, likely B cells) are CD4/CD8 double-negative
Lineage-defining NK markers (CD3, CD16, CD56, KIRs) are not displayed on this plot
62700.describe_en: Flow cytometry dot plot gated on lymphocytes displays CD8 versus CD4. The largest population (green) is negative for CD4 and negative to dim for CD8, clearly separate from the residual CD4-positive and CD8-bright T cells (blue) and the double-negative magenta events. In the context of the case, the green population represents an expanded NK-cell population that dominates the lymphocyte gate. This plot alone cannot establish NK lineage or clonality, which requires CD3 negativity, CD16/CD56 expression and restricted or aberrant KIR/CD94 expression on other plots. Findings are supportive of an NK-cell lymphocytosis consistent with chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells.

ddx.vs: The expanded population would be surface CD3-positive and usually CD8-bright rather than CD4/CD8 negative-to-dim.
Same CD4/CD8 pattern; reactive NK cells show polyclonal KIR expression and the expansion resolves over time.
Gamma-delta T cells are also CD4/CD8 negative to dim but express surface CD3 and TCR gamma-delta.

62636.recognize_zh: 單核球門控的 FLAER 對 CD14 圖中，箭頭所指的大族群同時 FLAER 陰性與 CD14 陰性（兩者皆為 GPI 錨定），占 94.54%（2,599/2,749），右上方僅少數正常單核球，代表極大的 PNH 克隆。
features: Dot plot of FLAER-FITC (x) versus CD14-PE (y) gated on monocytes
Dominant population (arrow) negative for both FLAER and CD14 within the PNH gate
PNH monocytes 94.54% (2,599 of 2,749 events)
Small residual normal population at upper right expressing FLAER and CD14
Adequate event count for high-sensitivity analysis
62636.describe_en: Flow cytometry dot plot of FLAER versus CD14, gated on monocytes, shows a dominant population (arrow) lacking both FLAER binding and the GPI-anchored antigen CD14, with only a small residual normal population expressing both markers at the upper right. The PNH gate contains 94.54% of monocytes (2,599 of 2,749 events). Loss of FLAER, which binds the GPI anchor itself, together with a second GPI-linked marker, confirms GPI-anchor deficiency. Findings demonstrate a very large PNH clone in monocytes, consistent with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria; the smaller red cell clone reflects selective hemolysis and transfusion of PNH red cells.

ddx.dx: Isolated CD14 loss in immature or abnormal monocytes (e.g., CMML, AML)
ddx.vs: Monocytic neoplasms may lose CD14 but retain FLAER binding.

ddx.dx: Small PNH clone associated with aplastic anemia
ddx.vs: Clone sizes are usually small (often <10%) rather than more than 90% of monocytes.

ddx.dx: Gating artifact with lymphocyte or debris contamination
ddx.vs: Lymphocytes are CD14-negative but FLAER-positive, so they would fall outside the double-negative PNH gate.

exam.answer_en: PNH monocyte flow — FLAER/CD14 double-negative population 94.5% of monocytes, indicating a very large PNH clone
pearls_zh: 考法：看 FLAER 對 CD14 點圖，問哪一群是 PNH 細胞（左下 FLAER−、CD14− 雙陰性）與克隆大小（94.54%）。
FLAER（fluorescent aerolysin）直接結合 GPI anchor 本身；ICSH 高敏感度流式要求白血球須以 FLAER 加一個 GPI 錨定蛋白（單核球 CD14、顆粒球 CD24）雙重缺失判定。
單核球以 CD64 或 CD33 等 lineage marker 設門；結果應與顆粒球 FLAER/CD24 克隆大小對照，兩者一致才可靠。
大克隆（>50%）常伴典型溶血與血栓風險；aplastic anemia／低危 MDS 中的小克隆也需定期追蹤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 單核球 CD14 下降不等於 PNH；CMML、AML 等異常或不成熟單核球可能 CD14 弱，但仍結合 FLAER，必須兩個標記同時缺失才算 PNH。

quiz.q: 單核球 PNH 流式通常用哪兩個標記判定？圖中 PNH 單核球比例？
quiz.a: FLAER 與 CD14；94.54%

62572.recognize_zh: CD79a 免疫染色：大量小 B 淋巴球呈強陽性，而夾雜其中細胞質淡染的大型漿母細胞樣細胞為陰性或僅弱染；大細胞缺乏 B 細胞抗原（CD20、CD79a），與 HHV8 陽性漿母細胞表型相符，支持 germinotropic LPD。
features: Strong CD79a staining of numerous densely packed small B lymphocytes
Scattered and clustered large cells with abundant pale cytoplasm are negative to weak
Negative large cells appear as pale islands within the positive small-cell background
Some large cells show faint cytoplasmic blush only
62572.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD79a shows strong staining of the numerous small B lymphocytes, while the admixed large cells with abundant pale cytoplasm are negative or at most weakly stained, forming pale islands within the positive background. The distribution of negative large cells mirrors that seen on CD20. Absence of CD79a and CD20 in the large cells indicates a plasmablastic phenotype that has lost B-cell program markers. In conjunction with HHV8 LANA-1 and EBER positivity, the findings support HHV8-positive germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma cells are often CD79a positive (weak) with CD20 negativity, form effacing sheets and are HHV8 negative.
MCD plasmablasts are cytoplasmic IgM-lambda positive, scattered in mantle zones and EBV negative.
HRS cells are usually CD79a negative too, but they are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and lie in a mixed inflammatory background without HHV8.

62508.recognize_zh: ZAP-70 免疫染色中，大多數小淋巴球呈中等強度的細胞質與核染色，另有少數染色特別深的細胞（反應性 T 細胞，作為內部正對照），代表 CLL 腫瘤細胞表現 ZAP-70。
features: Diffuse sheet of small, uniform lymphoid cells with round nuclei
Moderate cytoplasmic/nuclear ZAP-70 staining in the majority of neoplastic cells
Scattered cells with stronger, darker staining consistent with background T cells (internal positive control)
A minority of cells negative (blue hematoxylin counterstain only)
62508.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for ZAP-70 on a tissue section involved by a diffuse small lymphoid infiltrate shows moderate staining in the majority of the neoplastic B cells. Scattered cells with more intense staining, consistent with reactive T cells, serve as an internal positive control. Tissue site cannot be determined from this field alone. Findings support ZAP-70 expression by the CLL cells, a feature historically associated with unmutated IGHV and less favorable prognosis; interpretation by immunohistochemistry is semiquantitative and flow cytometry or IGHV sequencing is preferred for prognostication.

ddx.dx: ZAP-70-negative CLL with positive background T cells
ddx.vs: In ZAP-70-negative CLL only scattered T cells stain, whereas here most of the small lymphoid cells show staining comparable to or slightly weaker than the T cells.
A T-cell neoplasm would show uniform strong ZAP-70 with CD3 positivity, whereas CLL cells are CD20 dim, CD5 and CD23 positive with PAX5 expression.

62444.recognize_zh: 中倍下腺窩之間的固有層被大量卵圓到梭形、核細長或腎形、細胞質淡嗜伊紅且邊界不清的單核細胞撐滿，其間散佈帶亮紅顆粒的嗜酸性球；腺窩本身整齊無破壞——提示黏膜肥大細胞浸潤。
features: Lamina propria diffusely expanded by a monotonous population of oval to spindle-shaped cells
Elongated to oval, bland nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Admixed eosinophils with bright red granules scattered through the infiltrate
Evenly spaced crypts with intact goblet cells and no cryptitis or distortion
62444.describe_en: Colonic mucosa (H&E, intermediate power) shows preserved, evenly spaced crypts separated by a lamina propria that is diffusely expanded by a monotonous infiltrate of oval to spindle-shaped cells. These cells have bland elongated nuclei and moderate amounts of pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct borders, and they are admixed with scattered eosinophils. There is no crypt distortion, cryptitis or ulceration. Findings are suggestive of mucosal involvement by mastocytosis and should be confirmed with CD117, tryptase and CD25 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Normal lamina propria contains a mixed population of plasma cells and lymphocytes rather than sheets of monotonous spindled cells with pale cytoplasm.
These spindle cell lesions lack admixed eosinophils and are EMA/claudin-1 or S100-positive while CD117/tryptase-negative.
LCH cells are larger with grooved, reniform nuclei and are CD1a/langerin-positive, although eosinophils are also present.
Eosinophilic colitis has eosinophils as the dominant cell without a background population of spindled CD25-positive mast cells.

62380.recognize_zh: 這是血球計數儀的輸出圖：左下 RBC 體積分布直方圖出現兩個峰，一個約 60 fL（小球性族群）、另一個約 95 fL（正球性族群），代表雙相紅血球（dimorphic）；白血球 DIFF/BASO 散佈圖與血小板分布則無明顯異常。
features: Bimodal RBC volume histogram with peaks at ~60 fL and ~95 fL
Microcytic peak is taller than the normocytic peak
WBC DIFF scattergram shows distinct lymphocyte, monocyte, neutrophil and eosinophil clusters
BASO channel shows only a small basophil cluster
Platelet histogram right-skewed with tail toward larger volumes, without a clear giant platelet or RBC-fragment interference peak
62380.describe_en: Automated hematology analyzer printout shows a bimodal red cell distribution histogram with a dominant microcytic population peaking at approximately 60 fL and a second normocytic population peaking at approximately 95 fL. The leukocyte differential scattergram and basophil channel show well-separated clusters without abnormal populations. The platelet histogram is right-skewed without an obvious interference peak. The dual red cell populations explain the widened RDW, and in a patient receiving iron therapy the findings are consistent with a dimorphic red cell population from treated iron deficiency.

ddx.vs: Transfused normocytic donor cells give a similar bimodal histogram and are distinguished by transfusion history.
Agglutinates create a spurious large-volume peak with falsely low RBC count and high MCHC that corrects on warming.
Sideroblastic anemia also shows two populations but is confirmed by ring sideroblasts on marrow iron stain.

exam.answer_en: Dimorphic red cell population (treated iron deficiency) — bimodal RBC histogram with microcytic (~60 fL) and normocytic (~95 fL) peaks
pearls_zh: 考法：看血球計數儀 RBC histogram 雙峰，問代表什麼：兩群大小不同的紅血球（dimorphic），RDW 會上升，MCV 可能落在正常範圍而掩蓋異常。
雙峰常見原因：iron deficiency 補鐵後新生正球性紅血球、輸血後、sideroblastic anemia、合併缺鐵與 B12/folate 缺乏。
補鐵有效時網狀紅血球約在 1–2 週內上升，之後正球性峰逐漸增加、小球性峰減少；可用 reticulocyte hemoglobin（Ret-He/CHr）追蹤鐵供應。
判讀儀器圖要同時看 WBC scattergram 與 PLT histogram：本圖 WBC 各群分離清楚，PLT 無 RBC 碎片或巨大血小板干擾峰。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 cold agglutinin 造成的假大球性峰誤當 dimorphic：凝集會使 MCHC 假性升高、RBC 數假性下降，加溫後矯正；真正 dimorphic 需抹片上看到兩群紅血球。

quiz.q: 此 RBC 體積分布圖出現兩個峰代表什麼？在補鐵治療中的病人最可能原因為何？
quiz.a: Dimorphic RBC（小球性＋正球性兩群）；補鐵後新生正球性紅血球
