62124.recognize_zh: 生發中心內可見多處淡粉紅色、緻密的無細胞蛋白質樣細胞外基質沉積（對應 IgE 沉積），並散在多核細胞，周圍是小淋巴球，屬 Kimura 病的生發中心變化。
features: Germinal center containing irregular deposits of dense pink acellular proteinaceous extracellular material
Centroblasts and centrocytes arranged between and around the deposits
Scattered multinucleated cells with clustered dark nuclei (polykaryocyte-like)
Surrounding small mature lymphocytes forming the mantle zone
No necrosis or sheets of atypical large cells
62124.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a germinal center containing multiple irregular deposits of dense, eosinophilic, acellular proteinaceous extracellular material. Germinal center cells are arranged around the deposits, and scattered multinucleated cells resembling polykaryocytes are present. The follicle is surrounded by small mature lymphocytes, and no atypical large cell population is identified. The eosinophilic germinal center deposits correspond to IgE deposition on follicular dendritic cells and are consistent with Kimura disease, which is supported by IgE immunostaining.

ddx.vs: Castleman shows hyalinized penetrating vessels in atretic germinal centers with onion-skin mantles rather than extracellular proteinaceous IgE deposits.
Amyloid is waxy and Congo red positive with apple-green birefringence, whereas Kimura deposits are IgE positive and Congo red negative.
ALHE is a dermal vascular lesion with plump epithelioid endothelial cells and usually lacks nodal germinal center IgE deposition.
HIV lymphadenitis may show polykaryocytes and follicle lysis but lacks eosinophilic IgE deposits and peripheral eosinophilia.

62060.recognize_zh: 紅色免疫染色低倍下，大量小至中型陽性細胞均勻瀰漫地散佈於整個視野，沒有形成結節聚集，背景為陰性小淋巴球；這種瀰漫分布提示 NLPHL 已呈瀰漫型變異或需排除進展。
features: Diffuse, fairly even distribution of numerous positive small-to-intermediate cells across the entire field
No nodular aggregation or follicle-like clustering of positive cells
Membranous/cytoplasmic red staining; some slightly larger positive cells with ring-like outlines
Intervening negative small lymphocytes forming the background
Low magnification precludes cytologic assessment; antibody identity not labeled
62060.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (red chromogen, antibody not specified in the image) of lymph node at low power shows numerous positive small-to-intermediate cells distributed diffusely and evenly across the field, set among negative small lymphocytes. There is no nodular clustering of positive cells, and cytologic detail cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The diffuse distribution indicates loss of nodular architecture in this area. In a nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma with suspected progression, this pattern supports a diffuse variant or transformation; interpretation depends on the identity of the marker and correlation with CD20, CD3, PD-1 and CD21 staining.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL shows a diffuse architecture with sparse large B cells and a CD8+ T-cell-predominant background, confirmed by absence of CD21+ meshworks.
DLBCL shows confluent sheets of large CD20+ B cells rather than scattered positive cells separated by negative lymphocytes.
Reactive paracortex has scattered positive immunoblasts but preserves follicles and sinuses, which requires review of the full section architecture.

61996.recognize_zh: 八格免疫染色組合中，大型腫瘤細胞 CD30 強陽性（膜與高基氏體）、p63 強核陽性，而 ALK 陰性，CD3、CD4、CD8、CD20 均陰性（只有少數反應性 T 細胞陽性），CD45 也幾乎陰性；CD30+/ALK−/p63+ 且 T 細胞標記丟失，指向 TP63 重排的 ALK 陰性退行性大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）。
features: Sheets of large pleomorphic tumor cells with vesicular nuclei and moderate cytoplasm
CD30: strong, uniform membranous and Golgi-dot staining in virtually all tumor cells
p63: strong diffuse nuclear staining in tumor cells
ALK: negative
CD3, CD4, CD8 negative in tumor cells (only rare reactive T cells positive) - loss of T-cell antigens (null phenotype)
CD20 negative; CD45 negative to weak
61996.describe_en: Immunohistochemical panel of a lymphoid neoplasm composed of sheets of large pleomorphic cells shows strong, uniform membranous and Golgi CD30 expression and strong diffuse nuclear p63 staining. The tumor cells are negative for ALK, CD20, CD3, CD4 and CD8, with only rare reactive T cells staining, and CD45 is negative to weak. This CD30-positive, ALK-negative null-phenotype immunoprofile with diffuse p63 expression is consistent with ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma and suggestive of TP63 rearrangement, which should be confirmed by FISH.

ddx.vs: ALK-positive ALCL shows nuclear/cytoplasmic ALK staining, which is negative here.
cHL has scattered CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells with PAX5 dim in a mixed inflammatory background rather than cohesive sheets of CD30+ cells.
p63 and weak CD45 can mimic carcinoma; cytokeratin negativity and TCR gene rearrangement or cytotoxic markers support ALCL.
DUSP22-rearranged cases are typically p63 negative and LEF1 positive with a favorable prognosis, whereas diffuse p63 suggests TP63 rearrangement with poor prognosis.

61996.stain: IHC panel: CD45, CD20, CD3, CD4, CD8, CD30, ALK, p63

61868.recognize_zh: 低倍視野中大量紅血球內含細小的環狀或點狀寄生蟲，常一個紅血球內有多個，另見紅血球外的小型蟲體，且沒有瘧色素、裂殖體或配子體，符合巴貝西蟲（Babesia）高寄生率感染。
features: Numerous red cells containing tiny intraerythrocytic ring, dot and pear-shaped forms
Multiple parasites within single red cells in many cells, indicating high parasitemia
Small extracellular parasite forms scattered between red cells (some dots may represent platelets)
No hemozoin pigment, schizonts or gametocytes; infected red cells not enlarged
Tetrad (Maltese cross) forms not resolvable at this magnification
Single neutrophil (band/segmented) in the center of the field
61868.describe_en: Giemsa-stained peripheral blood smear, photographed at low magnification through the eyepiece, shows a high proportion of red cells containing tiny intraerythrocytic ring, dot and pyriform organisms, frequently several within a single red cell. Small extracellular forms are scattered between red cells, although some of these dots could represent platelets. Infected red cells are not enlarged, and there is no hemozoin pigment, schizonts or gametocytes; tetrad forms cannot be resolved at this power. A single neutrophil is present. Findings are consistent with Babesia infection with high parasitemia; confirmation by high-power review for tetrads and PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum also shows multiple small rings per red cell but lacks extracellular forms and tetrads and may show banana-shaped gametocytes, Maurer's clefts or pigment.
Superimposed platelets are granular, often surrounded by a halo and lie in a different focal plane, rather than forming delicate rings with a pale center.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single, solid, round nuclear remnants and Pappenheimer bodies are clustered peripheral granules, neither forming rings or multiple pyriform forms.
Precipitate lies on top of cells and background in varied focal planes and lacks the consistent ring morphology of parasites.

exam.answer_en: Babesiosis with high parasitemia — many RBCs with multiple tiny ring/pyriform forms, extracellular parasites, no pigment
pearls_zh: 考法：問與 P. falciparum 的區分：Babesia 無瘧色素、無配子體與裂殖體，可有紅血球外蟲體與 tetrad（Maltese cross）。
需計算寄生率；高寄生率（常以 >10% 為界）或嚴重溶血、器官功能障礙時考慮 exchange transfusion。
美國主要為 B. microti，經 Ixodes 硬蜱或輸血傳播；無脾、免疫抑制者重症風險高。
治療常用 atovaquone 合併 azithromycin。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤診為 P. falciparum 瘧疾；兩者都有一紅血球多個小環狀體，但 Babesia 無色素、無香蕉形配子體，且有紅血球外蟲體與四聯體。

quiz.q: 要與 P. falciparum 區分，高倍下應找哪個特徵性形態？
quiz.a: Tetrad（Maltese cross）

61804.recognize_zh: 抹片中可見數個核呈腎形、摺疊或分葉的單核球系細胞，細胞質灰藍、帶細小空泡，並伴隨淋巴球；在 GATA2 家族先證者（CMML）的背景下，提示單核球系增生與異常。
features: Medium-to-large monocytoid cells with folded, reniform or lobulated nuclei
Moderately fine chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuolation and scant fine granules
One cell with a round nucleus and pale, finely granular cytoplasm (monocyte/promonocyte range)
Interspersed small mature lymphocytes; clumped red cells and platelet-rich background
61804.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained smear (likely bone marrow aspirate) shows several monocytic cells with folded, reniform and lobulated nuclei, fine to moderately condensed chromatin and abundant grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm, admixed with small lymphocytes. Some monocytic forms have irregular nuclear contours, but unequivocal promonocytes or blasts are not numerous in this field. Blast enumeration and dysplasia assessment require a full differential count. In the clinical context of the GATA2 proband with CMML, findings are consistent with a monocytic proliferation.

ddx.vs: Reactive monocytes are mature and lack dysgranulopoiesis, and the monocytosis is transient without cytopenias or clonal abnormalities.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: AML requires at least 20% blasts plus promonocytes with fine chromatin and nucleoli, whereas this field shows mostly mature-appearing monocytes.
aCML is dominated by dysplastic neutrophils and their precursors with monocytes usually below 10%.

61740.recognize_zh: CD3 免疫染色把背景中大量小型 T 淋巴球染成棕色膜狀，中央一區細胞稀少、僅剩少數陽性細胞；淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫（lymphomatoid granulomatosis）中大多數細胞是反應性 T 細胞，腫瘤性 B 細胞反而是少數。
features: Numerous CD3-positive small to medium T lymphocytes with crisp membranous/cytoplasmic staining
CD3-positive cells form the dominant population of the infiltrate
Interspersed CD3-negative cells, including larger nuclei, likely represent the B-cell/histiocytic component
Central hypocellular zone with only scattered positive cells, possibly early necrosis
Polymorphous, non-sheet-like distribution of T cells
61740.describe_en: Immunohistochemistry for CD3 shows a dense infiltrate composed predominantly of CD3-positive small T lymphocytes with membranous staining. Scattered CD3-negative cells are admixed, and a central hypocellular zone contains only rare positive cells, suggestive of necrosis. The large atypical cells are not highlighted by CD3. In the appropriate context, the T-cell-rich background is consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis, in which the neoplastic EBV-positive B cells are a minority population.

ddx.vs: PTCL shows cytologically atypical CD3-positive cells, often with aberrant antigen loss and clonal TCR, whereas in LYG the large atypical cells are CD20-positive/EBER-positive and the T cells are reactive.
ENKTL is also angiocentric and EBV-positive, but the EBER-positive cells are cytoplasmic CD3-epsilon/CD56-positive rather than CD20-positive B cells.
THRLBCL lacks angiocentricity and necrosis and its scattered large B cells are usually EBER-negative.

61676.recognize_zh: 低倍血片中可見三顆小型成熟樣淋巴球，核圓、染色質粗塊狀、細胞質稀少，其中兩顆的細胞質邊緣有數個清楚的小空泡，符合帶細胞質空泡的慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）細胞；空泡本身不具診斷特異性，需靠免疫表型確認。
features: Three small lymphoid cells, only slightly larger than red cells
High N:C ratio with round to slightly oval nuclei
Dense, coarsely clumped chromatin; nucleoli not seen
Scant pale blue cytoplasm; two cells show a few small, sharply punched-out clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Background normocytic red cells with scattered platelets; no smudge cells in this field
61676.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-intermediate power shows several small mature-appearing lymphocytes among normocytic red cells and adequate platelets. The lymphocytes have round nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin, no visible nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm. Two of the cells contain small, discrete clear cytoplasmic vacuoles. With a supporting immunophenotype (CD5+, CD23+, dim surface light chain), findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with cytoplasmic vacuolation, which is thought to reflect lipid storage.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma cells are often more irregular with notched nuclei and less clumped chromatin, and are distinguished by cyclin D1/SOX11 positivity and CD23 negativity rather than by vacuoles.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with finely stippled chromatin, multiple nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with numerous vacuoles, unlike these small cells with clumped chromatin.

ddx.dx: Lysosomal storage disorder (e.g. Wolman disease, Pompe, Batten disease)
ddx.vs: Storage diseases produce vacuolated lymphocytes in a background of normal lymphocyte counts and clinical stigmata, without a clonal CD5+/CD23+ B-cell population.
Storage-related vacuolation affects neutrophils and monocytes as well as lymphocytes in an aged sample, whereas these vacuoles are restricted to the neoplastic lymphocytes.

61612.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中三個大型芽細胞核圓至卵圓、染色質細緻並可見核仁，胞質中等量呈嗜鹼性且大多無顆粒，其中一個有核旁淡染區，符合 AML 的骨髓芽細胞；CEBPA 突變需分子檢測。
features: Large blasts with round to oval nuclei and high-to-moderate N:C ratio
Finely dispersed chromatin with one or more visible nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm, largely agranular, one cell with a faint perinuclear hof
Smaller blast with scant cytoplasm and cytoplasmic blebs
Background with a large smudged cell (likely megakaryocyte/disrupted cell) and few red cells
61612.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several large blasts with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, visible nucleoli, and moderate amounts of basophilic, largely agranular cytoplasm, one with a faint perinuclear hof. No Auer rods or hypergranular promyelocytes are seen. A large disrupted cell is present in the background. Findings are consistent with myeloblasts of acute myeloid leukemia; subclassification as AML with mutated CEBPA requires molecular testing.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have scantier cytoplasm and less prominent nucleoli, and are MPO-negative with lymphoid flow markers.
Pronormoblasts have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with vacuoles and coarser chromatin, and are CD71/E-cadherin-positive.
Megakaryoblasts often show cytoplasmic blebs and are CD41/CD61-positive; flow or IHC is needed to separate.

61548.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下，上半部骨小樑間的髓腔被淡粉紅、細胞較少且呈纖維化的浸潤病灶取代，與下半部含脂肪與巨核細胞的正常造血組織界線清楚；這種局灶纖維化浸潤是 CHL 侵犯骨髓的典型低倍表現。
features: Upper intertrabecular spaces replaced by a pale, paucicellular fibrotic infiltrate with streaming spindle cells
Scattered small lymphocytes within the fibrotic area; large atypical cells not resolvable at this magnification
Relatively sharp demarcation from residual normocellular trilineage hematopoiesis with fat and megakaryocytes in the lower field
Bony trabeculae intact without obvious remodeling
61548.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy shows patchy replacement of the upper intertrabecular spaces by a pale, paucicellular fibrotic infiltrate with streaming spindle cells and scattered lymphocytes. This is sharply demarcated from residual trilineage hematopoiesis with adipocytes and megakaryocytes in the lower portion. Individual Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells cannot be resolved at this magnification. In a patient with classic Hodgkin lymphoma, this focal fibrotic infiltrate is suggestive of marrow involvement, to be confirmed by high-power identification of HRS cells with CD30/CD15 immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: PMF shows diffuse reticulin fibrosis with clustered atypical megakaryocytes and intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis throughout the core, not a sharply demarcated polymorphous infiltrate with HRS cells.
Metastatic carcinoma forms cohesive epithelial nests within the fibrosis that are cytokeratin-positive.
Mastocytosis forms paratrabecular or perivascular fibrotic aggregates of spindled mast cells with eosinophils that are tryptase and CD117 positive rather than CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells.

ddx.dx: Serous fat atrophy or post-therapy stromal change
ddx.vs: Gelatinous transformation is pale, amorphous and acellular without spindle-cell fibrosis or inflammatory cells.

61484.recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖（karyogram）：染色體依長度、著絲點位置與帶紋排成 1–22 對加上性染色體，此圖可見一條 X 與一條 Y，各對同源染色體帶紋與長度大致一致、marker 欄空白，外觀為正常男性核型 46,XY。
features: G-banded karyogram with chromosomes paired and ordered 1-22 by length, centromere position and banding pattern
Sex chromosomes: one X and one Y, indicating a male karyotype
Homologs appear matched in length and banding at this relatively high band resolution; no obvious deletion, translocation or extra chromosome
Marker (mar) slot empty; total count appears to be 46
Several chromosomes are bent or overlapped, which can obscure subtle rearrangements
61484.describe_en: This is a G-banded karyogram from a cultured bone marrow aspirate, not a morphologic image. Chromosomes are arranged in pairs 1 through 22 by size, centromere position and banding pattern, with one X and one Y chromosome. The homologous pairs appear concordant in length and banding without a visible numerical or structural abnormality, and the marker slot is empty, so this cell appears to be a normal male karyotype, 46,XY. A final report requires analysis of at least 20 metaphases and correlation with morphology, because a normal karyotype does not exclude cryptic abnormalities detectable only by FISH or molecular testing.

61420.recognize_zh: 小腸黏膜固有層被單一型態中等大小淋巴細胞密集浸潤（A、B），免疫染色 CD3+、CD4−、CD8+、CD56+（C–F），流式細胞儀顯示 CD3+CD56+、CD8+ 且 TCRγδ 表現，符合 MEITL；MRI 顯示腦部增強病灶、細胞抹片見同型淋巴細胞，代表中樞神經侵犯。
features: Intestinal mucosa with villi and lamina propria expanded by a dense lymphoid infiltrate extending into epithelium (A)
Monomorphic medium-sized cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin and a rim of pale cytoplasm (B)
IHC: CD3 positive, CD4 negative, CD8 positive, CD56 diffusely positive (C-F)
Brain MRI (G, H): enhancing lesions marked by arrows, including meningeal/temporal foci
Cytospin (I): sheets of monomorphic lymphoid cells
Flow cytometry (J): CD3+CD56+ population, CD8+CD4-, expressing TCR gamma-delta and lacking TCR alpha-beta
61420.describe_en: Composite figure: small intestinal biopsy shows lamina propria expansion by a dense infiltrate of monomorphic medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei and pale cytoplasm, with involvement of the epithelium. Immunohistochemistry shows the neoplastic cells are CD3+, CD4-, CD8+ and CD56+. Brain MRI demonstrates enhancing lesions, and a cytospin preparation shows monomorphic lymphoid cells. Flow cytometry confirms a CD3+CD56+CD8+CD4- T-cell population with gamma-delta T-cell receptor expression. Findings are consistent with monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma with central nervous system involvement.

ddx.vs: EATL shows pleomorphic medium-to-large cells with inflammatory background and is usually CD8-, CD56-, with celiac-type background, unlike the monomorphic CD8+CD56+ cells here.
ENKTL is angiocentric with necrosis and EBER-positive, whereas MEITL is EBV-negative.

ddx.dx: Primary intestinal T-cell lymphoma, NOS / indolent GI T-cell LPD
ddx.vs: Indolent T-cell LPD consists of small bland cells confined to mucosa without epitheliotropism and with a very low Ki-67, and lacks CD56.
HSTCL is gamma-delta and often CD56+ but involves hepatic/splenic/marrow sinusoids rather than forming intestinal epitheliotropic masses.

61420.stain: H&E; IHC: CD3, CD4, CD8, CD56; MRI; flow cytometry

61356.recognize_zh: 右側成片的組織球樣細胞具豐富淡粉紅細胞質，核為卵圓形並有明顯的核溝與摺疊（咖啡豆狀），左側背景有大量嗜酸性球混合淋巴球，這種有核溝的細胞加上嗜酸性球是蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症（LCH）的線索。
features: Sheets of medium to large histiocytoid cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct borders
Oval to reniform nuclei with longitudinal grooves, folds and indentations (coffee-bean appearance)
Fine, pale chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli; minimal nuclear atypia
Adjacent dense infiltrate rich in eosinophils admixed with small lymphocytes
No well-formed granulomas or multinucleated giant cells in this field
61356.describe_en: Section shows sheets of histiocytoid cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval nuclei with prominent grooves and folds, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. An adjacent inflammatory infiltrate is rich in eosinophils with admixed small lymphocytes. Significant cytologic atypia is not seen. Findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis, to be confirmed by CD1a, langerin (CD207) and S100 positivity; BRAF V600E testing (e.g., VE1 immunostain or molecular assay) may be informative.

ddx.vs: Histiocytes have large round nuclei with prominent nucleoli and emperipolesis, are S100+ but CD1a and langerin negative, with plasma cells rather than eosinophils.
Langerhans and interdigitating cells are confined to an expanded paracortex with melanin-laden macrophages, without sinus-filling sheets or eosinophilic microabscesses.
Contains large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells with huge nucleoli that are CD30+/CD15+ rather than bland grooved CD1a+ cells.
Shares CD1a/langerin expression but shows overtly malignant cytology with marked pleomorphism and high mitotic rate.

exam.answer_en: Langerhans cell histiocytosis — sheets of grooved coffee-bean nuclei histiocytoid cells with abundant eosinophils
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指有核溝的組織球樣細胞與旁邊的嗜酸性球，問「診斷？確診標記？」答：LCH；CD1a、langerin（CD207）、S100 陽性。
電顯特徵為 Birbeck granules（網球拍狀），langerin IHC 已大多取代電顯。
分子：MAPK 路徑活化，約半數以上有 BRAF V600E，其次 MAP2K1 突變；目前視為骨髓性腫瘤，BRAF 抑制劑可用於難治病例。
臨床：兒童常見溶骨性病灶（頭骨）、尿崩症（下視丘-垂體侵犯）；侵犯肝、脾、骨髓屬 risk organ，預後較差。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Rosai-Dorfman disease 或伴嗜酸性球的 Hodgkin lymphoma；LCH 細胞核有縱溝、CD1a/langerin 陽性，Rosai-Dorfman 核圓有核仁並有 emperipolesis、CD1a 陰性。

quiz.q: 圖中有核溝的細胞最可能為何？電子顯微鏡下的特徵性構造是？
quiz.a: Langerhans cells（LCH）；Birbeck granules

61292.recognize_zh: 左下為一個小型淋巴球，核深染圓形、周圍一圈深藍色細胞質（反應性、偏漿細胞樣）；右上為較大的淋巴球，核偏心、細胞質較豐富淡染，是大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）；但本圖解析度下嗜天青顆粒不易看清。
features: Bottom-left: small lymphocyte with dense round nucleus and a narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm (reactive/plasmacytoid)
Top-right: larger lymphocyte with eccentric oval nucleus and more abundant pale cytoplasm, consistent with a large granular lymphocyte
Azurophilic granules in the larger lymphocyte not clearly resolved at this magnification
Normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
Numerous platelets, including occasional clumps and a large platelet
61292.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two lymphocytes against a background of normocytic red cells and adequate platelets with occasional clumps. The lower-left cell is a small lymphocyte with a dense round nucleus and a narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, consistent with a reactive, plasmacytoid lymphocyte. The upper-right cell is larger with an eccentric nucleus and more abundant pale cytoplasm, consistent with a large granular lymphocyte, although cytoplasmic azurophilic granules are not well resolved at this magnification. These findings illustrate normal lymphocyte morphologic variants.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells have clock-face chromatin, a distinct perinuclear hof, and more abundant cytoplasm than the plasmacytoid lymphocyte here.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin, and grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm.
T-LGL leukemia requires a sustained LGL count above 2 ×10^9/L with clonal TCR rearrangement, not an isolated LGL.

61228.recognize_zh: 同一黏膜淋巴瘤浸潤區中，許多淋巴樣細胞呈膜狀 CD56 陽性（棕色），強度深淺不一，腺體上皮與角落一個淋巴濾泡樣區域為陰性，支持 NK 細胞表型。
features: Diffuse lymphoid infiltrate expanding the mucosa with residual glands in the upper left
Membranous CD56 staining in a large proportion of infiltrating cells, heterogeneous in intensity (weak to strong)
Positive cells are scattered throughout rather than uniformly strong in every cell
Glandular epithelium and a rounded negative nodular aggregate (right center) are CD56 negative
Small to medium-sized cells; cytologic detail limited on IHC
61228.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD56 on the mucosal biopsy shows membranous staining in a substantial proportion of the infiltrating small to medium lymphoid cells, with variable intensity from weak to strong. Residual glands and a small nodular lymphoid aggregate are negative. In combination with CD3 positivity, loss of CD4/CD5/CD8 and diffuse EBER positivity, the findings support extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type.

ddx.vs: MEITL is also CD56 positive but is EBER negative, typically CD8 positive, and shows marked epitheliotropism.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia is also CD56+ and EBER+ but presents with systemic marrow and blood involvement rather than a localized mucosal mass.
Neoplastic plasma cells may be CD56 positive but have plasmacytoid morphology, are CD3 negative and express CD138 with light-chain restriction.

61164.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片的紅血球背景中，有一條長約數十個紅血球寬度、呈問號狀彎曲的紫色蟲體，為微絲蟲（microfilaria）。
features: Single elongated worm-like larva, many red cell diameters long, coiled into a question-mark shape
Uniformly purple-staining body with a rounded anterior end and tapering tail
Internal nuclear column, sheath and tail nuclei not resolvable at this low magnification
Background of evenly spread red cells; no white cells prominent in this field
61164.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a single long, coiled, worm-like larva with a rounded anterior end and tapering tail among evenly spread red cells. The organism is consistent with a microfilaria. Sheath, nuclear column and tail nuclei cannot be evaluated at this magnification, so species cannot be determined; high-power or thick-film examination (and timing of collection relative to periodicity) is needed to separate Wuchereria bancrofti, Brugia, Loa loa and Mansonella.

ddx.vs: Trypanosomes are only a few red cells long, with an undulating membrane, flagellum and kinetoplast.
Artifacts are refractile, often in a different focal plane, and lack a stained body with internal nuclei and tapered tail.
Borrelia are thin loosely coiled spirochetes about 1-2 red cells long, much smaller and thinner than a microfilaria.

exam.answer_en: Microfilaremia — a long coiled microfilaria among red cells (species not determinable at this low magnification)
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍下問「這條蟲體是什麼？」→ microfilaria；進一步問如何分種，答案是高倍看 sheath 有無與尾端核（tail nuclei）分布，本圖放大倍率不足以分種。
尾端核鑑別：W. bancrofti 有鞘、尾端無核；Brugia malayi 有鞘、尾端有兩顆分離的核；Loa loa 有鞘、核延伸到尾端；Mansonella perstans 無鞘、鈍尾、核到尾端。
採血時機：W. bancrofti 與 Brugia 多為夜間週期性（約晚上 10 點到凌晨 2 點採血），Loa loa 為白天週期性；可用 thick film、Knott concentration 或 membrane filtration 提高偵測。
治療注意：高微絲蚴量的 Loa loa 用 diethylcarbamazine（DEC）或 ivermectin 可誘發腦病變；疑有 onchocerciasis 時 DEC 禁用。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Trypanosoma 或纖維異物混淆：Trypanosoma 僅約 2–3 個紅血球長，有波動膜、鞭毛與 kinetoplast；纖維具折光性、粗細一致、無內部核柱與漸細尾端。

quiz.q: 圖中蟲體為何？若要分辨 W. bancrofti 與 Brugia malayi，應在高倍下觀察哪個部位的特徵？
quiz.a: Microfilaria；尾端核（tail nuclei）分布（並確認有無 sheath）

61100.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見保留的淋巴濾泡與穿入的玻璃樣化小血管（Castleman 樣變化），高倍則在小淋巴球背景中散布帶透明暈的大型細胞（Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg 樣細胞），免疫染色中大型細胞核染色弱、膜/高基氏體區呈陽性。
features: Low power: lymphoid follicle-like nodule with small hyalinized vessels traversing a mantle-like zone of small lymphocytes (Castleman-like architecture)
Scattered large mononuclear cells with abundant clear to pale cytoplasm and retraction halos (lacunar/Hodgkin-like cells)
Background of numerous small mature lymphocytes with interspersed vessels
Nuclear IHC (panel C): strong staining of background small lymphocytes with weak to absent staining in the large cells (pattern suggests dim PAX5 in HRS cells; antibody not labeled)
Membranous/Golgi-type IHC (panel D) highlighting the scattered large cells (pattern typical of CD30 or CD15; antibody not labeled)
61100.describe_en: Lymph node sections show a nodular lymphoid proliferation with small hyalinized vessels penetrating follicle-like structures surrounded by small lymphocytes, reminiscent of hyaline-vascular Castleman disease. At higher power, scattered large cells with clear cytoplasmic halos resembling lacunar/Hodgkin cells are present in a mixed small-lymphocyte background. Immunostains show weak nuclear staining of the large cells relative to strongly positive small B cells, and membranous/Golgi-pattern positivity in the large cells; the specific antibodies are not labeled in the figure. Findings are consistent with classical Hodgkin lymphoma arising in a background of Castleman-like changes.

ddx.vs: Castleman disease lacks CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells with dim PAX5 and loss of CD45; the large atypical cells here argue for superimposed cHL.
LP cells are CD20+/strong PAX5+, CD30-/CD15- with popcorn nuclei and sit in large B-cell nodules rather than showing lacunar halos.
The large cells are strong CD20+/PAX5+ and CD30-/CD15-, set in a T-cell and histiocyte-rich background without follicular dendritic meshworks.
Reactive immunoblasts are CD45+, strong PAX5+/CD20+ and at most variably CD30+, lacking the CD15+/dim PAX5 HRS phenotype.

61036.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 CD23 免疫染色中，陽性濾泡樹突細胞（FDC）網絡不是侷限在圓形濾泡內，而是呈不規則、拉長、破碎的條帶散布於濾泡外的副皮質區，這種濾泡外 FDC 擴張是血管免疫母細胞性 T 細胞淋巴瘤（AITL）的特徵線索。
features: CD23-positive dendritic meshworks with a fine reticular/membranous staining pattern
Meshworks are irregular, elongated and fragmented rather than forming round, well-delimited follicles
Expanded meshworks extend into interfollicular/paracortical areas, often tracking along vessel-like linear structures
Background diffuse lymphoid infiltrate is largely CD23-negative (hematoxylin counterstain)
No intact primary or secondary follicle architecture identifiable at this power
61036.describe_en: Low-power CD23 immunohistochemistry of a lymph node shows a diffuse lymphoid infiltrate without intact follicles. CD23 highlights multiple irregular, expanded and disrupted follicular dendritic cell meshworks that extend beyond follicular boundaries into the interfollicular areas, in places arranged in elongated, perivascular-appearing bands. The atypical lymphoid cells themselves are CD23-negative. In the appropriate context (TFH-marker-positive T-cell infiltrate, high endothelial venule proliferation), this extrafollicular FDC expansion is consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (nodal TFH-cell lymphoma, angioimmunoblastic type).

ddx.vs: Reactive nodes show CD23/CD21 FDC meshworks confined to round, sharply delimited follicles rather than irregular extrafollicular sprawling networks.
PTCL-NOS usually lacks expanded extrafollicular FDC meshworks and does not co-express multiple TFH markers (PD-1, CXCL13, ICOS, BCL6, CD10).
FDC sarcoma forms cohesive sheets/fascicles of spindled-to-ovoid CD21/CD23/CD35-positive tumor cells with nuclear atypia, not delicate dendritic meshworks around a T-cell infiltrate.
CHL may show residual FDC meshworks but contains CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells and lacks a TFH-phenotype T-cell population.

exam.answer_en: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma — CD23 highlights expanded, irregular extrafollicular follicular dendritic cell meshworks
pearls_zh: 考法：只給 CD23 染色，問陽性的是什麼細胞、分布有何異常 → FDC 網絡擴張到濾泡外、形狀不規則且常沿血管分布。
FDC 標記：CD21、CD23、CD35；評估 AITL 的 FDC 擴張最常用 CD21，CD23 亦可。
此發現是 AITL 的支持證據而非單獨診斷依據，需搭配 TFH 標記（PD-1、CXCL13、ICOS）與 TCR 克隆性。
CD23 也會染部分 B 細胞（如 CLL/SLL），判讀時要分辨網狀樹突結構與單顆淋巴細胞膜染色。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為反應性濾泡增生；反應性 FDC 網絡侷限在圓形、邊界清楚的濾泡內，AITL 則不規則擴張到濾泡外。

quiz.q: 此 CD23 染色中陽性的網狀結構是什麼細胞？其濾泡外擴張支持何診斷？
quiz.a: Follicular dendritic cells；angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma

60972.recognize_zh: 腹部皮膚多發紅色至紫紅色、圓頂狀的真皮結節（A、B），切片見真皮內瀰漫浸潤的單一型態不成熟細胞、夾雜在膠原纖維間，插圖 IHC 瀰漫強陽性，合併臨床符合皮膚骨髓肉瘤（myeloid sarcoma）作為 AML 的首發表現。
features: Panels A-B: multiple erythematous-to-violaceous, dome-shaped dermal papules and nodules on the abdomen with a smooth, slightly scaly surface
Panel C: diffuse dermal infiltrate of monotonous immature mononuclear cells dissecting between collagen bundles
Cells medium-sized with round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and scant-to-moderate cytoplasm; scattered apoptotic debris
Inset: diffuse strong cytoplasmic immunostaining of the infiltrate (CD68 per figure legend)
Magnification limits assessment of nucleoli and cytoplasmic granules
60972.describe_en: Clinical photographs show multiple erythematous to violaceous dome-shaped dermal nodules on the abdomen. The skin biopsy demonstrates a diffuse dermal infiltrate of monotonous, medium-sized immature cells with round to irregular nuclei and fine chromatin, splaying collagen bundles, and the inset immunostain shows diffuse strong positivity of the infiltrate. Although a complete panel is required, the morphology with an immunoprofile of CD45, CD43, CD68/CD163 and focal MPO positivity is consistent with myeloid sarcoma with monocytic differentiation, presenting as leukemia cutis.

ddx.vs: Similar violaceous skin nodules, but cells are CD4/CD56/CD123/TCF4-positive and MPO/CD163-negative.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell or lymphoblastic lymphoma of skin
ddx.vs: Infiltrate expresses CD20/PAX5 or TdT with lineage markers and lacks CD68/CD163/lysozyme and MPO.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous Langerhans cell histiocytosis or other histiocytic lesion
ddx.vs: Cells have grooved nuclei with eosinophils and are CD1a/langerin-positive (LCH) or mature histiocytes with low proliferation, unlike immature cells with Ki-67 about 60%.

ddx.dx: Merkel cell carcinoma or other small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: Tumor cells are CD45-negative and express keratin (dot-like CK20) and neuroendocrine markers.

exam.answer_en: Cutaneous myeloid sarcoma (leukemia cutis) as initial AML presentation — diffuse dermal infiltrate of immature cells splaying collagen, myeloid/monocytic IHC
pearls_zh: 考法：臨床照片紅紫色真皮結節加切片中單一型態不成熟細胞「穿插於膠原纖維間」，問診斷 → myeloid sarcoma；追問需要哪些 IHC 證明骨髓系。
常用 IHC：CD43、MPO、lysozyme、CD33、CD117、CD34；monocytic 分化者 CD68（KiM1P/PGM1）、CD163、CD14 陽性而 MPO 可弱或陰性。CD43+ 但 CD3−/CD20− 是警訊。
WHO 與 ICC 將 myeloid sarcoma 視同 AML 處理：即使骨髓尚未達診斷門檻，也應以 AML 型全身性治療，並做骨髓評估與基因檢測。
皮膚侵犯較常見於 monocytic 分化的 AML，並與 NPM1 突變及 KMT2A 重組等相關；需做完整分子檢測以定分類與預後。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤診為淋巴瘤（DLBCL 或 lymphoblastic lymphoma），因 CD43 與 LCA 皆陽性；需加 MPO、lysozyme、CD68/CD163 等；另需排除 BPDCN（CD4/CD56/CD123/TCF4 陽性、MPO 陰性）。

quiz.q: 皮膚切片見圖中穿插於膠原纖維間的單一型態不成熟細胞，若 CD43 陽性但 CD3、CD20 陰性，應想到什麼診斷？再加做哪些標記？
quiz.a: Myeloid sarcoma（AML 皮膚侵犯）；MPO、lysozyme、CD68/CD163、CD33、CD117、CD34

60908.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見小至中型淋巴球，染色質濃縮，細胞質淡藍且邊緣呈不規則、極性分布的短絨毛狀突起（villous lymphocytes），箭頭並標示部分具較多細胞質、偏心核的漿細胞樣淋巴球，符合脾臟邊緣區淋巴瘤的血液表現。
features: Small to medium-sized lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei and condensed chromatin
Pale blue cytoplasm with short, irregular, sometimes polar villous projections
Some cells (solid arrows) are larger with more abundant cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei, suggesting plasmacytoid differentiation
Other cells (dashed arrows) are smaller villous lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm
Background red cells largely unremarkable; no nucleoli or blasts evident
60908.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a population of small to medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with round to slightly indented nuclei, condensed chromatin and moderate pale blue cytoplasm bearing short, irregular villous projections, sometimes concentrated at one pole. Arrows highlight both small villous lymphocytes and larger cells with more abundant cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei with plasmacytoid features. Prominent nucleoli and blasts are not identified. Findings are suggestive of circulating villous lymphocytes of splenic marginal zone lymphoma; flow cytometry is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: HCL cells have circumferential fine hairy projections, oval or bean-shaped nuclei with open chromatin and are CD11c/CD25/CD103/CD123 positive with BRAF V600E, unlike the short polar villi here.
CLL cells are small round lymphocytes with block-like chromatin, scant cytoplasm without villi and smudge cells, and are CD5/CD23 positive.
LPL shows plasmacytoid lymphocytes without villous projections and carries MYD88 L265P in most cases.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and lack clonal light-chain restriction.

exam.answer_en: Splenic marginal zone lymphoma — circulating villous lymphocytes with short polar villi, some plasmacytoid
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指細胞質邊緣有短而偏向一極的絨毛突起的小淋巴球，問「這是什麼細胞？要和哪個疾病區分？」→ villous lymphocyte，SMZL vs hairy cell leukemia。
Flow 表型：CD19+、CD20+，通常 CD5−、CD10−、CD103−，CD25 與 CD11c 可有可無；CD123 陰性、annexin A1 陰性，BRAF V600E 陰性。
骨髓切片典型為竇內（intrasinusoidal）浸潤合併結節；常見 del(7q)，部分病例有 NOTCH2、KLF2 突變。
臨床：脾腫大為主、淋巴結腫不明顯，可伴 small M-protein 或自體免疫血球低下；部分病例與 HCV 相關，抗病毒治療可能使淋巴瘤緩解。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 hairy cell leukemia：HCL 細胞絨毛細長且環繞全周、核卵圓或腎形，flow 為 CD11c/CD25/CD103/CD123 陽性並帶 BRAF V600E；本圖為短而偏極的絨毛。

quiz.q: 圖中帶短極性絨毛的淋巴球，要與 hairy cell leukemia 區分，flow cytometry 最有用的標記組合是？
quiz.a: CD103、CD25、CD11c、CD123（HCL 皆陽性；SMZL 通常 CD103−、CD123−）

60844.recognize_zh: 子宮頸切片下方黏膜被密集淋巴樣細胞浸潤，高倍可見混合的大型活化淋巴球與免疫母細胞；免疫染色（C）呈大片膜狀陽性、EBER 原位雜交（D）見大量散在陽性核，提示 EBV 相關、類似淋巴瘤的反應性病灶。
features: Dense, diffuse lymphoid infiltrate expanding the cervical stroma beneath the surface (low power, panel A)
Polymorphous population of medium-to-large activated lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei and visible nucleoli, admixed with small lymphocytes, plasma cells and apoptotic bodies (panel B)
Immunohistochemistry (panel C) shows many positive cells with membranous staining in clustered zones (marker not labeled in figure)
EBER in situ hybridization (panel D) highlights numerous scattered nuclear-positive cells of varying size
No sheet-like monomorphic large cell population evident at the magnification shown
60844.describe_en: Biopsy of the uterine cervix shows a dense, diffuse lymphoid infiltrate occupying the stroma. At high power the infiltrate is polymorphous, composed of numerous activated immunoblast-like large cells with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli, admixed with small lymphocytes, plasma cells and apoptotic debris. Immunohistochemistry demonstrates many membranous-positive lymphoid cells in aggregates, and EBER in situ hybridization shows abundant scattered EBV-positive nuclei of varying sizes. In the appropriate clinical context (e.g., primary EBV infection with regression), findings are consistent with an EBV-associated reactive lymphoproliferation mimicking lymphoma; clonality studies and follow-up are needed to exclude an EBV-positive lymphoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows sheets of monomorphic atypical large B cells with destructive growth and clonal IG rearrangement, whereas the reactive lesion is polymorphous with EBER positivity across small and large cells and polyclonality.
NK/T-cell lymphoma shows angiocentric necrotizing growth of atypical cytoplasmic CD3+/CD56+ cytotoxic cells that are nearly all EBER-positive, unlike a mixed B/T polymorphous infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma-like lesion of the cervix (non-EBV chronic cervicitis)
ddx.vs: Ordinary florid cervicitis is EBER-negative and usually superficial with well-formed germinal centers.
EBVMCU is a sharply circumscribed ulcer in an immunosuppressed patient with Hodgkin-like CD30+/CD15+ large cells and a peripheral rim of T cells.

captions: A-B: H&E low and high power of dense polymorphous lymphoid infiltrate; C: immunohistochemistry with membranous positivity; D: EBER ISH with numerous positive nuclei

60780.recognize_zh: 複層鱗狀上皮下方與上皮內有密集中型淋巴細胞浸潤，細胞核圓至不規則、染色質細緻如母細胞，並沿上皮底層向上侵犯，連上皮表面也堆積一層腫瘤細胞。
features: Stratified squamous mucosa with a dense subepithelial infiltrate of medium-sized lymphoid cells
Tumor cells have round to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed (blastoid) chromatin, small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm
Infiltrate undermines and permeates the basal epithelium in a pushing, lymphoepithelial pattern
A band of detached tumor cells lies on the epithelial surface (upper right)
Scattered darker, more angulated small cells and apoptotic debris; no epithelioid granulomas or sclerosis
60780.describe_en: Section of squamous mucosa shows a dense, diffuse infiltrate of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells in the lamina propria that undermines and infiltrates the overlying stratified squamous epithelium, with an additional layer of tumor cells deposited on the epithelial surface. The cells have round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed blastoid chromatin, small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. Immunohistochemistry is required for lineage assignment. In conjunction with CD20 and cyclin D1 positivity and a Ki-67 index above 90%, findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid variant, involving mucosa.

ddx.vs: Cytology is nearly identical, so TdT and CD34 positivity with cyclin D1 negativity are needed to distinguish it.
Cells are generally larger with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli and are cyclin D1 negative.

ddx.dx: Poorly differentiated squamous cell or neuroendocrine carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are cohesive, arise from the epithelium and express cytokeratin (plus synaptophysin/chromogranin for neuroendocrine), not CD45/CD20.
Blasts have more eosinophilic cytoplasm with admixed eosinophilic myelocytes and express MPO, CD33, CD117 or lysozyme instead of B-cell markers.

60588.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中的芽細胞細胞質內有圓形、灰藍色均質的大型包涵體（類 Russell 小體），插圖 H&E 下呈嗜酸性圓球；電子顯微鏡可見細胞質內一顆大型、電子密度均勻的圓形包涵體，出現在 Ph 陽性 B 淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Blasts with high to moderate N:C ratio, fine chromatin and pale basophilic cytoplasm
Large, round, homogeneous gray-blue cytoplasmic inclusions (Russell-like bodies), one or more per cell, sometimes indenting the nucleus
Inset H&E: cells with bright eosinophilic globular cytoplasmic inclusions
Electron microscopy: single large round membrane-bound inclusion with homogeneous, finely granular moderately electron-dense content
Background of red cells with scattered lymphoid-appearing blasts
60588.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows blasts with fine chromatin and scant to moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm, several containing large, round, homogeneous gray-blue cytoplasmic inclusions resembling Russell bodies. On the H&E-stained section (inset) these inclusions appear as bright eosinophilic globules. Ultrastructurally the inclusion is a large, round, homogeneous body occupying much of the cytoplasm. In the context of immunophenotypic and genetic confirmation, findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with BCR::ABL1 showing unusual Russell-like cytoplasmic inclusions.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell neoplasm with Russell bodies (Mott cells)
ddx.vs: Mott cells are mature plasma cells with clumped chromatin, CD138 and cytoplasmic light-chain positivity, whereas these are TdT/CD19-positive blasts with fine chromatin.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules are MPO-positive large azurophilic granules in myeloblasts, while Russell-like bodies here are pale, homogeneous and MPO-negative in lymphoblasts.
Phagocytosed red cells or debris are heterogeneous and eosinophilic on Wright stain, not uniform gray-blue globules with homogeneous ultrastructure.

60652.recognize_zh: 體液抹片中大型巨噬細胞之間與細胞內可見大量大小一致的卵圓形酵母樣小體，周圍有清楚的透明環，部分首尾相連成串珠狀（出芽鏈），提示體液中的真菌（酵母菌）感染。
features: Large macrophages/mononuclear cells with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm and oval to reniform nuclei, admixed with neutrophils
Numerous small uniform oval yeast-like organisms (roughly 3–5 µm) with a dark-staining center and a thin clear halo/cell wall
Organisms both intracellular within macrophages and extracellular
Some yeasts attached end to end forming short bead-like chains or budding pairs (panels A, D)
Panels B–C: yeasts clustered around and within individual mononuclear cells; no true septate hyphae seen
60652.describe_en: Cytospin of body fluid shows numerous macrophages with vacuolated cytoplasm and scattered neutrophils. There are abundant small, uniform, oval yeast forms with a clear halo, located both within macrophages and extracellularly, some showing budding and short bead-like chains. No septate hyphae are identified. Findings are consistent with a yeast infection of the body fluid; the chain-forming budding pattern favors Candida species over Histoplasma, and fungal culture with species identification is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are smaller (2–4 µm), predominantly intracellular with narrow-based single budding and do not form chains or pseudohyphae.
Cryptococci vary in size with a thick mucicarminophilic capsule and narrow-based budding rather than uniform small chained yeasts.
Leishmania amastigotes contain a nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack budding or a refractile cell wall.
Ingested red cells are pink and platelets granular, whereas these bodies are uniform, basophilic, walled and budding.

60716.recognize_zh: 周邊血中有大量中型母細胞，染色質細緻、細胞質灰藍色且邊緣有偽足狀突起或「尾巴」，核有時呈凹陷不規則；TCL1 免疫染色強陽性、流式呈 CD4+/CD123 高表現，符合母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤 (BPDCN) 的白血病型。
features: Panel A: numerous medium-sized blasts replacing normal leukocytes, with occasional residual neutrophils
Panels B-D, F-H: blasts with fine immature chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and indented, folded or irregular nuclear contours
Moderate grey-blue agranular cytoplasm with pseudopod-like projections, cytoplasmic blebs and tail-like extensions
Panel E: strong nuclear/cytoplasmic TCL1 positivity in most cells
Panel I: flow cytometry showing a dominant CD4+ / CD123 bright population (88.7%)
60716.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium-sized blasts with fine chromatin, irregular folded nuclei and moderate agranular grey-blue cytoplasm bearing pseudopodia and cytoplasmic tails. Immunohistochemistry demonstrates strong TCL1 expression, and flow cytometry identifies a CD4-positive, bright CD123 population comprising 88.7% of analyzed events. Findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm presenting as an acute leukemic variant in a child.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes are MPO/NSE and CD14/CD11b/lysozyme positive, whereas BPDCN is MPO negative and co-expresses CD4, CD56, CD123, TCL1 and TCF4.
ALL blasts express TdT with CD19/CD22 or cytoplasmic CD3 and lack the CD4/CD123/TCL1 plasmacytoid dendritic phenotype.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation with myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Mature pDCs in CMML-associated proliferations are CD56 negative, CD34 variable and accompanied by a myeloid neoplasm rather than a blastic leukemic population.

exam.answer_en: Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, leukemic presentation — agranular blasts with pseudopodia/tails; CD4+, CD123 bright, TCL1+
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指胞質灰藍無顆粒、帶偽足或尾巴的 blast，配合 flow CD4+/CD123 bright，問「診斷？」→ BPDCN。
表型：CD4+、CD56+（多數）、CD123 強陽性，並表現 pDC 標記 TCL1、TCF4、CD303；MPO、lysozyme、CD3、CD19 等譜系標記陰性。
WHO 5th 診斷：CD123 加另一個 pDC 標記，並表現 CD4 和/或 CD56；或三個 pDC 標記且所有預期陰性標記皆陰性。
多數病人有皮膚病灶，但部分（含兒童）可以白血病形式表現；anti-CD123 藥物 tagraxofusp 為核准的標靶治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤認為 AML with monocytic differentiation：單核球性 AML 也可 CD4+/CD56+/CD123+，但 lysozyme、CD14、CD11c 陽性且 TCL1、TCF4、CD303 陰性。

quiz.q: 圖中帶偽足的無顆粒 blast 若 CD4+、CD123 bright、TCL1+，診斷為何？
quiz.a: Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm（BPDCN）

60524.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中，大片均質、無細胞、淡粉紅色的無定形物質取代了骨髓間質，把殘存造血細胞與脂肪細胞分隔成小島，內有小血管被包埋；此「粉紅雲霧狀」沉積物需以 Congo red 證實為類澱粉（amyloid）。
features: Extensive interstitial deposits of homogeneous, acellular, pale eosinophilic amorphous material with a fluffy, waxy texture
Deposits separate residual hematopoietic cells and adipocytes into small islands
Small vessels with thickened eosinophilic walls embedded in the deposits
Residual hematopoietic areas contain mixed myeloid and erythroid cells without obvious sheets of plasma cells in this field
Bony trabecula at the top right; occasional fine cracking artifact within the deposits
60524.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows extensive replacement of the interstitium by homogeneous, pale eosinophilic, acellular amorphous material with a waxy appearance, separating residual hematopoietic cells and fat into small islands. Several small vessels are engulfed by the material with thickened eosinophilic walls. The residual marrow contains trilineage elements; a plasma cell infiltrate cannot be assessed at this magnification without CD138 and kappa/lambda staining. Given the reported apple-green birefringence on polarization, findings are consistent with marrow involvement by amyloidosis, likely AL type in the setting of a monoclonal gammopathy.

ddx.vs: Gelatinous transformation is paler, finely granular to basophilic hyaluronic acid-rich material that is Alcian blue positive and Congo red negative.
Fibrosis shows reticulin/collagen fibers with streaming spindle cells, and edema is pale and watery, neither showing Congo red apple-green birefringence.
LCDD deposits are Congo red negative and non-fibrillar by electron microscopy despite a similar eosinophilic appearance.
Proteinaceous exudate is associated with necrosis or hemorrhage and lacks Congo red birefringence.

60460.recognize_zh: 高倍下成片大型淋巴樣細胞，核大圓形至卵圓形、泡狀，許多細胞有明顯單一或邊緣性核仁，部分染色質呈模糊（smudged）外觀，並有凋亡碎片，符合大 B 細胞淋巴瘤（中心母細胞／免疫母細胞樣）。
features: Diffuse sheets of large lymphoid cells, nuclei 2-3 times the size of a small lymphocyte
Round to oval vesicular nuclei, some with irregular or indented contours
Prominent single central or peripheral nucleoli in many cells (immunoblastic/centroblastic)
Areas of smudged, hyperchromatic crushed chromatin
Scant to moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; apoptotic bodies and mitotic figures present
Scattered small vessels with plump endothelial cells
60460.describe_en: Section shows diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei, frequent prominent central or peripheral nucleoli, and scant to moderate amphophilic cytoplasm. Some nuclei show smudged, hyperchromatic chromatin, and apoptotic bodies and mitotic figures are readily identified. No follicular architecture or significant small-lymphocyte background is seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a large B-cell lymphoma; with cutaneous location and a CD20+, BCL2+, MUM1+ phenotype, they support primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type.

ddx.vs: PCFCL cells are predominantly large centrocytes (cleaved) rather than round centroblasts/immunoblasts and are BCL2 and MUM1 negative.
Myeloid blasts have finer chromatin, may show eosinophilic myelocytes, and express MPO/lysozyme/CD33 rather than CD20.
Merkel cells have salt-and-pepper chromatin with nuclear molding and express CK20 (dot-like) and neuroendocrine markers.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is CD20 negative and CD138/MUM1 positive with plasmacytoid cytoplasm, often EBER positive.

60268.recognize_zh: 薄片區紅血球連成長鏈狀、如疊放硬幣般的錢串（rouleaux），部分鏈超過6顆以上；左側可見一顆核偏位、細胞質淡藍的循環漿細胞，支持漿細胞白血病的背景。
features: Long linear and branching chains of red cells stacked like coins, many exceeding 4 cells
Individual red cells normocytic with central pallor; occasional polychromatophilic cell
Circulating plasma cell (left) with eccentric nucleus, coarse clock-face-like chromatin and ample pale gray-blue cytoplasm
Scattered normal-appearing platelets
60268.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows prominent rouleaux formation, with red cells arranged in long linear stacks of more than four cells even in the thin area of the smear. A single atypical plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus, coarse chromatin and moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm is present. Red cell agglutinates and spherocytes are not seen. Findings are consistent with marked rouleaux formation associated with a circulating plasma cell, compatible with plasma cell leukemia in the given clinical context.

ddx.vs: Red cells form irregular grape-like clumps rather than orderly linear stacks, and the clumps disperse on warming to 37 C.
Can produce similar rouleaux, so distinction relies on SPEP/immunofixation and absence of circulating clonal plasma cells.
Reactive circulating plasma cells are polytypic by kappa/lambda flow cytometry, whereas plasma cell leukemia cells are monotypic, often CD19-/CD56+ aberrant.

exam.answer_en: Marked rouleaux formation with a circulating plasma cell — long coin-like red cell stacks in the thin area, compatible with plasma cell leukemia/paraproteinemia
pearls_zh: 考法：先確認觀察位置在抹片薄片區（feathered edge 附近），長串、分支的錢串才有意義；再指出左側核偏位、染色質粗塊的漿細胞。
Rouleaux 的程度與血漿蛋白（尤其 paraprotein、fibrinogen）量相關，實驗室表現常伴隨 ESR 明顯上升、total protein 升高且 albumin–globulin gap 增加。
周邊血漿細胞的臨床意義：定義 plasma cell leukemia 需 circulating plasma cells ≥5%（IMWG 2021）；flow 可見 monotypic light chain，常 CD19-、CD56 表現較 myeloma 少。
後續必做：SPEP、immunofixation、serum free light chain ratio、骨髓切片及 FISH（如 t(11;14)、t(4;14)、del(17p)）作風險分層。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 cold agglutinin disease 的凝集；凝集是不規則葡萄串狀團塊且 37°C 加溫後散開，rouleaux 為規則線狀堆疊，加生理食鹽水（saline replacement）可分散。

quiz.q: 如何在實驗室以簡單方法區分圖中的 rouleaux 與紅血球凝集（agglutination）？
quiz.a: Saline replacement／稀釋：rouleaux 會散開，真正凝集不散（cold agglutinin 則加溫至 37°C 後散開）。

60140.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片同一視野出現三顆嗜酸性球，胞質中的橘紅色顆粒明顯稀疏、夾雜淡藍灰色無顆粒區；右下那顆細胞核分葉不規則、呈多葉扭曲狀，這些型態異常的嗜酸性球提示PDGFRA重排相關的克隆性嗜酸性球增多。
features: Three eosinophils in a single high-power field, suggesting eosinophilia
Sparse, unevenly distributed orange-red granules with patchy agranular pale blue-gray cytoplasm (hypogranulation)
Abnormal nuclear segmentation: bilobed nuclei and one eosinophil with irregular, contorted multilobed nucleus
Cell size normal to slightly enlarged
Red cells normocytic and normochromic; platelets sparse in this field
60140.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three eosinophils in one field, consistent with eosinophilia. The eosinophils are morphologically abnormal, with sparse and unevenly distributed granules leaving patchy agranular pale blue-gray cytoplasm, and abnormal nuclear segmentation, including an irregularly contorted multilobed nucleus. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic. These abnormal eosinophils in the context of marked persistent eosinophilia raise concern for a clonal eosinophilic neoplasm; together with FIP1L1::PDGFRA, the findings are consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophils may also show hypogranulation or hypersegmentation, so morphology is not specific and genetic testing (PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2) with exclusion of secondary causes is needed.
L-HES has similar eosinophils but a clonal or aberrant T-cell population (e.g., CD3-negative CD4-positive) on flow cytometry without PDGFRA rearrangement.
CEL-NOS lacks the tyrosine kinase fusions and requires other evidence of clonality or increased blasts.
Toxic neutrophils have fine dark purple granules and 3–5 lobes rather than large orange-red eosinophilic granules with bilobed nuclei.

60076.recognize_zh: 左圖低倍可見大量顆粒球系細胞（髓細胞、後髓細胞、帶狀球、嗜伊紅球），右圖中央是一顆大型圓形、細胞質深藍、染色質細緻的早期紅血球前驅細胞（pronormoblast），周圍卻沒有成熟中的母紅血球；「顆粒球系為主＋僅少數早期紅系」符合 Diamond-Blackfan anemia。
features: Marked myeloid predominance with myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils, and eosinophils
Rare large early erythroid precursor (pronormoblast) with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, round nucleus, and fine chromatin
Paucity of polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts, indicating erythroid maturation arrest
Scattered small lymphocytes with condensed chromatin
No dysplasia or increased blasts; red cells show brownish staining artifact
60076.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a marked myeloid predominance, with granulocytic precursors including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils, and eosinophils maturing in an orderly fashion. Erythroid precursors are markedly reduced; a rare large early erythroid precursor with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a round nucleus with fine chromatin is present, but later-stage normoblasts are essentially absent. Scattered small lymphocytes are seen, and there is no dysplasia or increase in blasts. Findings are consistent with erythroid hypoplasia with rare early precursors, supporting Diamond-Blackfan anemia in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.dx: Parvovirus B19 pure red cell aplasia
ddx.vs: The few remaining pronormoblasts are giant with glassy eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions and cytoplasmic vacuoles, with positive B19 PCR.
Morphologically similar but arises after age 1 year with normal MCV, HbF, and eADA, and recovers spontaneously.
A large basophilic early erythroid cell could be mistaken for a blast, but the proportion is not increased and granulocytic maturation is intact.

ddx.dx: Fanconi anemia or other marrow failure
ddx.vs: These affect all lineages with hypocellularity and reduced myelopoiesis and megakaryocytes, rather than isolated erythroid hypoplasia.

60012.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見數個巨核細胞，其核分成多個彼此完全分開的圓形核葉（separated nuclear lobes），且細胞本身不算大，這種核葉分離是多系發育不良（dysplasia）的線索，符合 AML 伴隨骨髓發育不良相關變化。
features: Megakaryocytes with multiple widely separated, round, non-lobulated nuclear lobes
Megakaryocytes of small to intermediate size with abundant pale granular cytoplasm
Nuclear lobes with coarse chromatin, lacking the normal interconnected lobulation
Cellular marrow with many immature-appearing mononuclear cells with vesicular chromatin in the background
Incidental elongated basophilic linear artifact/debris in the field
60012.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section (H&E, high power) shows a cellular marrow containing megakaryocytes with multiple widely separated, round nuclear lobes rather than a single interconnected lobulated nucleus. The surrounding hematopoietic cells include numerous immature mononuclear cells with open chromatin. Blast percentage cannot be reliably quantified on this single field and requires aspirate differential and immunohistochemistry. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia, supporting acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Reactive megakaryocytes have a single hyperlobated but connected nucleus, whereas these cells show discrete separated round lobes.
Osteoclasts have many uniform nuclei with small nucleoli and lie along bone trabeculae, while megakaryocytes lie within the hematopoietic space and stain for CD61/CD42b.
PMF megakaryocytes form clusters with hyperchromatic cloud-like or bulbous nuclei rather than widely separated small round lobes.
Megaloblastic marrow shows megaloblastic erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes without an increase in blasts, and megakaryocyte changes resolve with vitamin replacement.

exam.answer_en: Megakaryocytic dysplasia on marrow biopsy — small-to-intermediate megakaryocytes with multiple separated round nuclear lobes, supporting AML, myelodysplasia-related
pearls_zh: 考法：切片上考官指核葉分離的巨核細胞，問發育不良類型；並追問切片上如何估母細胞（CD34 IHC，但部分 AML 母細胞 CD34 陰性，需搭配 CD117 與 aspirate 分類）。
切片的優勢：可看巨核細胞分布（成簇、旁小樑）、細胞密度與纖維化；aspirate 稀釋或 dry tap 時切片 CD34/CD61 IHC 對判斷母細胞與小型巨核細胞特別重要。
CD61 或 CD42b IHC 可凸顯切片中不易辨認的 micromegakaryocytes，是 MDS/AML-MR 的高特異性發育不良證據。
分類：母細胞 ≥20% 並具 MR 遺傳異常或 MDS 病史為 AML-MR（WHO 5th）；ICC 2022 中母細胞 10–19% 歸 MDS/AML。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 MPN（如 PMF）的異型巨核細胞：PMF 巨核細胞大小多形、核深染雲團狀並密集成簇、伴纖維化；MDS/AML 發育不良巨核細胞偏小、核葉分離或單葉，背景有未成熟細胞增加。

quiz.q: 骨髓切片中要凸顯小型發育不良巨核細胞（micromegakaryocytes），常用哪種免疫染色？
quiz.a: CD61（或 CD42b）免疫組織化學染色。

28140.recognize_zh: 耳廓（尤其耳甲、耳輪與耳垂）呈瀰漫性紅斑並有細小鱗屑，耳前臉頰亦有淡紅斑；耳朵、臉部與手腳掌是急性 GVHD 皮疹早期好發的部位。
features: Diffuse erythema of the pinna, most intense in the concha and along the helix
Fine scaling of the ear and adjacent preauricular skin
Faint erythematous macules extending onto the cheek
No vesicles, crusting, or necrosis of the cartilage-bearing skin
Surrounding scalp and hairline skin without significant change
28140.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the external ear shows diffuse erythema involving the helix, concha and lobule, with fine surface scale and faint macular erythema extending to the preauricular cheek. There are no vesicles, crusts or signs of chondritis. In an allogeneic transplant recipient, erythema of the ears is a typical early site of cutaneous acute graft-versus-host disease; the findings are consistent with that diagnosis in context, pending exclusion of drug, infectious and contact causes.

ddx.vs: Polychondritis produces tender swelling of the cartilaginous ear that characteristically spares the non-cartilaginous lobule.
These are localized with greasy scale or a clear exposure history and lack the concurrent acral/truncal morbilliform eruption of GVHD.
Infection is usually unilateral, warm, indurated and tender with fever and sharply demarcated raised borders.

16492.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中成片黏聚的大型、多形性細胞，胞質豐富呈深藍色，常見雙核、多核巨細胞與異常分裂象，外觀像轉移癌或肉瘤而不像典型漿細胞；切片為瀰漫片狀多形腫瘤細胞，核染免疫組化廣泛陽性，需以 CD138、輕鏈等確認為漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Cohesive sheets and clusters of large pleomorphic cells mimicking a non-hematopoietic tumor
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with variably eccentric nuclei; frequent binucleate and multinucleated giant forms
Numerous and atypical mitotic figures
Nuclei with coarse-to-open chromatin and occasional nucleoli; perinuclear hof inconspicuous
Trephine biopsy with diffuse sheets of pleomorphic tumor cells (panel E) and a nuclear immunostain positive in most tumor cells (panel F)
16492.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows cohesive sheets of large, markedly pleomorphic cells with abundant basophilic cytoplasm, frequent binucleation, multinucleated giant cells and numerous atypical mitoses, an appearance that closely mimics metastatic carcinoma or sarcoma. The corresponding core biopsy shows a diffuse sheet-like infiltrate of pleomorphic cells, and a nuclear immunostain is positive in the majority of tumor cells. Classic plasmacytoid features are only focally evident. With appropriate immunophenotyping (CD138, MUM1, light chain restriction), findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with anaplastic/sarcomatoid morphology.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma is keratin positive and CD138/MUM1 light-chain negative, and lacks monotypic cytoplasmic immunoglobulin.
Sarcoma and melanoma express lineage markers (e.g. S100/SOX10, desmin) and are negative for CD138 with kappa/lambda restriction.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shows monotonous immunoblast-like cells, often EBER positive in immunodeficient patients, without CRAB features or serum paraprotein burden typical of myeloma.

ddx.dx: ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma or ALK+ large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These show hallmark cells or granular ALK staining, which distinguishes them from ALK-negative anaplastic myeloma.

21100.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中可見多顆巨大血小板（紅色箭頭），有些與紅血球一樣大甚至比淋巴球還大，顆粒完整；搭配自幼的皮膚黏膜出血，提示 Bernard-Soulier 症候群，而非只是血小板被破壞的 ITP。
features: Giant platelets equal to or larger than red cells, some exceeding lymphocyte size (red arrows)
Giant platelets retain purple azurophilic granulation (not gray/agranular)
Scattered normal-sized platelets and small dark objects over red cells (blue arrows)
Inset: giant platelet adjacent to a small lymphocyte for size comparison
Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional elliptocytes; no platelet clumps
21100.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a reduced number of platelets with many giant forms, several as large as or larger than erythrocytes and neighboring lymphocytes, with preserved granulation. No platelet clumping is seen to account for pseudothrombocytopenia. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis. In a patient with lifelong mucocutaneous bleeding, findings are suggestive of an inherited macrothrombocytopenia such as Bernard-Soulier syndrome; platelet aggregometry (absent ristocetin response not corrected by normal plasma) and flow cytometry for CD42b/GPIb-IX-V are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: ITP platelets are only mildly enlarged, platelet function and GPIb expression are normal, and bleeding is not lifelong.
MYH9 disorders show Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils and normal ristocetin-induced agglutination.
Gray platelets are large but pale gray and agranular due to absent alpha granules.

ddx.dx: Type 2B or platelet-type von Willebrand disease
ddx.vs: These cause macrothrombocytopenia with enhanced, not absent, low-dose ristocetin-induced aggregation.

exam.answer_en: Bernard-Soulier syndrome (inherited macrothrombocytopenia) — giant platelets as large as red cells/lymphocytes with preserved granules
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指和紅血球一樣大的血小板，問「為何不是 ITP、下一步做什麼」；答案：自幼出血＋巨大血小板要想到遺傳性，做血小板凝集試驗與 GPIb 的 flow。
機轉：GPIb-IX-V 複合體缺陷（GP1BA、GP1BB、GP9），多為體染色體隱性，血小板無法經 vWF 黏附。
凝集試驗：ristocetin 無反應且加入正常血漿不能矯正（vWD 可矯正）；ADP、collagen、epinephrine 反應正常。Flow 見 CD42b（GPIbα）/CD42a（GPIX）表現低下。
臨床：自動血球計數器可能把巨大血小板當紅血球而低估數量，需人工計數；避免因誤診 ITP 而用類固醇或脾切除，出血以血小板輸注或 rFVIIa 處理。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤診為 ITP；ITP 血小板多只輕度變大且對治療有反應，BSS 巨大血小板比例高、自幼出血、ristocetin 凝集缺失。MYH9 相關疾病則在嗜中性球可見 Döhle-like 包涵體。

quiz.q: 圖中紅色箭頭所指的巨大血小板合併自幼出血，應做哪一項血小板凝集試驗？預期結果為何？
quiz.a: Ristocetin-induced platelet aggregation；凝集缺失，且加入正常血漿無法矯正（Bernard-Soulier syndrome）。

19948.recognize_zh: 周邊血（A）可見雙型性紅血球族群與帶有小顆粒狀嗜鹼性包涵體的紅血球（Pappenheimer bodies，箭頭），骨髓鐵染色（B）可見紅血球母細胞核周圍排列藍色鐵顆粒的環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblast），符合鋅中毒導致銅缺乏的後天性鐵粒母細胞貧血。
features: Peripheral blood with a dimorphic red cell population including hypochromic cells admixed with normochromic cells
Red cells containing small clustered dark basophilic inclusions consistent with Pappenheimer bodies (arrows, panel A)
Occasional target cells and anisocytosis in the background
Prussian blue-stained marrow showing coarse blue iron granules arranged around the nucleus of an erythroid precursor, consistent with a ring sideroblast (panel B)
Cytoplasmic vacuolization of myeloid and erythroid precursors typical of copper deficiency is not assessable in these panels
19948.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a dimorphic red cell population with hypochromic cells and occasional target cells, and several red cells contain small clustered basophilic inclusions consistent with Pappenheimer bodies. The iron-stained marrow aspirate shows erythroid precursors with coarse siderotic granules encircling the nucleus, consistent with ring sideroblasts. Cytoplasmic vacuoles in precursors cannot be evaluated on the provided panels. In the clinical setting of zinc excess, findings are consistent with acquired sideroblastic anemia due to zinc-induced copper deficiency; serum copper, ceruloplasmin, and zinc levels should be correlated, and MDS with ring sideroblasts must be excluded.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic neoplasm with ring sideroblasts / SF3B1 mutation
ddx.vs: MDS shows dysplasia in other lineages and an SF3B1 mutation with normal copper levels, whereas copper deficiency typically adds vacuolated precursors and neutropenia and reverses with copper repletion.
Alcohol can also cause ring sideroblasts and vacuolated precursors, and is separated by history, macrocytosis, and resolution with abstinence rather than by low copper and high zinc.
Congenital forms present earlier with a microcytic hypochromic picture and are pyridoxine responsive or ALAS2-mutated, without zinc exposure.
Lead produces coarse basophilic stippling (ribosomal RNA, Prussian blue negative) rather than Pappenheimer bodies (iron, Prussian blue positive), with raised blood lead levels.

exam.answer_en: Acquired sideroblastic anemia from zinc-induced copper deficiency — Pappenheimer bodies in dimorphic PB and ring sideroblasts on marrow iron stain
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指鐵染色中核周環狀藍點，問「這是什麼細胞、定義為何」；ICSH 定義 ring sideroblast：≥5 顆鐵顆粒環繞至少 1/3 核周。
機轉：過量鋅誘導腸上皮 metallothionein，優先結合銅並隨上皮脫落排出，造成銅缺乏；來源如含鋅假牙黏著劑、過量補充劑。
銅缺乏血液學表現：貧血、嗜中性球低下、紅血球及顆粒球前驅細胞空泡、ring sideroblasts，易被誤診為 MDS；可合併類似 subacute combined degeneration 的脊髓神經病變。
處置：驗血清銅、ceruloplasmin、鋅；停用鋅並補銅後血球通常可恢復，但神經學缺損可能無法完全恢復。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤診為 MDS with ring sideroblasts（SF3B1 突變）；銅缺乏/鋅中毒為可逆性，需先查銅與鋅，並注意 Pappenheimer bodies（鐵陽性）與 basophilic stippling（鐵陰性）不同。

quiz.q: 圖 B 鐵染色中紅血球母細胞核周圍一圈藍色顆粒稱為什麼？在鋅攝取過量的病人，造成此現象的根本缺乏是哪種微量元素？
quiz.a: Ring sideroblast；銅（copper）缺乏。

13036.recognize_zh: 左圖胸骨左上緣可見隆起的腫塊（箭頭）；右圖腫塊觸片滿布核偏位、胞質深藍、有核周淡染區的漿細胞，偶見雙核，顯示為漿細胞瘤（plasmacytoma）或骨髓瘤的骨外延伸。
features: Clinical photo: firm swelling over the left upper parasternal region (arrow) with a pacemaker site on the right
Touch preparation dominated by a monotonous population of plasma cells
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin and occasional small nucleoli
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Occasional binucleate plasma cells; background of red cells and few other hematopoietic elements
13036.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows a swelling at the left upper parasternal region. The touch preparation of the needle aspirate is highly cellular and composed almost entirely of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse clock-face chromatin, abundant deep blue cytoplasm, and prominent perinuclear hofs; occasional binucleate forms are present. No granulomas, organisms, or carcinoma clusters are seen. In a patient with lytic bone lesions, anemia, azotemia, and elevated total protein, the findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma presenting as a sternal/parasternal plasmacytoma; clonality should be confirmed by kappa/lambda staining or flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters with cytokeratin expression and lacks the discohesive eccentric-nucleus plasma cells with hofs seen here.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has large immunoblastic cells with prominent central nucleoli, high Ki-67, and frequent EBER positivity, unlike these mature-appearing plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasma cell-rich inflammation or abscess
ddx.vs: Reactive processes contain mixed neutrophils, lymphocytes, and histiocytes with polytypic plasma cells, whereas this aspirate is monotonous.

18540.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中數顆嗜中性球的細胞膜外緣黏附一圈小血小板，形成「衛星」排列（platelet satellitism），而背景游離血小板稀少，這就是自動計數器誤判血小板低下的原因。
features: Clump of segmented neutrophils rimmed by adherent platelets encircling the cell membranes
Platelets are small, granular, and morphologically normal
Neutrophils themselves show normal segmentation and granulation
Few free platelets in the background red cell field
Unremarkable red cell morphology
18540.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a group of segmented neutrophils whose cell membranes are rimmed by adherent platelets in a rosette-like arrangement. The platelets are morphologically unremarkable, and relatively few free platelets are seen in the background. Neutrophil and red cell morphology are otherwise normal. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism, a typically EDTA-dependent in vitro phenomenon that causes spurious thrombocytopenia (pseudothrombocytopenia); a repeat count in citrate or heparin, or from a fingerstick smear, is recommended.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumping forms free aggregates of platelets at the feathered edge rather than rings of platelets adhering to neutrophil membranes.
True thrombocytopenia shows uniformly few platelets without neutrophil-adherent rosettes, and the low count persists in citrate-anticoagulated samples.
Satellite platelets lie on the outer surface of the membrane rather than within the cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Pseudothrombocytopenia due to platelet satellitism — platelets rosetting around neutrophil membranes with few free platelets
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著被一圈血小板包圍的中性球問「為什麼儀器報血小板很低？」答：platelet satellitism，黏附的血小板不被計入，屬 in vitro artifact。
機轉多為 EDTA 依賴性 IgG 自體抗體，使血小板經 GPIIb/IIIa 與中性球 FcγRIII（CD16）橋接；通常在室溫下發生，與疾病無直接關聯。
處理：抹片確認後改用 citrate（或 heparin）管重抽、立即計數或以指尖血抹片估計，避免不必要的血小板輸注、骨髓檢查或延誤手術。
患者本身沒有出血傾向；報告時應註明「假性血小板低下」，以免被誤診為 ITP 而接受類固醇等治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常被誤判為真性血小板低下或 ITP；關鍵是找中性球外緣一圈黏附的血小板（衛星現象），且換 citrate 管後血小板數恢復正常。

quiz.q: 圖中中性球周圍環繞的小顆粒是什麼現象？下一步應如何確認血小板數？
quiz.a: Platelet satellitism（EDTA 相關假性血小板低下）；改用 citrate 管重抽計數或看指尖血抹片

18156.recognize_zh: 這是兩張血球計數時間序列圖（非形態學影像）：左圖先天性嗜中性球低下患者 ANC 持續低於 500/µL、單核球持續偏高，沒有週期；右圖典型週期性嗜中性球低下 ANC 約每 21 天由接近 0 回升，單核球呈反向波動。
features: Serial absolute neutrophil count (ANC, blue) and absolute monocyte count (AMC, pink) plotted over about 120 days
Left (congenital neutropenia): ANC persistently below about 500/uL without periodicity
Left: AMC persistently elevated around 1000-3000/uL with a spike above 5000/uL
Right (cyclic neutropenia): ANC oscillates regularly with nadirs near zero and peaks up to about 3300/uL at roughly 21-day intervals
Right: AMC oscillates out of phase with ANC, rising during neutrophil nadirs
18156.describe_en: This non-morphologic figure compares serial neutrophil and monocyte counts obtained two to three times weekly over approximately four months. The patient initially thought to have cyclic neutropenia shows a persistently low ANC without regular oscillation and a sustained compensatory monocytosis, a pattern of severe congenital neutropenia. In contrast, the individual with classic cyclic neutropenia shows regular ANC cycling with nadirs near zero approximately every 21 days and reciprocal monocyte oscillation. The practical point is that serial counts over at least 6 weeks are needed to document periodicity, and both disorders are commonly associated with ELANE mutations.

18092.recognize_zh: 這是 IGH 重排的 PCR 引子設計示意圖：上方為 IGHV（FR1–FR3、CDR1–2）、CDR3（IGHD）與 IGHJ（FR4），下方 A/B/C 三種策略以箭頭代表引子、雙色球代表探針，病人特異性（allele-specific）引子或探針都落在 CDR3。
features: Schematic diagram of a rearranged IGH gene (IGHV-IGHD-IGHJ), not a morphologic image
Framework (FR1-FR4) and complementarity-determining regions (CDR1-CDR3) labeled
Orange arrows/probe represent patient-specific (ASO) primers or probes located in CDR3
Blue arrows/probes represent consensus primers/probes in IGHV FR regions or IGHJ
Three configurations (A-C) of real-time quantitative PCR for MRD detection
18092.describe_en: This schematic (Ghia, Hematology 2012) illustrates allele-specific oligonucleotide real-time quantitative PCR (ASO-RQ-PCR) strategies for minimal residual disease detection in CLL. The clonal IGH rearrangement is drawn with IGHV framework and CDR regions, the junctional CDR3 containing IGHD, and IGHJ/FR4. In approaches A and B, a patient-specific primer in CDR3 is combined with a consensus primer and a consensus hydrolysis probe in IGHJ or IGHV; in approach C, the patient-specific sequence is used as the probe between consensus IGHV and IGHJ primers. No morphologic interpretation is applicable.

15148.recognize_zh: 新生兒血液抹片中可見多顆大型原始細胞（blasts），核質比高、染色質細緻，部分細胞質含細小顆粒，其中一顆有粗大嗜鹼性顆粒；在新生兒（尤其唐氏症）出現這種原始細胞，要想到暫時性異常骨髓增生（transient abnormal myelopoiesis）。
features: Numerous large blasts, roughly 2-2.5 times the diameter of a red cell
High N:C ratio with round nuclei and finely dispersed chromatin
Scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some cells with fine granules
One cell with abundant coarse basophilic/metachromatic granules, suggesting basophilic differentiation
A small dense nucleated cell (lymphocyte or nucleated red cell) for size comparison
Background red cells with some teardrop-like and irregular forms; platelets not prominent
15148.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear from a neonate shows numerous large blasts with high N:C ratio, round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and a narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, several of which contain fine cytoplasmic granules. One cell has abundant coarse basophilic granules, consistent with basophilic differentiation often seen alongside megakaryoblasts in this setting. Cytoplasmic blebbing is not clearly evident at this resolution, so megakaryoblastic lineage cannot be confirmed morphologically. In a newborn, particularly with Down syndrome or trisomy 21 mosaicism, these findings are suggestive of transient abnormal myelopoiesis; flow cytometry (CD41/CD61, CD7), karyotype and GATA1 mutation analysis are recommended.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome
ddx.vs: ML-DS usually presents after the neonatal period (typically before age 4) with persistent or progressive disease and additional mutations, whereas TAM appears in the first days to weeks and usually regresses spontaneously.
Non-Down syndrome neonatal leukemia lacks trisomy 21 and GATA1 mutation, often shows monoblastic or lymphoblastic lineage with skin infiltrates, and does not regress.

ddx.dx: Leukemoid reaction of sepsis or congenital infection
ddx.vs: Reactive neonatal leukocytosis shows a left shift with maturing granulocytes and toxic changes rather than a population of uniform blasts.

ddx.dx: Normal neonatal nucleated red cells and lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Nucleated red cells have dense pyknotic nuclei and hemoglobinized cytoplasm, unlike blasts with fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Transient abnormal myelopoiesis of Down syndrome — circulating blasts (megakaryoblast-like, some with basophilic granules) in a neonate
pearls_zh: 考法：新生兒周邊血出現大量 blasts，考官會問「病人最可能有什麼體質」→ trisomy 21（含嵌合型），答 TAM 而非直接答 AML。
分子：TAM 的標誌是 GATA1 exon 2 截斷突變（產生 GATA1s），發生於胎兒期；blasts 表型常為 CD34、CD117、CD41/CD61、CD36 與異常 CD7 陽性。
病程：多數在出生後數月內自行緩解，但少部分會在 4 歲前發展為 myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome（多為 megakaryoblastic），需長期追蹤血球。
急症：嚴重者可有肝纖維化、肝衰竭、水腫/積水、高白血球；有症狀者可用低劑量 cytarabine，無症狀者觀察即可。
WHO 5th 將 TAM 與 ML-DS 歸在 Down syndrome 相關骨髓增生；ML-DS 通常需在 GATA1 之外再獲得 cohesin、CTCF 或 JAK-STAT 路徑等額外突變。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為先天性急性白血病（如 KMT2A 重組 AML/ALL）；關鍵在是否有 trisomy 21 與 GATA1 突變，且 TAM 會自行緩解，不應立即給予標準強度化療。

quiz.q: 唐氏症新生兒周邊血出現這些原始細胞，最可能的診斷與必驗的基因突變為何？
quiz.a: Transient abnormal myelopoiesis；GATA1 突變

1196.recognize_zh: 四格合成圖：周邊血中有中大型原始細胞（blast），核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質少至中等且無明顯顆粒或 Auer rod；骨髓切片為高度細胞性並被未成熟細胞取代。形態本身無法判定 T/骨髓雙系列，需靠流式確認 cCD3 與 MPO 共表現。
features: Peripheral blood blasts of medium to large size with high N:C ratio and round nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Scant to moderate agranular pale blue-gray cytoplasm without visible Auer rods
One blast adjacent to a neutrophil with clumped, abnormally lobated nucleus
Bone marrow biopsy (H&E) hypercellular with sheets of immature cells displacing fat
Occasional echinocytes/crenated red cells in the smear background
1196.describe_en: Composite figure: peripheral blood smears show circulating medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and scant to moderate agranular gray-blue cytoplasm; no Auer rods are identified. A neutrophil with abnormal nuclear lobation is also present. The bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular with sheets of immature mononuclear cells replacing normal hematopoiesis. Morphology is that of an acute leukemia without distinguishing lineage features; the diagnosis of mixed-phenotype acute leukemia, T/myeloid, requires flow cytometric demonstration of cytoplasmic CD3 together with MPO (or monocytic differentiation) on the blasts.

ddx.vs: T-ALL blasts express cytoplasmic CD3 but lack MPO and monocytic markers, which only flow cytometry or cytochemistry can separate.
AML-M0 blasts may express CD7 but lack cytoplasmic CD3; MPO is positive by flow in a minority without T-lineage commitment.
ETP-ALL expresses stem/myeloid markers (CD117, CD34, CD13/33) but is MPO-negative, unlike T/myeloid MPAL.
B/myeloid MPAL shows strong CD19 with CD79a/CD22/CD10 rather than cytoplasmic CD3; morphology is indistinguishable.

1260.recognize_zh: 在淡藍色的造血/淋巴背景中，可見成群的大型上皮樣細胞呈強烈棕色細胞質染色（黑色素細胞標記免疫染色），與周圍小淋巴球截然不同，支持轉移性黑色素瘤。
features: Cohesive clusters and sheets of large, pleomorphic tumor cells with strong brown cytoplasmic immunoreactivity
Tumor cells much larger than background cells, with abundant cytoplasm and occasional prominent nuclei visible through the stain
Scattered single positive cells infiltrating between background cells
Background of small hematolymphoid cells with hematoxylin counterstain that are negative
Low-power field; the specific antibody is not labeled and marrow landmarks (trabeculae, fat) are not seen in this field
1260.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain shows clusters and sheets of large, pleomorphic tumor cells with strong cytoplasmic positivity (brown chromogen), infiltrating a background of small, negative hematolymphoid cells. Scattered single positive cells extend away from the main clusters. The antibody is not specified, but in context the staining pattern is that of a melanocytic marker (e.g., Melan-A, HMB-45, SOX10 or S100). Bony trabeculae are not included in this field, so the site cannot be confirmed from the image alone. Findings are consistent with metastatic melanoma involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are keratin positive and negative for melanocytic markers such as SOX10, Melan-A and HMB-45.
Macrophages are CD68/CD163 positive, lack melanocytic markers, and granular brown pigment on H&E stains blue with Prussian blue if it is hemosiderin.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or other large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphomas express CD45 and lineage markers (e.g., CD30, ALK, CD20) and are negative for melanocytic markers.
Histiocytic sarcoma is CD163/CD68/lysozyme positive and S100 may be focal, but it lacks HMB-45 and Melan-A expression.
