1068.recognize_zh: 紅血球間夾雜三角形、頭盔形與不規則的小碎片（schistocytes），血小板仍可見且有數個較大血小板，符合人工瓣膜功能不良引起的碎片性溶血。
features: Scattered schistocytes: helmet cells, triangular and irregular angular red cell fragments
Background normocytic red cells with occasional oval and irregular forms
Platelets present, including a few large platelets
No nucleated red cells or immature leukocytes in this field
1068.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered schistocytes, including helmet cells and small triangular fragments, among normocytic red cells. Platelets are present, with a few large forms, and no nucleated red cells or immature leukocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with fragmentation hemolysis; in the clinical setting of a malfunctioning prosthetic aortic valve, this is consistent with mechanical valve-related microangiopathic hemolytic anemia, and thrombotic microangiopathy should be excluded clinically.

ddx.vs: TTP has similar schistocytes but with marked thrombocytopenia and ADAMTS13 activity below 10%.
HUS shows schistocytes with thrombocytopenia and acute kidney injury, often following Shiga toxin-producing E. coli infection.
Artifactual fragments occur near the feathered edge or in poorly made smears and are not accompanied by laboratory evidence of hemolysis.

4204.recognize_zh: 脾臟中倍H&E中紅髓充滿多形性淋巴樣細胞，大小不一，夾雜細胞質較多、核較大的活化淋巴球與免疫母細胞，背景仍可見紅髓脾索結構，符合傳染性單核球增多症的紅髓浸潤。
features: Dense diffuse lymphoid infiltrate expanding the red pulp
Polymorphous population of small lymphocytes and larger activated cells with more cytoplasm
Scattered immunoblasts with vesicular nuclei
Preserved cord-and-sinus framework with endothelial-lined spaces
No necrosis or monotonous sheets of atypical cells
4204.describe_en: Section of spleen at medium power shows the red pulp diffusely infiltrated by a polymorphous lymphoid population of small lymphocytes admixed with larger activated lymphocytes and scattered immunoblasts. The cord and sinus framework remains discernible, and there is no necrosis or monotonous sheet of atypical cells. Findings are consistent with reactive red pulp lymphoid infiltration of infectious mononucleosis; EBER ISH and immunophenotyping help exclude lymphoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows monotonous large atypical cells in sheets, lacking the spectrum of small to large reactive cells seen here.
HSTL is composed of monotonous medium-sized cells within sinusoids with gamma-delta T-cell phenotype.
EMH contains erythroid precursors, myeloid precursors and megakaryocytes rather than lymphocytes and immunoblasts.

4076.recognize_zh: 厚抹片中可見多顆大型細胞，細胞質豐富、淡藍灰色並呈細纖維條紋狀，核為卵圓形、偏位，與周圍深染的造血細胞形成對比，是 Gaucher 細胞的典型外觀。
features: Multiple large histiocytes with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Fine fibrillary, striated cytoplasmic texture resembling crumpled tissue paper
Oval eccentric nuclei with finely clumped chromatin
Cells much larger than surrounding myeloid and erythroid precursors
Thick, crowded smear area with overlapping cells and staining artifact
4076.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several large histiocytes with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm having a fibrillary, wrinkled texture and oval eccentric nuclei, in a thick crowded area of hematopoietic cells. Overlap limits assessment of surrounding cells. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells; enzyme assay for glucocerebrosidase and GBA1 genotyping are recommended to distinguish Gaucher disease from pseudo-Gaucher cells.

ddx.vs: They are morphologically identical and are distinguished by normal glucocerebrosidase activity with an underlying CML, myeloma or infection.
Niemann-Pick cells have foamy vacuolated cytoplasm rather than fibrillary striations.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei and granular pink cytoplasm with platelet budding.

exam.answer_en: Gaucher disease — multiple large Gaucher cells with striated blue-gray cytoplasm in BM aspirate
pearls_zh: 考法：在厚、擠的抹片區域找出大型淡藍灰細胞，問名稱；答 Gaucher cell，機轉為 lysosomal glucocerebrosidase 缺乏。
組化：PAS 陽性、TRAP 陽性、iron stain 可陽性；切片上呈 CD68 陽性組織球片狀浸潤。
確診：白血球或纖維母細胞 glucocerebrosidase 活性下降加 GBA1 基因檢測；chitotriosidase 等生物標記可用於追蹤。
Type 1 以 enzyme replacement therapy 或 substrate reduction therapy 治療，可改善脾腫大與血球低下。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Niemann-Pick foam cells 或 sea-blue histiocytes 混淆：Gaucher 胞質為細纖維條紋、無明顯空泡；foam cell 為泡沫空泡狀。

quiz.q: 圖中大型細胞做 PAS 染色預期結果為何？
quiz.a: PAS 陽性

4012.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片的顆粒幾乎由脂肪空泡與基質纖維網構成，只有少量散在的小型細胞，背景細胞稀少；移植後慢性移植物抗宿主病（GVHD）可造成骨髓低細胞性，但此表現本身不具特異性。
features: Marrow particles composed mainly of fat vacuoles and a stromal network
Markedly reduced hematopoietic cells, with scattered small mononuclear cells along stromal strands
Focal denser cellular area at the particle center without discernible cytologic detail
Paucicellular smear background with abundant red cells
Low magnification; lineage and dysplasia cannot be assessed
4012.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows marrow particles composed predominantly of adipocytes and stromal strands, with markedly reduced hematopoietic elements. Small mononuclear cells are scattered along the stroma, and the background is paucicellular. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings indicate a hypocellular marrow, which in a transplant recipient with chronic graft-versus-host disease may reflect immune-mediated marrow failure; graft failure, relapse, viral infection and drug effect should be excluded.

ddx.vs: Graft failure also yields a hypocellular marrow; chimerism studies, not morphology, distinguish it from GVHD-related hypocellularity.

ddx.dx: Hypocellular relapse of the underlying neoplasm
ddx.vs: Relapse shows increased blasts or clonal cells on differential count, flow cytometry or molecular studies.

ddx.dx: Viral marrow suppression (e.g., CMV, parvovirus B19)
ddx.vs: Parvovirus shows giant pronormoblasts with red cell aplasia, and CMV may show viral inclusions; PCR testing is required.
Morphology is identical; the transplant and GVHD context distinguish an immune-mediated post-transplant cause.

3948.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中多數異常早幼粒細胞顆粒稀少，細胞核呈雙葉、摺疊或「蝴蝶形」（bilobed / butterfly nuclei），是急性前骨髓細胞白血病微顆粒型（microgranular APL, M3v）的典型線索。
features: Numerous large abnormal promyelocytes with moderate to abundant cytoplasm
Characteristic bilobed, folded, reniform ('butterfly') nuclei
Hypogranular cytoplasm with only fine dusty azurophilic granules
Some cells with more basophilic cytoplasm and a few with cytoplasmic vacuoles
Occasional smaller cells with round nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Background red cells with few platelets
3948.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a leukocytosis composed of numerous large abnormal cells with bilobed, folded or reniform nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate amounts of hypogranular to finely granular cytoplasm. Coarse granules are sparse, and Auer rods are not conspicuous in this field. Platelets appear decreased. The bilobed hypogranular morphology is suggestive of acute promyelocytic leukemia, microgranular (hypogranular) variant; urgent confirmation of PML::RARA and coagulation studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have delicately folded nuclei with grey-blue cytoplasm and are nonspecific esterase positive, whereas microgranular APL cells show bilobed nuclei with strong MPO positivity and PML::RARA.
Classic APL shows abundant coarse azurophilic granules and frequent Auer rod bundles, while the microgranular variant has sparse fine granules and a higher WBC count.
AML with maturation shows blasts with round nuclei and a spectrum of maturing granulocytes rather than a monotonous population of bilobed hypogranular promyelocytes.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia, microgranular (hypogranular) variant — bilobed butterfly-shaped nuclei with fine dusty granules in blood
pearls_zh: 考法：指蝴蝶形雙葉核、顆粒稀少的細胞，要能答 microgranular APL（M3v），而非單核球性白血病；確認靠 PML::RARA（t(15;17)(q24.1;q21.2)）。
M3v 常見高白血球（常 >10×10⁹/L，屬 Sanz 高風險）、常與 FLT3-ITD 及 bcr3 異構體相關；flow 常 CD34−、HLA-DR−、CD2 可陽性。
細胞化學：MPO 強陽性（幾乎所有細胞），NSE 陰性，是與 monocytic leukemia 區分的快速工具。
急症：APL 合併 DIC／高纖溶出血，形態懷疑時立即給 ATRA，不必等基因確認；同時積極補 cryoprecipitate、血小板、FFP。
治療：ATRA＋arsenic trioxide 為標準；需監測 differentiation syndrome（呼吸困難、肺浸潤、體重增加）與 ATO 的 QTc 延長。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為 acute monocytic leukemia（折疊核、灰藍細胞質）；M3v 核為對稱雙葉蝴蝶狀、MPO 強陽性、NSE 陰性，並可在少數細胞找到 Auer rod 束。

quiz.q: 圖中雙葉蝴蝶形核、顆粒稀少的細胞，最快區分它與單核球性白血病的細胞化學染色結果為何？
quiz.a: MPO 強陽性（NSE 陰性）→ 支持 microgranular APL

3820.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的紅血球邊緣缺了一塊、像被咬掉一口（bite cell），上方另有一顆紅血球邊緣有空洞樣缺口，提示氧化性溶血（如 G6PD 缺乏）。
features: Red cell (arrow) with a sharply demarcated semicircular peripheral defect, as if a bite had been removed
Additional red cell above with an eccentric notch/vacuole-like defect near its membrane (bite or blister form)
Remaining red cells are normocytic with central pallor; mild anisocytosis
No spherocytes, schistocytes or target cells prominent in this field
Scattered platelets in the background
3820.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mostly normocytic red cells with preserved central pallor. The arrowed red cell has a smooth, semicircular peripheral indentation characteristic of a bite cell (degmacyte), and a second red cell shows a similar eccentric membrane defect. Fragmented red cells and spherocytes are not prominent in this field. Findings are suggestive of oxidative hemolysis with splenic removal of Heinz bodies, as in G6PD deficiency or unstable hemoglobin; a Heinz body preparation and G6PD assay are recommended.

ddx.vs: Helmet cells have straight, angular cut edges with pointed horns, whereas bite cells have a rounded concave defect.
Blister cells retain a thin membrane rim over a peripheral vacuole, while a true bite cell has the membrane completely removed.
Keratocytes show two horn-like projections flanking a notch rather than a single smooth bite.

exam.answer_en: Bite cell (degmacyte) — smooth semicircular membrane defect indicating oxidative hemolysis, e.g. G6PD deficiency
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭紅血球問「這叫什麼、代表什麼機轉」，答 bite cell：氧化使血紅素變性成 Heinz body，脾臟巨噬細胞把它「咬掉」後留下缺口。
Heinz body 在 Wright 染色看不到，需 supravital stain（crystal violet 或 new methylene blue）；G6PD 缺乏為 X-linked，男性較常發病。
急性溶血期年輕紅血球與網狀紅血球 G6PD 活性較高，酵素檢測可能假性正常，應於溶血緩解後（約 2–3 個月）重驗。
誘發因子：fava beans、感染、primaquine/tafenoquine、dapsone、rasburicase、nitrofurantoin；G6PD 缺乏者發生 methemoglobinemia 時不可用 methylene blue。
台灣新生兒篩檢已包含 G6PD 缺乏，考題常結合用藥禁忌與衛教。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 schistocyte（helmet cell）；helmet cell 是直線、帶尖角的切緣（MAHA），bite cell 則是圓滑的半圓形凹缺，旁邊可伴 blister cell。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指紅血球的缺口是如何形成的？要看到其前驅包涵體需要什麼染色？
quiz.a: 脾臟移除 Heinz body（氧化變性血紅素）；supravital stain 如 crystal violet

3692.recognize_zh: 兩顆中性球（箭頭）各吞了一顆大而均質、像毛玻璃的紫色圓形物質（LE body），把中性球自己的分葉核擠到細胞邊緣呈新月形；這就是紅斑性狼瘡細胞（LE cell）。
features: Neutrophils each containing a large, round, homogeneous, glassy purple inclusion (LE body) of denatured nuclear material
LE body lacks chromatin structure and fills most of the cytoplasm
Phagocyte's own lobulated nucleus compressed and displaced to the periphery in a crescent
Residual pink granular neutrophil cytoplasm around the inclusion
Background RBCs with crenation
3692.describe_en: Smear shows two neutrophils (arrows), each containing a large, round, homogeneous, smooth purple inclusion without chromatin detail. The ingested material displaces the neutrophil's lobulated nucleus to the periphery, where it is compressed into a crescent. Background red cells show crenation. Findings are consistent with LE cells, reflecting phagocytosis of antinuclear antibody-opsonized nuclear material.

ddx.vs: In a tart cell the phagocytosed nucleus keeps visible chromatin structure and often a nuclear membrane, and the phagocyte is usually a monocyte or macrophage.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil with phagocytosed apoptotic cell or pyknotic nucleus
ddx.vs: Ingested apoptotic cells are small, dense, and dark rather than a large pale-purple homogeneous glassy mass.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil with ingested cryoglobulin or crystal
ddx.vs: Cryoglobulin inclusions are pale blue, amorphous, and often multiple, not a single homogeneous purple body.

exam.answer_en: LE cells — neutrophils containing a homogeneous, glassy LE body that displaces the phagocyte nucleus into a crescent
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指的中性球，問裡面均質紫色圓形物是什麼，答 LE body（被抗核抗體調理的變性細胞核），整顆細胞稱 LE cell。
機轉：抗 histone／DNA-histone（nucleoprotein）抗體使受損細胞核變性、失去染色質結構，再被中性球吞噬。
LE cell test 是 SLE 的歷史檢查，敏感度與特異性皆不如 ANA，現已被 ANA、anti-dsDNA、anti-Sm 取代；藥物性狼瘡亦可陽性。
LE cell 也可能在體外（放置的抗凝血、體液如肋膜液）形成，於體液抹片看到時要想到 SLE 相關漿膜炎。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 tart cell 混淆：tart cell 多為單核球/巨噬細胞吞入仍保有染色質結構的完整細胞核；LE body 則均質無染色質紋路、將吞噬細胞核擠成新月形。

quiz.q: 箭頭指的中性球內含均質、無染色質紋路的大圓形物，這個細胞叫什麼？與哪個自體免疫疾病相關？
quiz.a: LE cell（內含 LE body）；systemic lupus erythematosus（亦見於藥物性狼瘡）。

3564.recognize_zh: 低倍下兩顆分葉中性球（箭頭）的細胞質邊緣各有一小塊淡藍色包涵體，視野中還散佈大小不一、部分偏大的血小板，而一般大小的血小板很少；包涵體加上巨大血小板是 May-Hegglin 異常的特徵。
features: Two segmented neutrophils with small pale-blue cytoplasmic inclusions at the periphery (arrows)
Neutrophil granulation otherwise normal
Scattered platelets of variable size including enlarged forms; normal-sized platelets appear decreased
One large, pale granular platelet at left
Normochromic, normocytic RBCs
3564.describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows two segmented neutrophils, each containing a small pale-blue cytoplasmic inclusion near the membrane (arrows). Platelets are sparse and variable in size, with several enlarged forms. Red cells are normochromic and normocytic. In a patient with thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with May-Hegglin anomaly (MYH9-related disorder); higher magnification and NMMHC-IIA immunofluorescence or MYH9 testing can confirm.

ddx.vs: Reactive Döhle bodies are accompanied by toxic granulation and vacuoles, and platelet size is normal.
Giant platelets are present without neutrophil inclusions, and ristocetin-induced agglutination is absent.
ITP may show large young platelets but no neutrophil inclusions, and platelet counts respond to immunosuppression.

exam.answer_en: May-Hegglin anomaly (MYH9-related disorder) — neutrophil Döhle-like inclusions with macrothrombocytopenia
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍圖考官指箭頭的中性球包涵體，並問背景血小板有何異常（數量少、偏大），要把兩個線索連結成 MYH9-RD。
確診：周邊血中性球 NMMHC-IIA 免疫螢光染色或 MYH9 基因檢測；血小板功能與出血傾向通常輕微。
遺傳性巨大血小板鑑別：Bernard-Soulier（GPIb-IX-V 缺陷、ristocetin 凝集缺失）、Gray platelet syndrome（NBEAL2、血小板缺 α 顆粒）。
血小板計數應以抹片或手動/光學法確認，避免把巨大血小板漏計而高估血小板低下程度。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤診為 ITP；ITP 雖可有稍大血小板但中性球無包涵體，MYH9-RD 則有持續巨大血小板加中性球淡藍包涵體，且常有家族史。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指中性球內的淡藍包涵體，其成分是什麼蛋白的聚集？
quiz.a: 異常的 non-muscle myosin heavy chain IIA（NMMHC-IIA，由 MYH9 編碼）。

3372.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間的造血組織被粉紅色纖維束呈漩渦、流線狀取代，細胞排列成條索，並散布許多褐色含鐵血黃素巨噬細胞，脂肪幾乎消失。
features: Intertrabecular marrow replaced by swirling, streaming eosinophilic fibrous bands
Residual hematopoietic and inflammatory cells arranged in cords between fibers
Numerous scattered brown pigment-laden macrophages (hemosiderin)
Marked reduction of fat spaces
Bony trabeculae at upper and lower right; small vessels within the stroma
3372.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows the intertrabecular space extensively replaced by fibrous stroma arranged in swirling and streaming fascicles. Residual hematopoietic and inflammatory cells are compressed into cords between the fiber bundles, fat spaces are markedly reduced, and numerous brown pigment-laden macrophages consistent with hemosiderin are scattered throughout. Megakaryocytic atypia is not appreciated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow fibrosis; reticulin and trichrome grading, iron stain and clinicopathologic correlation are recommended.

ddx.vs: PMF shows atypical megakaryocyte clusters, intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis and osteosclerosis with a driver mutation, not evident at this power.
Carcinoma shows cohesive keratin-positive epithelial nests within the desmoplastic stroma.
Mastocytosis produces discrete fibrotic aggregates of spindled CD117/tryptase/CD25-positive mast cells often with eosinophils.
Hodgkin lymphoma shows a polymorphous background with scattered large CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells within the fibrosis.

3180.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一顆中大型淋巴細胞，核圓帶輕微凹陷、染色質中度濃縮，細胞質中量且呈嗜鹼性藍色、邊緣不規則；本細胞缺乏典型 ATLL 的花瓣狀分葉，屬於較不具特異性的表現。
features: Medium-to-large lymphoid cell, about twice the diameter of a red cell
Round nucleus with a subtle indentation/notch, lacking deep lobation
Moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Moderate amount of basophilic cytoplasm with slightly irregular outline
Background normochromic red cells and platelets
3180.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cell with a round, slightly indented nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin and a moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm. The characteristic polylobated flower-like nucleus of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma is not present in this cell. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Although ATLL may contain basophilic cells with less nuclear irregularity, this cell alone is not specific; the findings are compatible with ATLL only in conjunction with other flower cells, HTLV-1 serology and a CD4+ CD25+ CD7- T-cell phenotype.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes show abundant cytoplasm that scallops around adjacent red cells with peripheral basophilia and are heterogeneous, without HTLV-1 or clonal T cells.
T-PLL cells have a distinct nucleolus, cytoplasmic blebs and TCL1A rearrangement, and are CD7+ rather than CD7- CD25+.
Sezary cells have cerebriform, grooved nuclei with scant cytoplasm and are CD26- without HTLV-1 infection.
Large B-cell lymphoma cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli and express B-cell markers on flow.

3116.recognize_zh: 多顆單核球系細胞核呈腎形或摺疊、染色質細緻，胞質灰藍並含細小嗜天青顆粒與空泡，左下有低顆粒的分葉嗜中性球，呈現慢性骨髓單核球白血病（CMML）的單核球增多與異型性。
features: Increased monocytic cells with oval, indented, or folded nuclei
Relatively fine chromatin; some cells with small nucleoli or nuclear clearing (promonocyte-like)
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and small vacuoles
Hypogranular segmented neutrophil at lower left
Crowded red cells in the background
3116.describe_en: The smear shows an increase in monocytic cells with oval to folded nuclei, relatively fine chromatin, and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules and scattered vacuoles. Some cells have small nucleoli and would be counted as promonocytes. A hypogranular segmented neutrophil is present. Findings are consistent with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, provided blasts plus promonocytes remain below 20% and persistent monocytosis is documented.

ddx.vs: AML requires at least 20% blasts plus promonocytes, which cannot be enumerated from a single field.
Reactive monocytes are mature with condensed chromatin, lack neutrophil dysplasia, and resolve with the underlying condition.
CML shows basophilia and a myelocyte bulge with BCR::ABL1, rather than dysplastic monocytosis.

2988.recognize_zh: 中央骨髓系前驅細胞的細胞質下半部充滿粗大、紫紅色的巨大顆粒，下方嗜酸性系細胞含極大的橘紅色圓形顆粒，左上角另一顆細胞邊緣也可見巨大顆粒，是 Chediak-Higashi 症候群的典型表現。
features: Promyelocyte/myelocyte with abundant blue cytoplasm filled with coarse, oversized pink-purple granules
Eosinophilic precursors with huge, round orange-red granules, some spilling from a disrupted cell
Additional precursors with few large irregular dark granules
Round to indented nuclei with fine to moderately condensed chromatin
Normal-appearing red cell background
2988.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows granulocytic precursors at several stages. A central promyelocyte/myelocyte contains coarse, abnormally large pink-purple cytoplasmic granules, and eosinophilic precursors contain huge, round orange-red granules, some released from a disrupted cell. Other myeloid cells contain a few large irregular dark granules. Findings are consistent with the giant granules of Chediak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-CH granules are restricted to a clonal myeloid population with increased blasts or dysplasia.
Normal eosinophil granules are uniform and small, not few and giant.
APL shows sheets of abnormal promyelocytes with folded nuclei and Auer rods rather than giant granules in otherwise normally maturing precursors.

exam.answer_en: Chediak-Higashi syndrome — myeloid precursor filled with oversized pink-purple granules and eosinophilic precursors with huge round orange-red granules
pearls_zh: 考法：中央細胞胞質充滿粗大顆粒，考官可能引導你往 APL 想；答題要說出其他前驅細胞成熟正常、無 Auer rod，且多系皆有巨大顆粒。
CHS 的巨大顆粒在骨髓前驅細胞階段就已出現，骨髓抹片常比周邊血更容易看到。
LYST 突變、體染色體隱性；臨床為部分白化、反覆感染、出血傾向與神經學病變。
Accelerated phase（HLH）需參考 HLH-2004 criteria 診斷並治療，之後以 HSCT 根治。
鑑別成人出現類似顆粒：pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules 見於 AML、MDS 等克隆性疾病。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 acute promyelocytic leukemia；APL 為成片異常前骨髓細胞伴雙葉核與成束 Auer rods，CHS 則是正常成熟序列中出現巨大顆粒。

quiz.q: 圖中顆粒粗大的前驅細胞為何不應診斷為 APL？
quiz.a: 無成片異常前骨髓細胞與 Auer rods，其他細胞成熟正常，且嗜酸性等多系皆有巨大顆粒（CHS）

2860.recognize_zh: 組織切片中大量中型細胞核呈圓形至不規則、染色質細緻、細胞質稀少，片狀取代正常組織；殘存的巨核細胞與小而深染的紅血球母細胞散在其間，提示淋巴母細胞浸潤骨髓。
features: Sheets of intermediate-sized cells with round to irregular or convoluted nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm
Residual megakaryocyte with lobulated nucleus
Scattered small dark round nuclei of residual erythroid precursors
Fat space at upper left
2860.describe_en: Section of hematopoietic tissue, likely bone marrow, shows sheets of intermediate-sized cells with round to irregular, focally convoluted nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. A residual megakaryocyte and scattered small hyperchromatic erythroid precursors are present among the infiltrate. Findings are consistent with infiltration by lymphoblastic lymphoma/leukemia; immunohistochemistry (TdT, CD3, CD79a/PAX5, CD34) is required to confirm lineage.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts often have more cytoplasm and nucleoli and are MPO/CD117 positive, whereas lymphoblasts are TdT positive and MPO negative.
Blastoid mantle cell lymphoma is TdT negative and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.
Burkitt cells have multiple small nucleoli, basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, starry-sky macrophages and are TdT negative with MYC rearrangement.

2796.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片幾乎被成片的小型淋巴細胞取代，而這張免疫染色只有極少數散在細胞呈棕色陽性；若此為 B 細胞標記，代表浸潤的淋巴細胞幾乎都不是 B 細胞，符合 rituximab 治療後 B 細胞耗竭、以 T 細胞為主的反應性增生（marker 未標示，需對照 CD3 染色）。
features: Diffuse sheet-like infiltrate of small to intermediate lymphoid cells replacing marrow between fat spaces
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Only rare scattered cells show strong brown cytoplasmic/membranous immunoreactivity
Vast majority of infiltrating lymphocytes are negative for this marker
Few admixed histiocytic or stromal nuclei; residual hematopoiesis sparse in this field
2796.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunohistochemical stain (marker not labeled) shows a dense, diffuse infiltrate of small lymphoid cells with round to mildly irregular nuclei. Only rare scattered cells are immunoreactive, while the large majority of the lymphoid infiltrate is negative. In the context of prior rituximab therapy, and presuming this is a B-cell marker such as CD79a or PAX5, the pattern indicates depletion of B cells within the infiltrate. Correlation with a T-cell marker (CD3) and clonality studies is required. Findings are suggestive of rituximab-associated reactive marrow T-cell hyperplasia rather than residual B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Residual lymphoma would show sheets of PAX5/CD79a-positive B cells (CD20 may be lost after rituximab), whereas here almost all infiltrating cells are negative.
PTCL shows cytologic atypia, aberrant T-cell antigen loss and clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas rituximab-associated hyperplasia consists of bland small T cells that are polyclonal.
T-LGL typically forms interstitial/intrasinusoidal CD8+, TIA-1+, granzyme B+ linear clusters with clonal TCR and STAT3 mutation, rather than a bland polyclonal post-rituximab infiltrate.

2796.stain: IHC (marker not labeled; likely B-cell marker)

2476.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片白血球增加，除了小而深染的有核細胞（有核紅血球或淋巴球）外，還散在較大的單核球樣細胞，而血小板很少；在幼兒身上這種單核球增多合併有核紅血球與血小板低下的血片，符合幼年型骨髓單核球白血病（JMML）。
features: Low-power peripheral blood smear with increased nucleated cells
Scattered larger mononuclear cells with moderate grey-blue cytoplasm consistent with monocytes
Numerous small dark round nucleated cells, likely nucleated red blood cells and lymphocytes (not distinguishable at this power)
Platelets markedly decreased
Red cells show mild anisocytosis without obvious schistocytes
2476.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows leukocytosis with an increase in mononuclear cells, including monocytoid cells and numerous small, densely staining nucleated cells that likely represent nucleated red blood cells and lymphocytes. Platelets are markedly decreased. Individual cell detail is limited at this magnification. In a young child, the combination of monocytosis, circulating nucleated red cells and thrombocytopenia is consistent with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia, pending absolute monocyte count, splenomegaly, HbF level and RAS-pathway mutation testing.

ddx.vs: Viral infections show reactive lymphocytes rather than monocytosis with immature myeloid cells and nucleated red cells, and lack RAS-pathway mutations.
CML shows a myelocyte and neutrophil peak with basophilia and is BCR-ABL1 positive, whereas JMML is dominated by monocytes and is BCR-ABL1 negative.
This is morphologically similar but occurs in infants with germline PTPN11 variants and usually regresses spontaneously; germline testing separates them.

2412.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片充滿骨髓單核芽細胞，核呈摺疊或腎形、細胞質灰藍帶空泡與細顆粒，右上角可見一顆顆粒散出的嗜酸性系細胞；急性骨髓單核球性白血病型態加上嗜酸球異常時要想到 inv(16)。
features: Hypercellular smear dominated by medium to large blasts and promonocyte-like cells
Nuclei round to folded, indented or kidney-shaped with fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli
Moderate gray-blue cytoplasm, some with fine azurophilic granules and small vacuoles
Mixed myeloid and monocytic differentiation (myelomonocytic picture)
Occasional granulated eosinophil-lineage cell with dispersed granules (upper right); granule color not well resolved at this power
Scattered small lymphocytes and a nucleated red cell
2412.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular population of medium-to-large blasts and promonocyte-like cells with round to folded or kidney-shaped nuclei, fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli, and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine granules and vacuoles. The findings indicate both granulocytic and monocytic differentiation. An eosinophil-lineage cell with dispersed granules is present, although abnormal basophilic eosinophil granules cannot be fully assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia, compatible with AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22)/CBFB::MYH11 in the appropriate cytogenetic context.

ddx.vs: M3v cells have bilobed butterfly nuclei and are HLA-DR/CD34 negative with PML::RARA, whereas this marrow shows monocytic vacuolated cells and eosinophil lineage involvement.
Pure monocytic leukemia lacks the granulocytic component and abnormal eosinophils; cytogenetics separates KMT2A rearrangement from inv(16).
CMML has <20% blasts plus promonocytes with a more mature monocytic and dysplastic granulocytic background.

2348.recognize_zh: 高倍切片中粉紅色無定形膠狀基質佔滿背景，殘存的造血細胞稀疏散布，可見分葉中性球、帶狀核、紅血球前驅細胞與小脂肪空泡，符合骨髓膠狀轉化中殘餘的造血成分。
features: Pale eosinophilic amorphous ground substance filling the intercellular space
Sparse residual trilineage-type cells: segmented and band neutrophils, myeloid precursors and small round erythroid precursors
Occasional larger cell with vesicular nucleus, possibly an immature myeloid cell or macrophage
A few cells containing fine brown pigment, suggestive of hemosiderin-laden macrophages
Small clear vacuoles consistent with atrophic adipocytes and congested vessels
2348.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows abundant pale eosinophilic amorphous extracellular material. Residual hematopoietic cells are sparse and scattered, including maturing neutrophils (bands and segmented forms), myeloid precursors and small erythroid precursors, with occasional pigment-containing macrophages and small atrophic fat vacuoles. The residual cells lack atypia and no infiltrate is identified. Findings are consistent with gelatinous transformation of the marrow with residual maturing hematopoiesis.

ddx.vs: Amyloid is Congo red positive with apple-green birefringence and often perivascular, unlike this Alcian blue-positive mucoid matrix.
Necrosis shows degenerated ghost cells and karyorrhectic debris rather than intact maturing granulocytes.
Fibrosis shows reticulin/collagen fibers with atypical megakaryocytes and streaming, rather than an amorphous matrix with atrophic fat.

2028.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下成片的漿細胞樣細胞：核偏心、染色質呈車輪狀（clock-face chromatin）、細胞質呈雙染性（amphophilic）；其中混有核較大、染色質較開、帶核仁的非典型細胞，形態較單一，提示 PTLD 中的非典型漿細胞增生。
features: Sheet of plasmacytoid cells with moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Eccentric round to oval nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin
Admixed larger atypical cells with vesicular chromatin and visible nucleoli
Mild nuclear pleomorphism and occasional binucleate-appearing cells
Scattered small dark pyknotic/apoptotic nuclei in the background
Relatively monotonous population with few small lymphocytes
2028.describe_en: High-power H&E section shows a sheet of plasmacytoid cells with moderate amphophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin. Admixed are larger atypical cells with vesicular chromatin and visible nucleoli, and there is mild nuclear pleomorphism. Scattered apoptotic nuclei are present, while small lymphocytes are relatively few. Findings are consistent with a monotonous population of atypical plasma cells in the setting of post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder; light chain and EBV studies are needed for classification.

ddx.vs: Plasmacytic hyperplasia preserves architecture with bland polyclonal plasma cells, whereas this image shows sheets of atypical cells with nucleoli.
Plasmablastic lymphoma consists of larger immunoblast-like cells with prominent central nucleoli and very high Ki-67, rather than predominantly mature-appearing plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytoid differentiation
ddx.vs: DLBCL is predominantly large centroblasts/immunoblasts expressing CD20, whereas plasma cell lesions are CD20 negative, CD138 positive.

1964.recognize_zh: 一顆圓形顆粒球，原本分葉的細胞核裂解成多顆大小不一、邊緣平滑、均質深染的圓球狀核碎片（karyorrhexis），胞質仍保有細小顆粒，這就是凋亡的顆粒球。
features: Round cell about 1.5 times the diameter of adjacent red cells with intact cell membrane
Nucleus fragmented into multiple smooth, round, homogeneously dense (pyknotic) spheres of varying size
No chromatin structure, filaments, or nucleoli within the nuclear fragments
Cytoplasm with preserved fine purple granules and a few small clear vacuoles
Surrounding normochromic red cells with overlapping (rouleaux-like) arrangement
1964.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a granulocyte with intact cytoplasm containing fine granules and a nucleus broken into multiple round, smooth, homogeneously dense fragments of varying size, without chromatin strands connecting them. The cell membrane is intact and there is no evidence of phagocytosis. This appearance represents an apoptotic granulocyte with pyknosis and karyorrhexis, a common in vitro artifact of delayed smear preparation or a finding in stored or infected samples.

ddx.vs: Hypersegmented neutrophils have six or more lobes with preserved coarse chromatin joined by thin filaments, not detached smooth dense spheres.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil with phagocytosed nuclear material (LE cell or ingested apoptotic bodies)
ddx.vs: Phagocytosed material is a homogeneous inclusion displacing the cell's own intact lobulated nucleus, whereas here the cell's own nucleus is fragmented.
Basophils have coarse, irregular dark granules overlying a lobulated nucleus with visible chromatin, not discrete round dense nuclear spheres.
Karyorrhectic nRBCs have hemoglobinized, agranular cytoplasm rather than granular granulocytic cytoplasm.

1708.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆小至中型淋巴球，核圓、染色質塊狀，外圍有一圈偏藍的細胞質；但核仍大致位於中央、看不到明顯核周淡染區（hof），漿細胞樣特徵並不典型。
features: Single small-to-medium lymphocyte with high-moderate N:C ratio
Round nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin, no visible nucleolus
Narrow rim of basophilic (blue) cytoplasm surrounding the nucleus
Nucleus essentially central; no distinct eccentric placement or perinuclear hof
Background red cells largely normocytic with a few small dot-like inclusions or overlying platelets
1708.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small-to-medium lymphocyte with a round nucleus, clumped chromatin and a rim of moderately basophilic cytoplasm. The nucleus is nearly central and a perinuclear hof is not appreciated, so plasmacytoid features (eccentric nucleus, abundant deep-blue cytoplasm) are only subtle in this cell. Surrounding red cells are unremarkable apart from occasional small dot-like inclusions. Findings are compatible with a reactive lymphocyte with mild plasmacytoid differentiation; a single cell cannot establish a clonal process.

ddx.vs: A plasma cell has an eccentric nucleus with clock-face chromatin, abundant deep-blue cytoplasm and a prominent perinuclear hof, more developed than in this cell.
Morphology overlaps; clonality requires a monotypic population on flow cytometry and MYD88 L265P testing rather than single-cell appearance.
A resting lymphocyte has only a scant, barely visible cytoplasmic rim, whereas this cell has a more obvious basophilic rim.

1644.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E：上方為帶腺窩（crypt）的腸胃道黏膜，其下黏膜及黏膜下層有數個淋巴濾泡，中央是淡染的生發中心（germinal center）、外圍為深藍色套層（mantle zone），屬黏膜相關淋巴組織（MALT，如 Peyer patch）。
features: Gastrointestinal mucosa with glands/crypts along the upper surface
Multiple lymphoid follicles in the mucosa and submucosa
Pale germinal centers surrounded by dark, well-defined mantle zones
Interfollicular and diffuse lymphoid tissue extending toward the surface epithelium
Deeper submucosal connective tissue at the bottom of the field
1644.describe_en: Low-power section of gastrointestinal wall shows surface mucosa with crypts overlying abundant mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue. There are several lymphoid follicles with pale germinal centers and intact, dark-staining mantle zones, surrounded by interfollicular lymphoid tissue that extends up toward the epithelium. Crypt destruction by lymphoid cells or effacement of follicles is not evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with normal or reactive mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue, such as a Peyer patch or lymphoid aggregate of the intestine.

ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma shows expansion of marginal zone B cells beyond follicles, follicular colonization and lymphoepithelial lesions destroying glands.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma of the GI tract
ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are back-to-back, lack polarity and tingible-body macrophages, have attenuated mantles and are BCL2-positive.
Shows monotonous small cleaved cells expanding mantle zones or forming diffuse nodules, with cyclin D1 positivity.

61932.recognize_zh: 中央細胞布滿粗大、深紫藍色的顆粒，顆粒散布到核上方使核的輪廓模糊不清，這是嗜鹼性球（basophil）的典型表現。
features: Granulocyte approximately 1.5 times red cell diameter with a round outline
Abundant coarse, dark purple-blue cytoplasmic granules of variable size
Granules overlie and partially obscure the lobated nucleus
Nucleus with condensed chromatin; lobation difficult to resolve because of granules
Background normocytic red cells with occasional smaller dense-appearing cells and scattered platelets
61932.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows largely normocytic, normochromic red cells with a few platelets. In the center is a granulocyte with a condensed, lobated nucleus that is partially obscured by numerous coarse, dark purple-blue cytoplasmic granules. The granules are larger and darker than neutrophilic granules and are not orange-red as in eosinophils. Findings are consistent with a mature basophil.

ddx.vs: Eosinophil granules are uniform, refractile and orange-red and do not typically obscure the bilobed nucleus.
Toxic granules are finer, distributed in pale pink cytoplasm and leave the clearly segmented nucleus fully visible.

Mast cells have a round, non-lobated central nucleus with densely packed uniform granules and are rarely seen in blood outside systemic mastocytosis or mast cell leukemia; tryptase/CD117 help distinguish.

exam.answer_en: Normal basophil — cell packed with coarse dark purple-blue granules overlying and obscuring the nucleus
pearls_zh: 考法：指細胞問名稱；答 basophil 並說出顆粒遮蓋核是與 eosinophil 區分的重點。
正常 basophil 佔白血球 <1–2%；增加見於 MPN（尤其 CML）、過敏、甲狀腺功能低下，反應性原因較少造成明顯 basophilia。
Flow 表型：CD123+、CD203c+、HLA-DR−、CD117−；mast cell 則 CD117 強陽性、tryptase+。顆粒具 metachromasia（toluidine blue 染紫）。
自動分析儀的 basophil 計數準確度較差，數值異常時需以抹片人工分類確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 mast cell；mast cell 位於組織或骨髓、較大、核圓居中且顆粒更密，周邊血少見；flow 以 CD117 區分。

quiz.q: 此細胞是什麼？區分它與 mast cell 的 flow 標記是？
quiz.a: Basophil；CD117（mast cell 陽性，basophil 陰性）

60396.recognize_zh: 核呈未分節、粗細大致一致的 C／U 字形彎曲帶狀，沒有細絲狀的分葉連接，染色質粗塊，淡粉紅細胞質帶細顆粒，是帶狀嗜中性球（band neutrophil）。
features: Mature granulocyte about 1.5-2 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Non-segmented, curved C/U-shaped nucleus with roughly uniform width along its length
No thread-like filament separating lobes
Coarsely clumped, condensed chromatin
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine lilac specific granules; small platelets in the background
60396.describe_en: High-power peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a curved, non-segmented, band-shaped nucleus of relatively uniform width and coarsely clumped chromatin, without filamentous constrictions separating lobes. The cytoplasm is pale pink with fine specific granules and no toxic changes or Döhle bodies. Surrounding red cells are normochromic, and small platelets are present. Findings are consistent with a band neutrophil.

ddx.vs: Segmented neutrophils have two or more lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments narrower than one-third of the lobe width.
Metamyelocytes have a kidney-shaped nucleus indented less than half its width with less condensed chromatin.
Monocytes have grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm and lacy chromatin in a folded rather than band-shaped nucleus.

exam.answer_en: Band neutrophil — non-segmented, curved C/U-shaped nucleus of uniform width without filaments, with fine specific granules
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問「band 還是 seg？」判準是核有無真正以細絲（filament）相連的分葉；無細絲、寬度一致即為 band。
Band 與 metamyelocyte 的分界：核凹陷超過假想圓形核寬度的一半即為 band。
Band 百分比升高（left shift）常見於細菌感染、發炎；band count 因觀察者間差異大，現代實驗室多已不例行報告。
若全部嗜中性球皆呈不分葉、寬啞鈴形核，應考慮 Pelger-Huët（遺傳或後天）而非 bandemia。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 segmented neutrophil：核扭曲重疊時看似分葉，但只要未見細絲狀收縮連接、核寬大致一致，就應判為 band。

quiz.q: 圖中嗜中性球核呈 C 形、寬度一致、無細絲連接，應歸類為 band 還是 segmented neutrophil？
quiz.a: Band neutrophil

108.recognize_zh: 血片滿是小而成熟、染色質塊狀的淋巴球並有多量破碎細胞（smudge cells）；骨髓切片被小淋巴球瀰漫取代，其間有較大、核仁明顯的前淋巴球/類免疫母細胞（prolymphocytes/paraimmunoblasts）聚集；流式為 CD19+ B 細胞共表現弱 CD5 與 CD23、輕鏈表現極弱，符合 CLL。
features: Peripheral blood: marked absolute lymphocytosis of small mature lymphocytes with round nuclei, clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, with numerous smudge cells

Bone marrow biopsy: markedly hypercellular marrow with diffuse, packed infiltration by small round lymphocytes and paler areas containing larger cells with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli (proliferation-center-like), residual megakaryocytes
Bone marrow aspirate: sheets of small lymphocytes with scattered larger prolymphocytes bearing prominent nucleoli (arrows); a megakaryocyte is present

IHC: diffuse positivity of the infiltrate for a nuclear marker and a membranous marker, scattered membranous-positive small T cells, a minority of nuclear-positive cells with a second nuclear marker, and heterogeneous cytoplasmic/nuclear staining with a further marker (antibodies not labeled on the images)
Flow cytometry: CD19+ B cells about 79% of living events, dim CD5 (dimmer than T cells) with variable CD23, moderate CD20, heterogeneous partial CD38, and very dim surface light chain
T-cell tubes: residual CD3+CD2+ T cells with both CD4+ and CD8+ subsets; the dominant population is CD3/CD2/CD4/CD8 negative
108.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with condensed, clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, accompanied by numerous smudge cells. The bone marrow core biopsy is markedly hypercellular and diffusely replaced by small lymphocytes, with vaguely paler zones containing larger cells with open chromatin and nucleoli consistent with prolymphocytes/paraimmunoblasts; residual trilineage hematopoiesis is reduced. The aspirate confirms sheets of small lymphocytes with a minor admixed population of prolymphocytes. Immunohistochemistry shows the infiltrate to be diffusely positive for the B-lineage/CLL markers applied, with scattered background T cells; the specific antibodies are not labeled in the images. Flow cytometry identifies a dominant CD19+ B-cell population with dim CD5, CD23 expression, moderate CD20, partial CD38 and very dim light chain, and trisomy 12 cannot be assessed morphologically. Findings are consistent with extensive involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: MCL cells are CD5+ but usually CD23 negative with bright CD20 and brighter light chain, show irregular nuclei, and are cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, whereas CLL is CD23+ with dim CD20 and dim light chain.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia or CLL with increased prolymphocytes
ddx.vs: B-PLL requires >55% prolymphocytes in blood with prominent nucleoli, whereas here prolymphocytes are a minority among small clumped-chromatin lymphocytes.
Richter shows confluent sheets of large cells with high Ki-67, whereas the large cells here are scattered or clustered in proliferation-center-like zones against a small-cell background.
MZL cells usually have more cytoplasm, lack smudge-cell-rich smears, and are CD5 and CD23 negative with brighter CD20 and light chain.

Bone marrow biopsy H&E, low power: hypercellular marrow diffusely replaced by lymphoid infiltrate
Bone marrow biopsy H&E, medium power: small lymphocytes with paler proliferation-center-like zones
Bone marrow biopsy H&E, high power: small lymphocytes admixed with larger nucleolated prolymphocytes/paraimmunoblasts
Bone marrow biopsy H&E, paratrabecular area: lymphoid infiltrate with residual hematopoietic cells
IHC (antibody not labeled): diffuse nuclear positivity in nearly all infiltrating cells
IHC (antibody not labeled): scattered membranous-positive small cells, likely background T cells

IHC (antibody not labeled): nuclear positivity in a minority of cells; solid arrows positive, open arrows negative
IHC (antibody not labeled): heterogeneous cytoplasmic and nuclear staining with brighter scattered cells
Bone marrow aspirate, high power: small lymphocytes with admixed prolymphocytes (arrows) and a megakaryocyte
Bone marrow aspirate, low power: lymphocyte-rich aspirate with megakaryocyte; arrow marks a prolymphocyte
Flow cytometry CD19 vs side scatter: CD19+ B cells 78.84% of living cells

Flow cytometry, lymphocyte gate: minor CD3+CD2+ T cells and dominant CD3/CD2 negative cells

exam.answer_en: CLL/SLL with trisomy 12 — small mature lymphocytes with smudge cells, marrow infiltrate with proliferation centers of prolymphocytes/paraimmunoblasts, CD5+/CD23+
pearls_zh: 考法：切片指較淡染的區域，問這是什麼（proliferation center，含 prolymphocytes 與 paraimmunoblasts），它是 CLL/SLL 的特徵而非轉型。
FISH 預後分層：del(13q) 單獨較佳、+12 與正常核型中等、del(11q) 與 del(17p) 較差；另需檢測 TP53 突變與 IGHV 突變狀態。
Trisomy 12 與 NOTCH1 突變及非典型型態相關；smudge cells 是抹片製備時脆弱淋巴球破裂的假象。
iwCLL 診斷需周邊單株 B 淋巴球 ≥5×10⁹/L；增殖中心變寬、融合且 Ki-67 高提示 accelerated CLL。
exam.pitfall_zh: Proliferation center 的大細胞易誤判為 Richter 轉型；Richter 為成片大細胞形成瀰漫區，而增殖中心是散在的淡染結節。

quiz.q: CLL 骨髓切片中淡染、含較大核仁明顯細胞的區域稱為什麼？
quiz.a: Proliferation center（增殖中心）

44.recognize_zh: 15 歲青少年骨髓切片細胞量明顯低於年齡應有，巨核細胞偏小且核分葉分離成多個圓形核（separated nuclear lobes），網狀纖維增加，免疫染色凸顯分散的小型巨核細胞；結合單核球與 B/NK 淋巴球缺乏，指向 GATA2 缺乏相關的兒童難治性血球低下。
features: Hypocellular marrow for age with increased fat between bony trabeculae and scattered hemosiderin pigment
Dysplastic megakaryocytes: small forms and megakaryocytes with multiple widely separated round nuclei
Erythroid and granulocytic precursors present without increase in blasts
Reticulin stain shows increased reticulin fibers
Megakaryocyte IHC highlights numerous small, dispersed megakaryocytes including hypolobated micromegakaryocytes
Peripheral blood neutrophil with bilobed nucleus (pseudo-Pelger-like) and thrombocytopenia
44.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows decreased platelets and a neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus. The bone marrow aspirate contains dysplastic megakaryocytes with multiple widely separated round nuclei. The core biopsy is hypocellular for age with trilineage hematopoiesis, scattered hemosiderin, and small atypical megakaryocytes with hypolobated or separated nuclei; blasts are not increased. Reticulin stain demonstrates increased reticulin fibrosis, and immunohistochemistry for a megakaryocytic marker highlights numerous small, dispersed megakaryocytes. In the setting of monosomy 7, monocytopenia, B/NK lymphopenia and a germline GATA2 mutation, findings are consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood (hypocellular MDS) arising in GATA2 deficiency.

ddx.vs: Aplastic marrow lacks dysplastic megakaryocytes and reticulin fibrosis, and monocytopenia with B/NK lymphopenia and monosomy 7 would not be expected.

ddx.dx: Inherited bone marrow failure (Fanconi anemia, dyskeratosis congenita)
ddx.vs: These also produce hypocellular marrows, but are separated by chromosomal breakage or telomere length testing and lack the profound monocyte/B/NK deficiency of GATA2 deficiency.
MDS-EB requires increased blasts (≥5% marrow), whereas blasts are not increased here.
MPNs have hypercellular marrow with clustered large hyperlobated megakaryocytes and driver mutations, unlike this hypocellular marrow with small dysplastic megakaryocytes.

44.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; reticulin; IHC: megakaryocyte marker
captions: Peripheral blood: bilobed neutrophil with reduced platelets
Bone marrow aspirate: dysplastic megakaryocyte with widely separated round nuclei
Bone marrow core biopsy, low power: hypocellular marrow for age
Bone marrow core biopsy, high power: small atypical megakaryocytes and hemosiderin
Reticulin stain: increased reticulin fibers
Immunohistochemistry highlighting small dispersed megakaryocytes

exam.answer_en: Refractory cytopenia of childhood (hypocellular childhood MDS) in GATA2 deficiency — hypocellular marrow with small dysplastic megakaryocytes with separated nuclei and increased reticulin
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指低細胞性骨髓中散在、核分離的小型巨核細胞，問如何與再生不良性貧血區分；巨核細胞 IHC（如 CD61）可找出小型 micromegakaryocytes。
WHO 5th 將 RCC 納入 childhood MDS with low blasts，多數為 hypocellular 亞型。
Monosomy 7 在兒童 MDS 代表預後差與進展風險，通常是異體造血幹細胞移植的適應症。
GATA2 缺乏線索：單核球、B 與 NK 細胞缺乏；青少年 MDS 合併 monosomy 7 應送胚系 GATA2 檢測，親屬捐者須先篩檢。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤診為重型再生不良性貧血：SAA 巨核細胞極少或缺如、無發育不良、無網狀纖維增加；RCC 有散在小型發育不良巨核細胞與紅系小島。

quiz.q: 兒童低細胞性骨髓中找到小型、核分離的發育不良巨核細胞，支持 RCC 還是再生不良性貧血？
quiz.a: RCC（兒童低母細胞 MDS）

63980.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中散佈多個兩端尖細的鐮刀狀紅血球（sickle cells）與船形細胞，背景有許多中央染色加深的標靶細胞（target cells），這組合是鐮刀型貧血最典型的抹片線索。
features: Multiple elongated sickle cells with pointed ends and boat-shaped (oat) cells
Numerous target cells with central hemoglobin condensation
Anisopoikilocytosis with occasional crenated cells and irregular fragments
Some red cells appear smaller with increased central pallor
Platelets present and adequate in number; a small lymphocyte and a nucleated cell at the lower margins
63980.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis with numerous irreversibly sickled cells and boat-shaped cells, together with many target cells. Some red cells are small with increased central pallor, and occasional crenated forms and fragments are present. Polychromasia is not prominent in this field, and no Howell-Jolly bodies are clearly identified. Platelets are present, and a lymphocyte and another nucleated cell are seen at the edges. Findings are consistent with a sickling disorder, such as sickle cell anemia; hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: HbSC shows fewer classic sickle cells and more target cells with intracellular crystals (billiard-ball or 'Washington monument' forms) and is confirmed by HPLC.
Sickle-beta thalassemia shows more pronounced microcytosis and target cells with elevated HbA2 on HPLC, which cannot be reliably separated by smear alone.
Elliptocytes are uniformly oval with rounded ends and no pointed sickle forms or target cells.
Artifactual elongated cells are aligned in one direction in thick areas, whereas true sickle cells are randomly oriented with sharp pointed ends.

exam.answer_en: Sickle cell disease — numerous irreversibly sickled and boat-shaped cells with target cells on peripheral smear
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指兩端尖細的鐮刀狀紅血球與標靶細胞，問診斷與確診檢查；答 sickling disorder，需以 hemoglobin HPLC／electrophoresis 確認 HbSS、HbSC 或 HbS/β-thalassemia。
分子：HbS 為 β-globin 第 6 個胺基酸 Glu→Val；去氧狀態下聚合使紅血球變形。Sickle solubility test 無法區分 sickle trait 與 disease。
脾臟自體梗塞（autosplenectomy）後抹片可見 Howell-Jolly bodies，對 encapsulated bacteria 感染風險高，需疫苗與兒童期預防性 penicillin。
臨床急症：acute chest syndrome、中風（兒童以 transcranial Doppler 篩檢）、parvovirus B19 造成 aplastic crisis、脾隔離危象；hydroxyurea 可提升 HbF 減少疼痛危象。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把抹片乾燥造成、同方向排列的拉長紅血球誤判為鐮刀細胞；真正 sickle cell 方向隨機且兩端尖銳，而 elliptocytes 則兩端圓鈍。

quiz.q: HbS 的分子缺陷為何？確診應做什麼檢查？
quiz.a: β-globin codon 6 Glu→Val；hemoglobin HPLC 或 electrophoresis
